jobs.description:
- Für ein bekanntes Haus im Bereich Pflege und Medizin in der Region Wetzikon suchen wir Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH – Schwerpunkt Psychiatrie.

### Kurz zusammengefasst: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Wetzikon

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Psychiatrie

**Pensum:** 60–80 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Wetzikon

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Wetzikon liegt in der Zürcher Oberland und besticht durch eine hervorragende Verkehrsanbindung mit direkter Bahnverbindung nach Zürich. Sie profitieren von der zentralen Lage zwischen Stadt und ländlichem Raum, was kurze Pendelwege ermöglicht. Die Region bietet Ihnen ein vielfältiges Arbeitsplatzangebot in etablierten Branchen und mittelständischen Unternehmen bei gleichzeitig hoher Lebensqualität und guten Freizeitmöglichkeiten.

### Ihr Aufgabengebiet als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Psychiatrie in Wetzikon

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Das setzen wir für diese Stelle voraus

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Psychiatrie

Sie arbeiten in einem psychiatrischen Umfeld. Beziehung ist hier das wichtigste Werkzeug: Sie begleiten Menschen in Krisen, geben Halt und arbeiten mit klaren Strukturen. Zudem sind Deeskalation und der geschulte Blick für Veränderungen Teil Ihres Alltags – ein Fachbereich, der viel gibt.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Psychiatrie in Wetzikon verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Der Arbeitsmarkt für Diplom-Pflegefachkräfte in Psychiatrie zeigt in der Region Wetzikon eine anhaltend hohe Nachfrage. Die Spitäler und Fachkliniken suchen kontinuierlich qualifiziertes Personal im genannten Pensum. Als spezialisierter Personalvermittler bietet Ihnen iPersonal einen direkten Zugang zu attraktiven Positionen und unterstützt Sie bei der Vermittlung in passende Stellen.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Wetzikon

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv
- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Psychiatrie in Wetzikon

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Übrigens: Laufend weitere [offene Stellen](https://med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/), Jobs und Stellenangebote in Pflege und Medizin finden Sie jederzeit auf med-ipersonal.ch.

### Interessiert? Wir freuen uns auf Sie

- Ihre neue Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Psychiatrie in Wetzikon wartet – zudem beraten wir Sie gerne zu weiteren Stellen als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH in Ihrer Region.
- Senden Sie uns darum noch heute Ihre Bewerbung als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH für Wetzikon – wir begleiten Sie dabei persönlich.

**Per E-Mail:** nk@med-ipersonal.ch

Chauffeur Taxi \& Limousine – Gstaad (H/F)
============================================



### Chauffeur Taxi \& Limousine – Gstaad (H/F)



Nous recherchons un chauffeur professionnel pour renforcer notre équipe à Gstaad, principalement pour la prochaine saison d’ activité combine **Taxi et Limousine / Chauffeur Service**, avec une clientèle locale et internationale exigeante. Nous effectuons des courses Taxi, livraisons express pour des magasins de luxe, transferts privés et aéroports ainsi que des mises à disposition avec chauffeur dans la région de Gstaad et dans toute la Suisse.

Profil recherché
-----------------

Nous recherchons une personne :

* professionnelle, fiable et ponctuelle
* avec une excellente présentation et un très bon sens du service client
* à l’aise avec une clientèle internationale et haut de gamme
* ayant une **bonne capacité à gérer les périodes de stress et de forte activité**
* faisant preuve d’une**grande flexibilité et disponibilité**, indispensables dans notre activité
* disponible pour travailler selon les besoins du service, notamment les soirées, week\-ends et jours fériés
* à l’aise avec la conduite en montagne et dans des conditions hivernales
* capable de travailler de manière autonome tout en s’intégrant dans une petite équipe
* discrète et respectueuse de la confidentialité de nos clients.


Permis et qualifications – obligatoires
-----------------------------------------

* **Permis de conduire catégorie B avec autorisation professionnelle B121**
* Autorisation de travailler en Suisse.


Nous souhaitons cibler en priorité des candidats déjà actifs en Suisse et disposant des qualifications nécessaires pour pouvoir commencer rapidement.

Langues
-------

Compte tenu de notre clientèle internationale :

* **Anglais : obligatoire**
*  **çais et/ou allemand : requis**
* Toute langue supplémentaire constitue un réel apprécions notamment les candidats parlant également **arabe, russe, italien, portugais ou espagnol**.


La capacité à communiquer naturellement et professionnellement avec une clientèle internationale est essentielle.

Une expérience comme **chauffeur de taxi, chauffeur limousine, chauffeur privé, chauffeur d’hôtel ou dans le transport professionnel de personnes**constitue un avantage important.

Au\-delà de l’expérience, nous accordons beaucoup d’importance à la qualité du service, à la présentation, à la conduite, à la ponctualité et à l’attitude envers le client.

Véhicules

Le chauffeur sera amené à conduire principalement des véhicules premium \- , notamment **E\-Class, V\-Class et S\-Class**.

Une conduite souple, prudente et adaptée aux standards d’un service limousine est essentielle.

---------------------

* Travail possible en soirée, les week\-ends et les jours fériés
* **Flexibilité et disponibilité exigées**, particulièrement pendant les périodes de haute saison.
* **Permis de conduire catégorie B avec autorisation professionnelle B121**; (aussi D, D1 valable)

Nous offrons

Accelleron is accelerating sustainability in the marine and energy industries as a global technology leader in turbocharging, fuel injection, and digital solutions for heavy\-duty applications. Accelleron’s 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best\-in\-class products, services, and solutions that are mission\-critical for the energy transition. You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting\-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.



Data Science \& AI Specialist (m/f/d) (80\-100%)
================================================







This role is the foundation of Accelleron's new Advanced Analytics AI Center of Excellence. This role requires coding experience and handling of structured and unstructured data sets. This role transforms business challenges into data\-driven solutions: identifying the right data, building and validating models, translating results into insights and measurable business value.



The Advanced Analytics AI CoE builds process\-agnostic capability and acts as the expert partner to the process domain teams and business units that own the solutions. Alongside hands\-on delivery, the role helps the AI citizen program across the company to work safely and effectively with AI. These roles will help to go up to the next AI data maturity level.



**Your Responsibilities:**



*AI and machine\-learning use case delivery*



* Support and deliver data driven solutions: from problem framing and feasibility assessment to model development, validation, deployment, and post\-go\-live monitoring.
* Create actionable insights using data science \& AI methods: statistical analysis, machine learning, computer vision, Large Language Models applied to business problems.

Clinical Data and Trial Lead 80 \- 100 % (w/m/d)
================================================







For more than 40 years, Medical has shaped the future of mechanical ventilation. We develop Intelligent Ventilation solutions that support clinicians in critical moments.  
  
Our ventilators are used in intensive care units, during emergency transport, and in MRI environments. They help medical teams care for adult, pediatric, and neonatal patients worldwide.  
  
Here, your work has real impact. Every improvement you make supports better respiratory care for patients around the globe.









  **How you can make a difference** **:**



Join our Clinical Research and Innovation team and contribute to clinical trials that shape the future of mechanical ventilation technology. As a Medical Research Engineer, you will play a key role in developing and maintaining data management tools, analyzing clinical study data, and collaborating with medical experts to generate valuable research insights and scientific publications.  

**Your Responsibilities**



* Implement data management tools and automated workflow for clinical and medical device data, including data transfer, storage, conversion, anonymization, cleaning, quality validation, and filtering.
* Process and analyze medical device data, physiological signals, and time\-series data to generate reliable, analysis\-ready datasets.
* Conduct exploratory data analyses and perform software\-based analyses of clinical study data to evaluate research hypotheses and support study reports, regulatory submissions, and scientific publications.
* Develop, implement, test, and validate electronic case report forms (eCRFs), clinical databases, including edit checks, and data review tools.
* Perform ongoing clinical data review, identify inconsistencies and missing data, and support edit checks, query management, reconciliation, and database cleaning activities.
* Coordinate and support clinical studies throughout the study lifecycle, including feasibility assessments, study start\-up, site initiation, study conduct, close\-out, and database lock.
* Support clinical project planning and tracking to ensure that study timelines, milestones, budgets, deliverables, quality objectives, and risks are effectively managed.
* Act as a key contact for investigators, study sites, CROs, EDC providers, external partners, and internal stakeholders (Regulatory and Clinical Affairs, Medical Experts, Engineering), ensuring clear communication, effective networking, and timely issue resolution.










  **That's what you bring along** **:**



* Master's degree in a relevant engineering, scientific, biomedical, statistics, data science, or related field.
* Strong programming skills in MATLAB and (experience in C\+\+, C\#, or C is a plus).
* Experience working with medical device data, physiological signals, or time\-series data, including data acquisition, processing, quality assessment, and interpretation in a clinical or research setting. Familiarity with acute\-care workflows, PDMS, and bedside device data integration is a plus.
* At least two years of hands\-on experience in clinical studies, clinical data management (data review and query management), or clinical database development (eCRF design and testing).


* Experience working with clinical study teams, investigators, study sites, CROs, EDC providers, or other external clinical partners. Familiarity with electronic Case Report Form (eCRF) development, programming, and testing is a plus.


* Knowledge of clinical trial regulations (e.g., ISO 14155, GCP, MDR, FDA) and regulatory requirements for clinical data management incl. data protection regulations (GDPR, HIPAA).


* Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage technical and clinical workstreams, deadlines, risks, and multiple priorities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across technical, clinical, cross\-functional, and international teams.
* High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data integrity, quality, regulatory compliance, and reproducible analysis. Background in statistical analysis and data interpretation for clinical research is a plus.
* Fluent in English, with strong documentation, presentation, and reporting skills. is a plus.
* Self\-motivated and proactive team player with the ability to work independently.
* Willingness to travel internationally up to 10%.


**How to apply:**

- Für ein bekanntes Haus im Bereich Pflege und Medizin in der Region Gipf-Oberfrick suchen wir Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH – Schwerpunkt Psychiatrie Entwicklungsstörungen.

### Kurz zusammengefasst: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Gipf-Oberfrick

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Psychiatrie Entwicklungsstörungen

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Gipf-Oberfrick

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Gipf-Oberfrick liegt malerisch im Fricktal des Kantons Aargau und besticht durch seine zentrale Lage zwischen Basel und Zürich. Sie profitieren von einer ausgezeichneten Verkehrsanbindung durch die Bahnlinie Basel-Waldshut und nahegelegene Autobahnanschlüsse. Die Region bietet Ihnen eine hohe Lebensqualität durch ländliche Ruhe, moderne Infrastruktur und zahlreiche lokale Arbeitgeber, was sie zu einem attraktiven Arbeitsort macht.

### Ihr Aufgabengebiet als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Psychiatrie Entwicklungsstörungen in Gipf-Oberfrick

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Das setzen wir für diese Stelle voraus

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Psychiatrie Entwicklungsstörungen

Sie arbeiten in einem psychiatrischen Umfeld. Beziehung ist hier das wichtigste Werkzeug: Sie begleiten Menschen in Krisen, geben Halt und arbeiten mit klaren Strukturen. Zudem sind Deeskalation und der geschulte Blick für Veränderungen Teil Ihres Alltags – ein Fachbereich, der viel gibt.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Psychiatrie Entwicklungsstörungen in Gipf-Oberfrick verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Die Region Gipf-Oberfrick verzeichnet eine hohe Nachfrage nach diplomierten Pflegefachpersonen mit Spezialisierung auf Psychiatrie und Entwicklungsstörungen. Ihre Qualifikation eröffnet Ihnen ausgezeichnete Chancen bei stationären und ambulanten Einrichtungen. iPersonal vermittelt Sie gezielt an passende Arbeitgeber und unterstützt Sie bei der Stellensuche mit umfassender Beratung, sodass Sie schnell in eine erfüllende Position finden.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Gipf-Oberfrick

- Bezahlte Kurse über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv
- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Psychiatrie Entwicklungsstörungen in Gipf-Oberfrick

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
Meist hören Sie schon innerhalb von 24 Stunden von uns, denn Ihre Zeit ist uns wichtig. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Übrigens: Laufend weitere [offene Stellen](https://med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/), Jobs und Stellenangebote in Pflege und Medizin finden Sie jederzeit auf med-ipersonal.ch.

### Interessiert? Wir freuen uns auf Sie

- Ihre neue Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Psychiatrie Entwicklungsstörungen in Gipf-Oberfrick wartet – zudem beraten wir Sie gerne zu weiteren Stellen als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH in Ihrer Region.
- Senden Sie uns darum noch heute Ihre Bewerbung als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH für Gipf-Oberfrick – wir begleiten Sie dabei persönlich.

ICT Supporter

Du hast Freude daran, Menschen bei IT\-Problemen weiterzuhelfen, behältst auch bei mehreren Anfragen den Überblick und arbeitest gerne in einer kundenorientierten Supportrolle?

Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

???? Über ITeasy
-----------------

ITeasy ist die externe IT\-Abteilung für kleine und mittlere Unternehmen. Wir unterstützen unsere Kunden im täglichen IT\-Betrieb, lösen Supportanfragen und betreuen ihre Arbeitsplätze, Microsoft\-365\-Umgebungen, Netzwerke und weitere IT\-Systeme.

Unsere Kunden schätzen die persönliche, unkomplizierte und zuverlässige Betreuung. Wir sind ein kleines, familiäres Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und legen Wert auf pragmatische Lösungen und eine angenehme Zusammenarbeit.

????‍???? Deine bei ITeasy
----------------------------

Als ICT Supporter bist du eine der ersten Ansprechpersonen für unsere Kunden. Du nimmst ihre Anliegen per Telefon, E\-Mail und über unser Ticketsystem entgegen, verstehst das eigentliche Problem und sorgst dafür, dass sie rasch und freundlich Unterstützung erhalten.

Viele Anfragen löst du selbständig. Bei komplexeren Fällen dokumentierst du die wichtigsten Informationen sauber und übergibst das Ticket an unsere System Engineers. Dabei behältst du offene Anliegen im Auge und stellst sicher, dass unsere Kunden zuverlässig informiert werden.

Diese Stelle passt besonders gut zu dir, wenn du gerne operativ arbeitest, den direkten Kontakt mit Menschen schätzt und dich in einer vielseitigen Supportfunktion wohlfühlst.

????️ Deine Aufgaben
----------------------

* Entgegennahme und Bearbeitung von Supportanfragen per Telefon, E\-Mail und Ticketsystem
* Analyse und Lösung von Störungen im First\-Level\-Support
* Unterstützung unserer Kunden per Fernzugriff, im Büro und gelegentlich vor Ort
* Einrichtung von Computern, Benutzerkonten, Microsoft\-365\-Anwendungen, Druckern und mobilen Geräten
* Unterstützung bei Ein\- und Austritten von Mitarbeitenden unserer Kunden
* Verwaltung von Benutzern, Berechtigungen und Standardapplikationen
* Installation und Aktualisierung von Hard\- und Software
* Dokumentation der bearbeiteten Anfragen und Lösungen
* Koordination und Weiterleitung komplexerer Fälle an unsere System Engineers

* Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als ICT\-Fachmann/\-frau EFZ, Informatiker/in EFZ Plattformentwicklung oder eine vergleichbare IT\-Ausbildung

* Freude am täglichen Kontakt mit Kunden und am Lösen konkreter Anwenderprobleme
* Fliessende mündliche und schriftliche Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse
* Freundliche, geduldige und verständliche Kommunikation
* Zuverlässige, sorgfältige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
* Fähigkeit, Kundenanliegen richtig einzuordnen und gezielt nachzufragen
* Grundkenntnisse in Microsoft 365 sowie Windows\-Clients
* Bereitschaft, Neues zu lernen und das eigene Supportwissen aktuell zu halten
* Teamgeist und ein bodenständiger, unkomplizierter Umgang


???? Mit diesen Themen arbeitest du bei uns

Du musst nicht bereits alles beherrschen. Wichtig sind solide Grundlagen, Lernbereitschaft und Freude am Support:

jobs.title: Patient Services Governance Lead
jobs.description:
The Patient Services Governance Lead provides enterprise-level governance leadership for Patient Services and related patient support activities across the patient journey. The role focuses on PSPs and other structured services that support diagnostic testing, access and reimbursement, treatment start and administration, home care or treatment logistics, adherence, monitoring, and ongoing disease or wellbeing support. It may also provide governance input for patient education and awareness activities where these require dedicated Patient Services review.

Operating within the Medical Governance Office, this role establishes and maintains clear standards, decision criteria, review pathways, documentation expectations, and oversight requirements for these activities. The role helps teams determine the appropriate governance approach for PSPs, diagnostic services, and other patient-facing support, ensuring that the right Medical, Ethics & Compliance, Pharmacovigilance, Quality, Regulatory, Privacy, Legal, Digital/DD&T, Access, Procurement, and Vendor Management reviews are built into the process where relevant.

The role balances compliance rigor with practical execution, enabling responsible innovation through simple tools, templates, clear accountabilities, and consistent ways of working across markets. Working closely with Strategic Portfolio Division (SPD), Marketing and Commercial Excellence (MCE), and local market organizations, the role helps translate enterprise governance standards into compliant local execution aligned to patient journey needs, healthcare-system realities, and country-specific regulatory requirements. It does not own Patient Services strategy, asset-level launch planning, or local program delivery; instead, it provides the governance standards, risk-management framework, and advisory support needed for compliant, scalable, and patient-centric execution globally

The role also serves as a key Medical Governance Office partner to Digital/DD&T and Patient Solutions stakeholders, ensuring that digital patient services, technology-enabled patient support programs, patient-facing platforms, and emerging AI-enabled solutions are governed through appropriate risk-based oversight, data governance, privacy, security, quality, and compliance frameworks. This includes helping define governance standards for increasingly integrated digital and non-digital patient support ecosystems. Recent governance discussions have emphasized the need to synchronize digital and non-digital patient service governance and clarify ownership across overlapping governance domains.

How you will contribute
- Establish, maintain, and evolve enterprise governance standards for Patient Services to ensure consistent quality, transparency, accountability, appropriate oversight, and compliance across markets.
- Define practical decision criteria and review tools that help teams determine whether an activity should follow PSP governance, diagnostic service governance, or another appropriate patient support governance pathway.
- Partner with SPD, MCE, LOC Patient Services leaders, and country organizations to establish governance frameworks that enable compliant local implementation of patient support solutions while maintaining alignment with enterprise standards, local patient journey requirements, evolving regulations, and global risk-management expectations.
- Define lifecycle governance expectations for Patient Services and PSPs, from concept/intake through review, approval, implementation readiness, monitoring, change management, and close-out or retirement, ensuring clear documentation and accountability at each stage.
- Translate governance expectations into usable operating materials, including intake questions, checklists, templates, documentation requirements, SOP/standard inputs, training materials, and knowledge-management resources.
- Enable consistent governance review by coordinating required functional input from Medical, Ethics & Compliance, Pharmacovigilance, Quality, Regulatory, Privacy, Legal, Digital/DD&T, Access, Procurement, Vendor Management, and local Medical teams where relevant, ensuring governance decisions appropriately reflect both enterprise risk considerations and local execution realities.
- Assess new, changing, or scaled Patient Services and related patient support activities to determine the appropriate governance pathway, required functional review, documentation expectations, and oversight needs.
- Maintain visibility of emerging patient support models across markets, identifying trends, common risks, and opportunities for harmonization, simplification, and scalable governance approaches that balance global consistency with necessary local flexibility.
- Define enterprise expectations for third-party governance in Patient Services and PSPs, including role clarity, qualification expectations, training, documentation, oversight, issue escalation, and performance visibility, while local or program owners remain accountable for vendor execution and day-to-day management.
- Provide governance advisory support for new, changing, or scaled patient support models, including launch-related PSPs, diagnostic services, access support, treatment-start services, and home care or monitoring models, while not owning asset strategy, launch execution, or local implementation.
- Build and maintain governance visibility for Patient Services and related patient solutions through inventories, repositories, documentation standards, review status tracking, issue visibility, follow-up actions, and leadership-ready summaries.
- Support audit readiness, governance reviews, risk assessments, gap analyses, remediation planning, issue escalation, and CAPA-related activities for Patient Services / PSP governance, in collaboration with the broader Medical Governance Office and relevant enterprise functions.
- Define and continuously evolve governance standards for digital patient services, including patient portals, digital adherence programs, remote monitoring solutions, patient applications, AI-enabled support capabilities, and other technology-enabled patient engagement models, ensuring responsible innovation while protecting patient safety, privacy, trust, and regulatory compliance.
- Bring responsible innovation by introducing reusable tools, digital intake and workflow solutions, governance automation, dashboards, analytics, AI-enabled oversight capabilities, and continuous-improvement practices that improve transparency, efficiency, risk visibility, and governance effectiveness without adding unnecessary bureaucracy.
- Represent the Medical Governance Office in relevant PSP, diagnostic services, patient support, vendor, data/digital, and cross-functional governance discussions, ensuring enterprise governance expectations are clearly understood and practically embedded.
- Capture and share learnings, best practices, and common market needs to strengthen the enterprise governance foundation.
- Serve as the primary Patient Services governance interface to Global Digital/DD&T for digital patient services, patient-facing technologies, digital health solutions, data-enabled support models, and emerging AI-enabled patient engagement capabilities, ensuring governance expectations are integrated across Medical, Quality, Regulatory, Privacy, Cybersecurity, and Digital functions.

Skills and qualifications
- Degree in life sciences, pharmacy, healthcare management, or related discipline preferred.
- 8+ years of experience in Medical Affairs, Patient Services / Patient Solutions, PSP governance, Medical Operations, Quality, Compliance, Risk Management, or related functions within biopharma or healthcare.
- Strong understanding of PSPs, Patient Services, diagnostic services, patient support models, patient journey needs, vendor-enabled healthcare services, and global/local execution realities.
- Experience developing or implementing governance frameworks, standards, SOPs, control models, risk assessments, audit-readiness activities, dashboards, or cross-functional operating models.
- Experience working across multiple countries, regions, or markets with varied maturity levels and regulatory environments preferred.

Competencies
- Ability to translate enterprise governance expectations into simple, usable tools and guidance that support local implementation without adding unnecessary complexity.
- Strong understanding of digital health ecosystems, patient-facing technologies, patient data governance, privacy requirements, platform governance, and emerging AI-enabled patient engagement capabilities.
- Strong governance, risk-based thinking, and systems-thinking capability, with the ability to convert complexity into practical enterprise standards and decision tools.
- Excellent cross-functional leadership, communication, influence, and stakeholder-management skills across cultures and seniority levels.

jobs.title: Nurse specialist in dementia care
jobs.description:
To primarily provide holistic, evidence-based best practice care to a private individual relating to all her needs in positive person-centred manner. These needs currently include having a diagnosis of dementia, age-related frailties and any other issues or health co-morbidities that may arise.

Essentially the post-holder will be required to:

- Assesses; plans, develops and implements programmes of care; provides advice; maintains associated records either manually or digitally;
- Carry out nursing procedures as required and in concordance with clinical guidelines;
- Provide clinical supervision to other staff.

The post holder will direct, coordinate and supervise, where appropriate, the work of other staff to promote best practice in relation to the care of the client with dementia. In the absence of the team leader, the post holder will provide cover to ensure effective delivery of care to the client. Any issues should be raised with the line manager.

QUALIFICATIONS / Essential requirements

- Swiss or EU passport (or Swiss working permit holder)
- Registered Nurse with valid NMC registration or European/Swiss equivalent.
- Nursing degree or equivalent.
- Best Practice in Dementia Training completion or working towards, ability to undertake this.
- Willingness to undergo specific dementia training ie Best Practice in Dementia Care, delivered in English.
- Additional qualifications in relation to dementia and dementia related topics including stress and distress training, meaningful activity, Sage and Thyme.
- Understanding of the Newcastle Model and/or PINCHME model of behaviour assessment.
- Willingness to develop dementia knowledge as part of CPD either independently or as provided by the Organisation.
- Specialist dementia qualification or additional studies in related areas.
- Understanding behaviour as a communication and good knowledge of non-pharmacological interventions and strategies.
- Experience in End of Life Care / Develop relevant clinical skills to address any developing co-morbidities and end-of-life care

QUALIFICATIONS / Additional requirements (may be utilised to benefit LHS)

- Moving and Handling Trainer
- Beauty/Massage Therapy
- Meaningful Activity

LANGUAGE / Essential

- Ability to communicate effectively using English.    English as first language (ideally mother tongue). Local dialect to client – Central Scotland.
- Excellent written communication in English.
- Due to the nature of FTL Dementia the language centres of the brain are affected. The inability to communicate effectively has a detrimental affect on LHS and their quality of life, increasing stress and distressed behaviour.

EXPERIENCE

Minimum 5 years’ experience working with people with dementia.
    
PERSONAL SKILLS AND ABILITIES

- Demonstrate excellent team working skills with the ability to work using own initiative.
- Effective listening, communication, and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to work with people and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
- Excellent time management skills.
- Working knowledge of basic technology.    
- Teaching skills for junior members of staff, family and other professionals.

SPECIFIC JOB REQUIREMENTS

- Being able to commit to working a shift pattern based in Buckinghamshire, UK and Switzerland for extended periods of time (preferably 10-14 days) / Necessity to travel with the client in UK.
- Unsociable hours are included this comes in the form of a sleepover arrangement alternating nights with another member of staff for the period of time ‘on shift’.
- May involve accompanying client to and from other venues as part of the duties.
- Be able to conduct and present themselves in a manner appropriate to the social standing of the client.
- Confidentiality must be always maintained both in line with NMC requirements as well as organisationally given the nature of the employer – a confidentiality agreement will be provided separately.
- Understanding the culture local to the client and family as dementia progresses earlier years are more prevalent and a lack of awareness or understanding can cause increased stress and distress which could lead to unnecessary pharmacological interventions.    
- Housekeeping is also a key aspect of this position.

Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

Dans le cadre de son développement, cette structure a fait appel à **l’expertise d’Alpia Recrutement SA** pour l’accompagner dans l’identification et le recrutement du professionnel qui occupera ce **poste stratégique au sein de son bureau technique**.

**Le dessin et la conception constituent le cœur du poste.** Selon votre expérience et vos aspirations, votre fonction pourra également comprendre la gestion technique, organisationnelle et financière des projets.

Vos missions : conception, dessin technique et suivi des réalisations
----------------------------------------------------------------------

* **Réaliser les plans d’ensemble, de détail, d’exécution, de fabrication et de montage**, à l’aide d’AutoCAD et des logiciels métiers utilisés par l’entreprise.
* Étudier les dossiers techniques, analyser les contraintes et développer des solutions adaptées aux ouvrages de **serrurerie, construction métallique et façades**.
* Préparer les dossiers nécessaires à la fabrication et à la pose : détails constructifs, nomenclatures, listes de matériaux et documents techniques.
* Assurer la coordination avec les architectes, les ingénieurs, le bureau technique, les fournisseurs, l’atelier et les équipes de montage.
* Participer au suivi des réalisations et veiller à la conformité des ouvrages, à la qualité d’exécution et au respect des délais.


**Pour les profils disposant d’une expérience en gestion de projet**, les responsabilités incluent également la planification, le suivi budgétaire, la préparation des offres, les consultations fournisseurs, les commandes et la relation client, jusqu’à la réception des travaux.

Votre profil
------------

* Vous disposez d’un **CFC de dessinateur\-constructeur sur métal**, d’une formation technique en construction métallique ou d’une qualification équivalente.
* Vous bénéficiez d’une expérience confirmée en **dessin technique, études ou gestion de projets**, dans la construction métallique, la serrurerie ou les façades.
* Vous maîtrisez le dessin assisté par ordinateur, notamment **AutoCAD** ou d'autres logiciels.
* Vous possédez une bonne compréhension des méthodes de fabrication, des assemblages et des contraintes de pose. La connaissance des normes suisses constitue un atout.
* Vous associez rigueur, autonomie et sens de l’organisation à un bon esprit d’équipe. Vous communiquez aisément en français avec les différents interlocuteurs du projet.


**Une expérience professionnelle en Suisse constitue un atout, mais n’est pas une exigence.** Ne pas avoir encore travaillé en Suisse ne représente en aucun cas un frein à votre candidature : nous porterons avant tout notre attention sur votre expertise métier, vos compétences techniques et votre motivation.

Un **brevet fédéral ou un diplôme fédéral en construction métallique** constitue un atout supplémentaire.

**Vous êtes avant tout dessinateur projeteur et souhaitez rester proche de la conception ?** Votre candidature nous intéresse également : le périmètre des responsabilités sera défini selon votre expérience et les besoins de l’entreprise.

Ce que notre partenaire vous offre
----------------------------------

* Un **poste fixe en CDI**, au sein d’une entreprise reconnue et solidement implantée sur le marché suisse de la construction métallique.
* Des projets variés en **construction métallique, serrurerie, façades et enveloppe du bâtiment**, alliant exigences techniques et qualité architecturale.
* Un environnement de travail structuré, avec une collaboration directe entre le bureau technique, les équipes de fabrication et les équipes de montage.
* Une autonomie adaptée à votre expérience, ainsi que des possibilités de formation et d’évolution technique ou vers la gestion de projets.


Parlons de votre prochain projet professionnel

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager Orthopaedics (Open)
jobs.description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more athttps://www.jnj.com/.



About Orthopaedics

Fueled by innovation at the intersection of biology and technology, we’re developing the next generation of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments.

Are you passionate about improving and expanding the possibilities of Orthopaedics? Ready to join a team that’s reimagining how we heal? Our Orthopaedics teams help keep more than 6 million people moving each year while delivering clinical and economic value to surgeons and healthcare systems. Our teams build solutions for joint reconstruction; trauma and craniomaxillofacial; sports, extremities, and elective foot and ankle; spine; and robotics and digital surgery.

Your unique talents will help patients on their journey to wellness. Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/medtech



Strategic Account Manager Orthopaedics - Johnson & Johnson

Western Part of Switzerland

Are you passionate about making a tangible difference in healthcare? Do you thrive on building strong relationships and driving growth? We are seeking a Senior Strategic Account Manager to join our sales team, drive market expansion, and deliver innovative surgical solutions to our customers. This role anchors Johnson & Johnson’s go-to-market strategy, emphasizing long-term partnerships and measurable value for patients. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to elevate customer outcomes and fuel sustainable business growth. If you’re a strategic thinker with a proven track record in key account management, we’d love to hear from you.



Responsibilities

Strategic Account Management is an essential part of the future business strategy for the Johnson & Johnson companies. It is how we will go to market as an Orthopaedics organization and will be critical to our future growth plans. With this approach to our non-clinical customers, we can demonstrate the long-term value of partnership and working with Johnson & Johnson, most importantly, our impact on patient care.

In the role as Strategic Account Manager you will report to the Lead of the Strategic Account Management for Orthopaedics and be responsible for developing mutually beneficial long-term partnerships with clinical and non-clinical partners in a given number of designated key accounts.

In conjunction with the Business Units, you will develop and lead the account strategy to drive additional profitable sales and market share growth within Hospital, Hospital Groups & Group Purchasing Organizations.

Together with the clinical team, you will coordinate and support the proposal development process, presenting opportunities and risks along with their implications to the required levels of management.

As key driver of our Value Based Health Care Strategy you will lead negotiations for commercial agreements and coordinate their execution across care centers, in collaboration with the Business Unit and Shared Functions (Pricing, Services & Solutions, HEMA, etc.).

You will be the representative of Johnson & Johnson Orthopaedics for the commercial partners in strategic accounts.



Qualifications

Master’s degree in Business Administration or relevant field is an advantage.

Several years of clinical experience in a Sales Manager or Key Account Manager role, with proven experience in managing non-clinical partnerships.

Deep understanding of the healthcare market and the local regulatory/policy environment; adept at identifying short-term and long-term factors impacting the business.

Experience in contract negotiations and deal structuring.

Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills in French to professionally represent Johnson & Johnson’s MedTech in the country; strong English skills (written and spoken) are required; proficiency in a second official language is preferred.

German language skills in writing and speaking are a plus.

Strong negotiation skills, high self-confidence, courage, and conviction.

Analytical and strategic thinker with solid business acumen.

Project management capabilities with the ability to lead complex initiatives involving multiple internal and external stakeholders.

Strong team spirit and collaborative mindset.



Johnson & Johnson announced plans to separate our Orthopaedics business to establish a standalone Orthopaedics company, operating as DePuy Synthes. The process of the planned separation is anticipated to be completed within 4 to 9 months, subject to legal requirements, including consultation with works councils and other employee representative bodies, as may be required, regulatory approvals and other customary conditions and approvals.

Should you accept this position, it is anticipated that, following conclusion of the transaction, you would be an employee of DePuy Synthes and your employment would be governed by DePuy Synthes employment processes, programs, policies, and benefit plans.In that case, details of any planned changes would be provided to you by DePuy Synthes at an appropriate time and subject to any necessary consultation processes.

NGS Scientist (single\-cell and spaital Omics)
==============================================







For our Client, a leading pharmaceutical company based in Basel, we are looking for a motivated NGS Scientist\-







Single\-cell and spatial omics technologies are transforming biomedical research by enabling deep characterization of complex biological systems at unprecedented resolution. These technologies provide critical insights into cellular heterogeneity, disease mechanisms, therapeutic responses, and translational biology.



We are seeking a highly motivated Scientist / Associate Scientist to join a cutting\-edge genomics platform team focused on single\-cell sequencing, spatial transcriptomics, and next\-generation sequencing (NGS) applications. The successful candidate will work at the interface of molecular biology, genomics, and translational research, supporting the development and implementation of innovative omics technologies that accelerate scientific discovery and therapeutic innovation.







Key Responsibilities



* Develop, optimize, and implement advanced NGS\-based workflows with a focus on:
* Single\-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA\-seq)
* Spatial transcriptomics
* Multi\-omics and multimodal profiling approaches
* Independently perform molecular biology experiments and troubleshoot complex workflows.
* Execute sample processing, nucleic acid extraction, PCR/qPCR, library preparation, sequencing, and quality control activities.
* Generate, analyze, and document experimental results with a high level of scientific rigor.
* Work with challenging sample types including FFPE tissues, primary samples, and low\-input materials.
* Collaborate closely with bioinformatics and cross\-functional research teams to interpret sequencing datasets and derive biological insights.
* Ensure generation of high\-quality, FAIR\-compliant data.
* Present scientific findings, protocols, and recommendations to internal stakeholders.
* Contribute to continuous innovation and enhancement of platform capabilities.






Required Qualifications



* Master's degree in Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Life Sciences, Genomics, or a related discipline.
* 1\-3 years of industry or relevant research experience in genomics or molecular biology.
* Hands\-on experience with Next\-Generation Sequencing (NGS) workflows.
* Strong expertise in:
* DNA/RNA extraction
* PCR and qPCR
* NGS library preparation
* Molecular biology laboratory techniques
* Experience handling clinical or challenging biological samples such as FFPE tissue, tumor specimens, or low\-input samples.
* Proven ability to independently design, execute, analyze, and troubleshoot experiments.
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary teams.
* Fluent English.






Preferred Qualifications



* Hands\-on experience with single\-cell sequencing platforms (e.g. 10x Genomics Chromium).
* Experience with spatial transcriptomics and spatial biology technologies (e.g. Visium, Xenium, CosMx, RNAscope).
* Knowledge of transcriptomics, genomics, and multi\-omics approaches.
* Experience with assay development, method optimization, and technology implementation.
* Familiarity with basic bioinformatics analyses and interpretation of sequencing datasets.
* Experience in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or translational research environment.






What We're Looking For



We are particularly interested in candidates who combine strong wet\-lab genomics expertise with a passion for emerging technologies such as single\-cell sequencing and spatial biology. Successful candidates are curious, innovative, collaborative, and excited about applying cutting\-edge omics technologies to advance translational research and therapeutic discovery.

jobs.title: PMO - Governance and Performance Consultant
jobs.description:
Ref 2582132 \| Date: 1 Oct 2026

![Michael Page]( )



We are seeking a **PMO** \-**Governance \& Performance Consultant** to support the enhancement of governance, operational performance, reporting, and process improvement initiatives within a complex international organization.



The role is for 9 months.





PMO \- Governance and Performance Consultant

Our client is an international organisation.

**Missions**



Governance \& Process Improvement  

* Support the review, documentation, and optimization of key business processes across multiple functions.
* Coordinate governance activities, monitor key actions and deadlines, and ensure appropriate stakeholder engagement.
* Produce process documentation, recommendations, and implementation plans to improve operational efficiency.
* Provide ad hoc analytical and project support to management teams.


Performance Management \& Reporting  

* Contribute to the enhancement and operationalization of performance measurement frameworks.
* Design and coordinate regular KPI collection, consolidation, and reporting processes.
* Develop management reporting materials, dashboards, and insights to support decision\-making.
* Monitor operational improvement initiatives and track associated business benefits.


Cost Analysis \& Operational Insights  

* Analyze organizational costs and spending trends.
* Collaborate with Finance and business stakeholders to improve reporting quality and visibility.
* Develop practical reporting methodologies and recommendations to support resource allocation decisions.
* Create sustainable reporting tools that can be maintained over time.


Contract \& Data Governance  

* Review and improve the quality of contract and vendor\-related data.
* Establish processes to monitor upcoming renewals and support proactive planning.
* Ensure governance mechanisms are in place to maintain accurate and reliable information



**Profil du candidat**

* Proven experience in **PMO, consulting, transformation, operational excellence, business performance, or governance\-related roles**.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience producing dashboards, KPIs, management reporting, and decision\-support materials.
* Strong process mapping, documentation, and project coordination capabilities.
* Ability to work autonomously in a complex, international, matrix environment.
* Experience within a **consulting firm (Big Four, management consulting, transformation advisory, or similar)** would be particularly valued.
* Exposure to international organizations, public sector, NGOs, or large multinational environments is an advantage.




**Conditions et Avantages**

9 months of temporary mission.

jobs.title: Global Merchandising Head Of Lifestyle & Special Projects
jobs.description:
In short
As the Global Merchandising Head Of Lifestyle & Special Projects, you will shape and drive the Global Merchandising strategy across On’s Lifestyle portfolio, spanning both Lifestyle Footwear and Special Projects across Footwear, Apparel and Accessories.
You will own the global range architecture, consumer proposition and tailored assortments, ensuring On delivers the right product, to the right consumer, in the right channel, at the right time and at the right price.
At the heart of this role is creating consumer desirability and brand heat while building a sustainable and scalable Lifestyle business. You will translate On’s global brand and product strategy into compelling assortments that balance commercial performance with premium brand positioning.
You will bring a strong point of view on consumer, product, channel and market opportunity, influencing product briefs and franchise strategies from the earliest stages of development through to seasonal execution and sell-through.
For Special Projects, you will apply the same commercial and consumer lens to build high-impact, culturally relevant and strategically important product stories, using controlled distribution, scarcity and tailored assortments to create demand and strengthen On’s premium positioning.
You will partner closely with Product, Design, Innovation, Brand, Regional Merchandising, Partnership Management, VM and Global and Regional Sales to ensure consumer and market insights translate into differentiated product strategies, global range architecture and commercially successful assortments.

Your mission
Build the Global Lifestyle Merchandising Strategy
- Define and evolve the global merchandising strategy for Lifestyle and Special Projects, translating On’s broader brand and product priorities into clear consumer and commercial strategies.
- Build the global range architecture ensuring an efficient yet compelling Lifestyle proposition.
- Identify opportunities to expand Lifestyle into new consumer segments, channels and categories while protecting On’s premium positioning.
- Develop clear merchandising frameworks that balance consumer desirability, brand heat, commercial opportunity and sustainable profitability.

Drive Product & Franchise Strategy
- Influence product briefs and franchise strategies from concept through to commercialization, ensuring products are rooted in clear consumer and market opportunities.
- Establish clear roles for hero, core, growth and incubation franchises, ensuring the portfolio evolves with consumer demand.
- Identify when franchises should be scaled, reset, repositioned or exited based on consumer and commercial signals.

Own Global Range & Assortment Excellence
- Build seasonal range plans across Lifestyle and Special Projects, translating global strategy into detailed SKU-level line plans.
- Build consumer-right tailored channel assortments globally, balancing global consistency with regional and account-specific opportunities.
- Provide a clear point of view on product flow, colour needs, depth, price and channel distribution to maximize seasonal performance.
- Ensure global and regional teams are aligned on the range strategy while allowing appropriate market localization.

Lead Special Projects
- Own the global merchandising strategy for Special Projects, working project-by-project to define the consumer proposition, range, targets, distribution and commercial strategy.
- Develop clear scarcity and allocation frameworks to balance brand heat with commercial opportunity.
- Partner closely with Product, Design and Brand to bring strategically important innovations and collaborations to market.
- Ensure Special Projects acts as an incubator for future Lifestyle franchises, consumer insights and new business opportunities.
- Set sell-through, volume, NS and productivity targets and ensure the range is structured to deliver against them.

Drive Commercial Performance
- Own global seasonal targets and commercial KPIs across Lifestyle and Special Projects.
- Identify commercial risks and opportunities early and drive cross-functional actions to address them.
- Use performance data, consumer signals and market intelligence to continuously refine the global range strategy.

Your story
- 8+ years of experience within premium sportswear, luxury fashion or streetwear with significant experience owning global or multi-market businesses.
- Strong people leader with the ability to build, develop and inspire a high-performing global merchandising team.
- Proven track record of building global merchandising strategies and commercial plans across multiple channels and markets.
- Deep understanding of Lifestyle and sneaker culture, with a strong instinct for what will create consumer relevance and brand heat.
- Commercially strong, with the ability to balance brand aspiration, consumer desirability and financial performance.
- Highly comfortable operating in a fast-paced, matrixed global environment, with strong executive presence and the ability to influence senior stakeholders.
- A strategic thinker who can move seamlessly between 5-year vision and SKU-level detail.
- Exceptional relationship builder who can connect Product, Design, Innovation, Brand, Merchandising, Sales and Regional teams around a common consumer and commercial ambition.
- A resilient, entrepreneurial leader who thrives in ambiguity, embraces change and proactively builds solutions in a high-growth environment.
- Data-led but consumer obsessed, able to combine quantitative insights with strong product and cultural intuition.

Meet the team
On’s Global Merchandising Team sits at the center of Product, Brand and Commercial Strategy, ensuring we create and deliver the right product to the right consumer, in the right market, at the right time and at the right scale.
As the Global Merchandising Head of Lifestyle (Inline) & Special Projects, you will lead the merchandising strategy for one of On’s key future growth opportunities, working across global and regional teams to build a consumer-led, commercially sustainable and culturally relevant Lifestyle business.
You will be a key voice in shaping not only what we sell, but where On plays, how we build demand and how we scale the Lifestyle business globally

Program Manager
===============

Lead a high\-impact Group IT transformation program, driving application rationalization, technology simplification and cost optimization while ensuring initiatives translate into measurable and sustainable business value.

Program Manager
===============

### description:

We are looking for a **Senior IT Transformation \& Cost Optimization Program Manager** to coordinate and govern a portfolio of strategic initiatives across Group IT.

Working closely with IT leadership, Product Managers, technical SMEs, Finance, Procurement and external technology partners, you will ensure that transformation initiatives are structured, executed and tracked against clearly defined financial and operational outcomes.

This is a program leadership and coordination role rather than a hands\-on technical position. It requires someone who can operate comfortably between technology, finance and senior management, bringing structure, visibility and momentum to a complex transformation agenda.

* Define, maintain and coordinate the execution of the Group IT transformation and cost\-optimization roadmap.
* Support the development of the future IT run\-cost baseline and target operating\-cost model.
* Establish program governance, KPIs and reporting mechanisms to monitor savings, cost avoidance and value realization.
* Coordinate transformation initiatives across multiple IT domains, ensuring effective management of milestones, dependencies, risks, actions and key decisions.
* Work closely with Product Managers and technical SMEs to ensure required technical and business inputs are delivered on time.
* Coordinate application portfolio discovery and rationalization activities, assessing applications for retention, retirement, replacement, consolidation or modernization.
* Drive coordination of cost\-optimization initiatives across applications, infrastructure, cloud and IT operations.
* Track the implementation and financial realization of approved optimization initiatives.
* Coordinate technical and operational contributions to supplier transformation initiatives, service\-provider reviews and supplier assessments.
* Identify and track opportunities linked to automation, AI, technology modernization and simplification.
* Maintain alignment across senior stakeholders and provide clear program\-level reporting to Group IT leadership


### About the customer:

Our client is a well\-established international industrial technology group, with a strong global footprint and complex enterprise IT environment. As part of an ongoing Group\-wide transformation, the organization is strengthening its technology operating model, simplifying its application landscape and optimizing IT costs across applications, infrastructure, cloud and external service providers.

### Requirements:

* Significant experience leading **IT transformation, technology optimization or complex IT programs** within a large enterprise environment.
* Strong understanding of enterprise IT operating models, application landscapes, infrastructure and cloud environments.
* Demonstrated experience in **application portfolio rationalization**, technology simplification and/or IT cost optimization.
* Strong financial and analytical skills, including experience with cost baselines, business cases, savings tracking, benefits realization and KPI reporting.
* Proven ability to coordinate senior IT stakeholders, Product Managers, architects, technical SMEs and business functions.
* Experience working with major technology vendors, outsourcing partners and managed\-service providers.
* Strong program governance skills, with the ability to manage interdependencies, risks, actions and executive\-level reporting.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical and financial topics into clear management\-level messages.
* Comfortable operating in a highly cross\-functional and international environment.

Global Clinical Distribution Lead
=================================

Working within a global clinical supply chain team, you will manage end\-to\-end distribution activities for a portfolio of clinical studies. Your…

Global Clinical Distribution Lead
=================================

### description:

Working within a global clinical supply chain team, you will manage end\-to\-end distribution activities for a portfolio of clinical studies. Your responsibilities will cover the deployment of clinical inventory across an international depot network, from technical release through importation and delivery to depots and clinical sites.

### About the customer:

Swisslinx is seeking a Global Clinical Distribution Lead on behalf of an international pharmaceutical company. This role offers the opportunity to support a diverse clinical development portfolio, helping ensure investigational medicines reach clinical trial sites and patients on time.

### Requirements:

* Manage on\-time delivery of shipments across the distribution network to meet study requirements and patient demand.
* Represent clinical distribution in cross\-functional study and supply execution teams.
* Resolve operational and system issues affecting delivery performance, working with internal stakeholders and external providers.
* Coordinate depot replenishment with clinical demand and supply planning teams.
* Lead and contribute to distribution projects and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Maintain accurate records in clinical supply systems and perform first\- and second\-level troubleshooting.
* Work within a GMP\-compliant environment and follow established quality procedures.
* Process quality incidents, corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), and change controls, where applicable.


### Compensation benefits:

* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Business, Operations Management, Supply Chain Management, Biotechnology or a related field.
* At least three years of experience in clinical trial management, logistics, warehouse management or another supply chain discipline, preferably within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
* Strong working knowledge of SAP or comparable ERP systems.
* Experience working in cross\-functional, international teams and agile organisational environments.
* Fluency in English, with strong communication and active listening skills.
* An action\-oriented approach and the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to manage complex situations independently.
* The ability to prioritise multiple tasks while maintaining accuracy.
* A collaborative mindset and a commitment to continuous learning and process improvement.


Experience with clinical supply management systems, quality management platforms, Microsoft Office and Google Workspace would be beneficial. Operational Excellence, Six Sigma or training, and APICS or SCOR certification, are also advantageous.

jobs.title: ASSISTANT COMMERCIAL EN ALTERNANCE (H/F)
jobs.description:
La Ferme d'Anchin : une aventure gourmande et engagée depuis 1993
Née à Liévin, dans le Nord de la France, La Ferme d'Anchin est une entreprise familiale qui a su transformer une simple passion pour les recettes traditionnelles en une succès story agroalimentaire. Spécialisée dans la fabrication de soupes fraîches, bio et de qualité, l'entreprise s'est imposée comme un acteur incontournable du rayon frais, proposant aujourd'hui plus de 27 recettes authentiques, proches du fait maison.
Un environnement de travail dynamique et humain
Rejoindre La Ferme d'Anchin, c'est intégrer une équipe soudée, porteuse de valeurs fortes : authenticité, innovation et convivialité. C'est aussi l'opportunité de contribuer à une aventure collective, où chaque talent compte pour faire grandir la marque en France et à l'international.
En avril 2026, La Ferme d'Anchin a rejoint le groupe italien La Linea Verde, leader européen des salades en sachets et des plats prêts à consommer, via sa filiale française La Ligne Verte. Ce rachat stratégique marque le début d'une nouvelle ère pour l'entreprise, avec l'ambition affichée de relancer durablement la marque sur le marché français et européen. Fort de son expertise et de sa vision long terme, La Linea Verde souhaite valoriser le savoir-faire artisanal et l'identité locale de La Ferme d'Anchin, tout en renforçant son positionnement haut de gamme et son innovation produit. Avec une quote-part de 48 % du marché des soupes fraîches en France, l'entreprise dispose désormais de ressources accrues pour accélérer sa croissance, développer de nouvelles gammes et conquérir de nouveaux marchés, tout en préservant les valeurs qui ont fait son succès : authenticité, qualité et proximité. Rejoindre La Ferme d'Anchin aujourd'hui, c'est participer à un projet ambitieux, porté par un groupe international tout en gardant l'âme d'une entreprise familiale et engagée

Dans le cadre de son développement, la Ferme d'Anchin cherche un(e) Chef(fe) de secteur GMS en en alternance sur la zone AIX EN PROVENCE / MONACO (lieu d'habitation souhaité Toulon/Fréjus)
Rythme souhaité. 3 semaine entreprise / 1 semaine école


Voici tes missions :
- Tu gères en autonomie un parc de supermarchés et hypermarchés (SUD-EST) dans lesquels tu assures une visibilité optimale pour nos marques partenaires. Plus précisément :
- Tu assures la présence permanente de nos produits, tu références les nouveautés ;
- Tu optimises leur implantation en linéaire pour qu'ils soient bien visibles ;
- Tu négocies et mets en œuvre les actions d'extra visibilité et de manière générale tu saisis toutes les opportunités qui nous permettront de dynamiser notre business ;
- Tu partages tes best-practices avec tes collègues, tu remontes les informations sur nos clients ; nos concurrents,
- Tu as le permis B
- Tu es force de proposition et de recommandation pour faire plus et mieux.
De formation supérieure Bac+2 à Bac+5, tu es à la recherche d'un stage dans une entreprise en pleine croissance, offrant des challenges nombreux et passionnants :
Avant tout :
- Tu te reconnais dans la marque : travailler pour des produits bons, beaux, sains
et responsables est important pour toi.
- Tu es quelqu'un de sympa, souriant, positif, tu as de l'énergie à revendre, tu aimes travailler en équipe et êtes connu comme étant un très bon 'team player'.
- Tu es un 'super commercial' : tu es reconnu pour ton abnégation et ta culture du résultat, tu ne lâches jamais, tu sais te donner les moyens d'être convaincant.
- Tu es un entrepreneur dans l'âme : tu es travailleur et courageux, tu sais détecter les opportunités et les transformer en plans d'actions, tu es curieux et aimes tenter des nouvelles approches.
- Tu es curieux, as un niveau d'empathie au-delà de la moyenne, et les gens qui t'entourent saluent ta capacité ++ à créer du lien, socialiser.

jobs.title: Miljømedarbeidere som bidrar til et trygt og godt læringsmiljø
jobs.description:
Blommenholm skoles visjon er «Glede gjennom mestring», og vårt slagord er «Vi er ulike, men vi passer SAMMEN». Våre verdier er samarbeid, ansvar, mangfold, medvirkning, empati og nysgjerrighet. Vi søker deg som ønsker å bidra aktivt til at disse verdiene preger elevenes hverdag.

Blommenholm skole har 306 elever fordelt på 1.-7. trinn og rundt 45 ansatte. Personalet består av ledelse, fag- og kontaktlærere, spesialpedagoger og miljøarbeidere i skole og SFO. Ledelsen består av rektor og to avdelingsledere. Skolen ligger sentralt til i umiddelbar nærhet til E18, Sandvika og Blommenholm stasjon, noe som gir gode pendlingsmuligheter fra blant annet Oslo og Drammen.

Vi søker engasjerte og relasjonssterke miljømedarbeidere som er faglig bevisste, fleksible og opptatt av å styrke elevenes sosiale kompetanse. Du har et positivt elev- og læringssyn og ser betydningen av gode relasjoner som grunnlag for trivsel, utvikling og læring. Hos oss står fellesskapende didaktikk sentralt, og vi arbeider målrettet for å flytte fokus fra individ til fellesskap. Alle elever skal oppleve tilhørighet, mestring og inkludering. Derfor verdsetter vi medarbeidere som er gode lagspillere og som bidrar positivt til fellesskapet.

Vi tilbyr et inkluderende og godt arbeidsmiljø preget av engasjement, raushet og samarbeid. Hos oss møter du kollegaer som støtter, oppmuntrer og lærer av hverandre. Vi har et stabilt personale, en sterk delingskultur og et profesjonelt fellesskap der utvikling står i sentrum. Skolen arbeider systematisk med elevenes læringsmiljø i tett samarbeid med engasjerte foresatte. Vi har et etablert ressursteam med flere spesialpedagoger, et miljøteam og et godt SFO-tilbud med erfarne og stabile medarbeidere.
Vi har ledig inntil fem faste stillinger som miljømedarbeider.

Vi ser etter deg som bygger gode relasjoner til barn og voksne, og som ser muligheter og potensial i hvert enkelt barn. Du bidrar til å vekke lærelyst, skape trygghet og fremme mestring. Gjennom ditt arbeid er du med på å gjøre elevene rustet til å møte både skolehverdagen og livet videre. Du møter barn med respekt, omsorg og tydelige forventninger, og du verdsetter mangfold og ulikhet som en styrke. Samtidig samarbeider du godt med kollegaer, foresatte og andre samarbeidspartnere.

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg som ønsker å gjøre en positiv forskjell for barn og unge, og som vil være med på å skape et trygt, inkluderende og utviklende læringsmiljø på Blommenholm skole.

Stillingene følger lærernes arbeidsår (39 uker), og lønn utbetales derfor med 89 %.


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Legge til rette for et trygt, godt og inkluderende læringsmiljø
  • Bidra til et godt samarbeid
  • Sørge for et trygt, godt og inkluderende skolemiljø
  • Delta og bidra i et lærende fellesskap i skolen
  • Ta aktivt del i aktiviteter med barna, både ute og inne
  • Legge til rette for at barn og foreldre opplever trygghet, omsorg og trivsel
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Fagbrev barn og unge er en fordel, men ikke et krav
  • Du har arbeidet med barn tidligere eller har erfaring fra tilrettelegging av fritidsaktiviteter for barn
  • For stillingen kreves gode norskkunnskaper. Søkere fra land utenfor Skandinavia skal som et minimum ha bestått norskprøve B1 skriftlig og muntlig
Personlige egenskaper

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Er en trygg, varm og tydelig voksen som skaper gode relasjoner til barn og unge
  • Har et positivt elevsyn og møter alle elever med respekt, omsorg og høye forventninger
  • Er relasjonssterk og evner å bygge tillit hos både elever, foresatte og kollegaer
  • Er tålmodig, robust og rolig i møte med utfordrende situasjoner
  • Har gode samarbeidsevner og bidrar aktivt til et positivt arbeidsmiljø
  • Er fleksibel og løsningsorientert i en variert og til tider uforutsigbar arbeidshverdag
  • Har evne til å se den enkelte elev samtidig som du ivaretar fellesskapet
  • Er initiativrik og tar ansvar for å skape inkluderende aktiviteter og gode læringsarenaer
  • Er bevisst rollen som voksenmodell og fremmer trygghet, trivsel og mestring
  • Har god forståelse for barns ulike behov og verdsetter mangfold som en styrke
  • Kan arbeide målrettet med sosial kompetanse, inkludering og forebygging av utenforskap
  • Bidrar til et profesjonelt fellesskap preget av åpenhet, refleksjon og utvikling
Vi vil legge stor vekt på personlig egnethet. Du er en lagspiller som ser verdien av fellesskapet, og som hver dag arbeider for at alle elever skal oppleve tilhørighet, trygghet og mestring.
Vi tilbyr
  • Varierte arbeidsdager
  • Et raust og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø
  • Medbestemmelse og medansvar
  • Påfyll og kurs
  • Mulighet for kompetanseutviklingsstipend
  • Offentlig tjenestepensjon

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sammen skaper vi et godt og inkluderende samfunn for over 130 000 innbyggere, både i dag og i årene som kommer. Vi skaper rammer som bidrar til at de aller minste kan leke og lære og at de som trenger en hjelpende hånd får en hverdag preget av mestring, mening og verdighet. Vi gjør et bredt spekter av arbeidsoppgaver, og felles for oss alle er at vi får tillit og myndighet til å påvirke vår egen arbeidshverdag for å skape et samfunn som er godt å leve i. Hos oss kan du bli med og sette spor.
