jobs.title: Sternöskolan söker en lärare till mellanstadiet, åk 4-6
jobs.description:
I början av vårterminen 2027 går en av våra kollegor på föräldraledighet. Eftersom vi vill ge både elever och arbetslag de allra bästa förutsättningarna är vi ute i god tid med att rekrytera en ersättare.

Söker du ett sammanhang där elevernas lärande och trygghet är i fokus? Hos oss blir du en del av ett engagerat team där ni utvecklas och växer tillsammans.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Arbetsuppgifter

Du ingår i ett arbetslag som planerar, genomför, utvärderar och utvecklar verksamheten utifrån läroplanen. Du har ansvar för undervisningen på mellanstadiet tillsammans med en mentorskollega.

Tillsammans med arbetslaget har du ansvar för:

    att skapa och utveckla en trygg miljö som lockar och utmanar elevernas utveckling, inflytande och lärande
    att förbereda, utvärdera och dokumentera verksamheten
    att utveckla en god relation till eleverna och deras vårdnadshavare
    att stödja och inspirera eleverna till att nå uppsatta mål

Krav för tjänsten:

    Legitimerad grundskollärare åk 4-6

Meriterande för tjänsten:

    Erfarenhet att arbeta med flerspråkiga elever
    Erfarenhet av att arbeta åldersblandat
    Erfarenhet av att ha arbetat i grundskolan i åk 4-6

Egenskaper:

Du har lätt för att samarbeta med andra, kunna ta egna initiativ, ha ett bra bemötande och förhållningssätt samt förmåga att utveckla verksamheten. Stor hänsyn tas till personlig lämplighet.



Om arbetsplatsen

Sternöskolan är den lilla, enparallelliga skolan i innerstaden med cirka 120 elever från förskoleklass till åk 6 och två fritidsavdelningar. Skolan är vackert belägen uppe på natursköna Hinseberg i centrala Karlshamn. Hos oss innebär det mindre formatet en stor trygghet där vi känner alla elever. Vi arbetar utifrån ett relationellt perspektiv med elevernas behov och förutsättningar i centrum, där ett språkutvecklande arbetssätt genomsyrar undervisningen och flerspråkighet ses som en tillgång.

Information om tjänsten

    Anställningsform: Ferietjänst, vikariat under Vt 2027 med möjlighet till förlängning
    Omfattning: 100%
    Antal tjänster: 1
    Tillträde: 2027-01-08 (eller enligt överenskommelse)
    Sista ansökningsdag: 2026-10-18

Övrigt:

Enligt Skollagen (2010:800) skall den som erbjuds denna anställning visa upp ett utdrag ur belastningsregistret. Ni beställer ert belastningsregister på polisens hemsida, utdraget ni ska begära är det som gäller arbete i skola eller förskola.

Som arbetsgivare behöver vi kontrollera rätten att arbeta i Sverige, därmed behöver du vid eventuell intervju visa upp id-handling som styrker medborgarskap: pass eller nationellt id-kort är exempel på sådan handling.

Tjänsten tillsätts under förutsättning att erforderliga beslut fattas.

För mer information kontakta:

Malin Granqvist, rektor, 0454- 30 76 02

Sveriges Lärare, 0454-811 86, karlshamn@sverigeslarare.se

Besök gärna https://www.karlshamn.se/rekrytering för att få information om ingångslöner och bestämmelser om gällande kollektivavtal samt om vad som gäller dig som har skyddade personuppgifter, hur vi kontrollerar rätten att arbeta i Sverige, när du behöver och hur du beställer ett utdrag ur belastningsregistret.

För att kvalitetssäkra rekryteringsprocessen samt möjliggöra god kommunikation med våra sökande ber vi dig ansöka via knappen i annonsen. En ansökan till Karlshamns kommun är en allmän handling.

jobs.title: (Senior) Data Engineer (Snowflake) – Building and Technical Trade, K Group
jobs.description:
Snowflake is becoming the foundation of Building and Technical Trade's future data ecosystem. As a (Senior) Data Engineer, you'll help define how data is modelled, built and utilized across analytics, AI and business development. Rather than joining a fully established environment, you'll have a rare opportunity to influence the development practices, data models and technical standards that will shape our future data platform. We are open to candidates from experienced Data Engineer to Senior Data Engineer level. The exact scope and level of responsibility can be shaped based on your background and expertise.

You will work as part of Kesko's Central Data & Analytics Platforms team while collaborating closely with Building and Technical Trade's Data, AI and ESG team. Together with BI analysts, analytics engineers, data experts and business stakeholders, you'll turn business needs into scalable and reliable data solutions that support both daily decision-making and future growth. We are working in a hybrid workplace model where we combine office days at K Kampus in Kalasatama and remote work to best suit both the role and the team. Come and join our professional team and start building your own kind of career in K Group!

What is the role about?

As a (Senior) Data Engineer, you will be a key data expert helping BTT build a modern Snowflake-based data foundation for analytics, AI and business development. This is a hands-on senior role with strong architectural influence: you will help shape how Snowflake development is done in BTT, while working closely with the BTT Data, AI and ESG team and Keskos central data platform experts. In addition to building solutions, you will help grow the teams Snowflake capabilities through collaboration, mentoring and practical examples.

Your key responsibilities include:
- Technical ownership: owning the technical direction of BTTs Snowflake solutions and ensuring that solutions are reliable, maintainable and aligned with agreed platform principles - Best practices and architecture: defining BTTs Snowflake development practices, including modelling approach, warehouse strategy, documentation, quality and maintainability, while contributing to the broader data architecture and innovation - Mentoring and collaborating: coaching BTT data team members towards stronger Snowflake competence, collaborating with BI analysts, analytics engineers and business stakeholders, and translating business needs into practical data solutions - Building solutions: designing, building and optimizing scalable dbt-based data pipelines, transformations and logical and physical data models



Who are we looking for?

We are looking for an experienced data engineer who enjoys hands-on building but also thinks about the bigger picture, and who genuinely wants to help others grow.

We are not looking for unicorns, but the more of below capabilities are found the better youd fit to the ideal candidate profile:
- Snowflake, dbt and SQL: strong hands-on experience in data engineering with Snowflake, proficiency with dbt for transformations, efficient SQL skills and solid data modelling capability. (This one is actually mandatory) - Modern engineering practices: experience with version control, CI/CD pipelines and a DevOps mindset in a data context; what we develop, we also support. - Background in data warehousing/ETL: You have designed or maintained data pipelines with different technologies. Experience with SAP BW data models and transformations is beneficial, as it helps in understanding our legacy environment. - Data management mindset: Familiarity with data cataloging, lineage tools, semantic views, or overall data governance frameworks. You care about documentation and data quality. - Big picture view: the ability to make sound technical choices across source data, data modelling, transformations and reporting needs, not just build individual pipelines. - Mentoring ability: experience and motivation in sharing knowledge, supporting colleagues and contributing to the development of data engineering practices - AI mindset: interest in leveraging AI to speed up and improve development and maintenance processes - Communication: excellent teamwork and communication skills, and the ability to explain complex data topics to both technical and non-technical colleagues. Fluency in English is required (our working language). Finnish or other Nordic language skills are beneficial but not necessary. - Self-driven and proactive attitude: You take initiative to improve things and arent afraid to suggest new ideas. You are solution-oriented and able to work independently when needed, but also know when to ask for help or input. - Relevant experience with SAP, Aspect4 or web-based business application data as well as familiarity with chain-operated wholesale and/or merchant-led retail business models, especially in the building and technical trade sector










Please note that the role is in Finland and you will need the existing right to work here. Kesko is unable to sponsor work permits or visas.

Why join us?

We offer you the chance to work in a key role, building a modern data platform in a large and diverse organization. Rather than stepping into a fully established environment, you'll have a rare opportunity to help define the development standards, modelling principles and engineering practices that will shape how BTT utilizes Keskos Snowflake platform.

With us you get:
- a genuinely impactful, hands-on role in building our Snowflake data platform from the ground up - a supportive community of expert colleagues in both BTT and Keskos central data teams - the opportunity to influence the technical direction, best practices and ways of working of our future data platform - modern work tools and numerous opportunities to learn, develop and grow your career in a large, international organization - extensive K Group employee benefits, including a mobile-phone benefit, culture, well-being and sports benefit (ePassi Flex), staff discounts in K Group stores, own occupational health care, leisure-time accident insurance, and a car benefit according to our company policy. - partner benefits related to optical stores, accommodation and travel, as well as sports and wellbeing services - a flexible hybrid working model with at least one office day per week

jobs.title: Er du vår neste Assisterende restaurantsjef – med ønske om å vokse sammen med oss?
jobs.description:
Brennende opptatt av god service, vertskap, mat og vin? Vi ser etter deg som vil være med å lede driften i dag, og som på sikt ønsker å ta enda mer ansvar.

 

Vi søker en engasjert, strukturert og tilstedeværende assisterende restaurantsjef til teamet på Biologen Herdla. Hos oss blir en sentral oppgave å bidra til at gjestene skal føle seg ivaretatt og velkomne fra første stund.

Dette er en fantastisk mulighet for deg som trives i en operativ lederrolle på gulvet, men som samtidig har lyst til å utvikle deg videre. For den rette personen er vi opptatt av å legge til rette for faglig vekst, med gode muligheter for å ta mer overordnet ansvar etter hvert.

Om Biologen Herdla

Biologen Herdla ligger idyllisk til helt ytterst på Askøy, omkranset av storslått natur og med panoramautsikt over Hjeltefjorden og Herdlefjorden. Vår historie strekker seg tilbake til tiden som marinbiologisk forskningsstasjon, og i dag driver vi et varmt, personlig og stemningsfylt boutique hotell.

 

Hos oss forenes den unike kysthistorien med førsteklasses mat- og vinopplevelser. Vi brenner for lokale råvarer, et nøye sammensatt vinkart og det ekte, rause vestlandske vertskapet. Å jobbe her betyr lavere skuldre, spektakulære omgivelser og en hverdag fylt med matglede, spennende gjester og fantastiske kolleger.

Din rolle som assisterende restaurantsjef

I det daglige vil du jobbe tett sammen med daglig leder og kjøkkenet for å skape magiske øyeblikk for gjestene og en trygg, inspirerende hverdag for teamet.

 

Sentrale oppgaver:

  • Være til stede i driften: Spre trygghet, god energi og passe på at servicen flyter sømløst i sal og restaurant.
  • Det gode vertskapet: Bidra til at alle som besøker oss møtes med varme, faglig tyngde og kvalitet i alle ledd.
  • Kvalitet og detaljer: Være opptatt av de små og store detaljene som gjør at vi leverer topp kvalitet i alle ledd.
  • Daglig tilrettelegging og økonomi: Hjelpe til med vaktlister, varebestillinger, gode rutiner, dagsoppgjør og være delaktig i månedsavslutninger med varetelling.
  • Innspill og utvikling: Være med å forme meny-, vin- og drikkekonsepter, samt planlegge selskaper og arrangementer sammen med resten av lederteamet.
  • Spille laget godt: Møte hver dag med godt humør og entusiasme, og løfte teamet i samme retning mot felles mål.
Hvem ser vi etter?

Du har gjerne erfaring fra restaurant, hotell eller servering, enten som hovmester, skiftleder eller som en erfaren servitør som føler seg klar for å ta neste steg inn i lederrollen.

 

Vi tror du vil trives hos oss om du:

  • Har et brennende hjerte for god service, god mat og spennende vin.
  • Har god tall- og økonomiforståelse, med blikk for struktur i driften.
  • Er en utpreget lagspiller som leder gjennom nærvær, humør og god kommunikasjon.
  • Er ryddig og strukturert, men takler at det koker litt i helgene med et smil.
  • Drivs av å begeistre gjesten og skape de beste opplevelsene.
  • Ønsker å lære mer, bygge karriere over tid og vokse i faget sammen med oss.
  • Har tilgang på bil (en fordel med tanke på beliggenhet og arbeidstider).
  • Har gode norskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig – da en viktig del av hverdagen handler om tett dialog med våre norske gjester, opplæring av teamet og enkelte administrative oppgaver.
Hva vi tilbyr
  • En unik, spennende og sentral lederstilling på et av Askøys vakreste steder.
  • Tydelige utviklingsmuligheter: Et uformelt og raust miljø hvor vi satser på folkene våre og heier fram intern karrierebygging.
  • Faglig påfyll innen vertskap, ledelse og vinkunnskap (inkludert tilgang til vår egen vinkjeller).
  • Stor frihet til å komme med egne idéer og være med på å forme konseptet videre.
  • Et inkluderende, engasjert og sosialt kollegium hvor vi løfter i flokk.
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser etter avtale.
Klar for å bli en del av laget på Herdla?

Er du nysgjerrig på rollen, ønsker mer informasjon om mulighetene hos Biologen Herdla, eller bare vil ta en helt uforpliktende prat? Da hører vi veldig gjerne fra deg!

 

Send inn din CV og en kort tekst om deg selv, eller ta direkte kontakt med vår rekrutteringspartner i Randstad.

 

Camilla Johnsen Vågstøl, Seniorrådgiver, Randstad, E-post: camilla.vagstol@randstad.no

 

Vi vurderer søknader fortløpende og gleder oss til å bli kjent med deg!

 

 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

BIOLOGEN DRIFT AS

Biologen Herdla er et unikt boutique-hotell og serveringssted idyllisk plassert helt ytterst på Askøy, med panoramautsikt over Hjeltefjorden. Stedets historie går tilbake til 1920-tallet som marinbiologisk forskningsstasjon.

I dag forener vi denne historiske sjarmen med førsteklasses mat- og vinopplevelser, kurs- og konferansefasiliteter og ekte vestlandsk vertskap. Vi brenner for lokale råvarer, god vin og uforglemmelige opplevelser for våre gjester. Hos Biologen får du et engasjert, uformelt og sosialt arbeidsmiljø hvor faglig kvalitet, matglede og samhold står i sentrum.

jobs.title: Trygg och erfaren personlig assistent sökes till pojke med Autism - Kungälv
jobs.description:
Trygg och erfaren personlig assistent sökes till pojke med autism

Vill du ha ett meningsfullt arbete där ditt lugn, din lyhördhet och din förmåga att skapa trygghet gör verklig skillnad? Primacura söker nu en erfaren kvinnlig personlig assistent till en pojke med autism.
Han kommunicerar inte med tal och behöver en assistent som kan tolka hans signaler, arbeta förebyggande och skapa en trygg och förutsägbar vardag.

Om uppdraget
Du blir ett viktigt stöd efter skoldagen och under eftermiddagar och kvällar. Pojken kan reagera kraftfullt vid frustration, vilket kan innebära utmanande beteenden eller att han försöker lämna situationen. Därför behöver du vara trygg, uppmärksam och handlingskraftig, med ett lugnt och lågaffektivt bemötande.

Arbetet innebär att:
● skapa struktur och förutsägbarhet
● läsa av kroppsspråk och andra signaler
● förebygga och hantera utmanande situationer
● vägleda med tydlighet och respekt
● bygga en trygg och långsiktig relation.

Arbetstider:
Måndag–fredag kl. 13.15–20.00
Enstaka helgpass kan förekomma vid behov.

Vem vi söker

Vi söker dig som

● är kvinna, gärna 30–60 år
● har erfarenhet av personlig assistans eller omsorg
● har erfarenhet av barn med autism
● är lugn, stabil och ansvarstagande
● kan arbeta självständigt och ligga steget före
● är lyhörd, tydlig och konsekvent
● har ett respektfullt och lågaffektivt förhållningssätt
● vill skapa kontinuitet och trygghet över tid.

Albanska och B-körkort är krav.

Vi ser gärna att du bor i Kungälv eller på rätt sida av stan, så att resvägen fungerar långsiktigt.

Vi erbjuder:

Du får introduktion och inskolning tillsammans med ordinarie personal för att lära känna kunden, hans kommunikation och arbetssätt. Som medarbetare hos Primacura blir du en del av ett engagerat team med fokus på trygghet, delaktighet och personlig service.
Vi är en etablerad arbetsgivare inom personlig assistans och daglig verksamhet och har kollektivavtal.

Ansök idag
Det här är ett uppdrag för dig som vill göra konkret skillnad i en annan människas vardag – med ditt lugn, din erfarenhet och ditt engagemang.
Känner du igen dig? Skicka in din ansökan till Primacura redan idag. Vi ser fram emot att lära känna dig!

Om Primacura

Primacura Personlig Assistans är ett etablerat assistansbolag med verksamhet inom LSS, personlig assistans och daglig verksamhet. Vi grundades 2007 och har vårt kontor i Borås.

Vår verksamhet bygger på närhet, trygghet och personlig service – vi arbetar för att skapa en tillitsfull och inkluderande miljö för våra kunder och anställda. De flesta av våra kunder finns i Sjuhärad, Västra Götaland och Halland.

Mer information om oss hittar du på vår hemsida: www.primacura.se

jobs.title: Kreativ kvinne 27 år søker assistenter
jobs.employer: PRIMA ASSISTANSE AS AVD MØRE OG ROMSDAL
jobs.description:
Jeg søker en engasjert assistent til å bistå med daglige oppgaver hjemme, aktiviteter og reiser til ulike arrangementer. Stillingen innebærer noe reisevirksomhet i løpet av året, så det er en flott mulighet for deg som ønsker en spennende og variert jobb.

Jeg er en kreativ og engasjert person som setter pris på et godt samarbeid, og jeg ønsker å finne en assistent som kan være en positiv støtte i hverdagen. Jeg tilbyr tilkallingstilling med arbeid på dagtid og noen ganger på helg.


Kvalifikasjoner jeg ser etter:

Flytende muntlig og skriftlig norsk

Førerkort klasse B (for reise og transport)

Kvinne over 23 år (grunnet stillingens natur)

Plettfri vandel (krav om politiattest)


Er du den ansvarsfulle, fleksible personen jeg ser etter? Jeg ser frem til å høre fra deg!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

jobs.title: Sök jobb som timvikarie inom personlig assistans i Karlskrona med omnejd!
jobs.description:
Om arbetsplatsen



Furuboda Assistans är en privat assistansanordnare i södra Sverige med rötter i den ideella Föreningen Furuboda. Bolaget skapades år 2005 och är ett växande företag. I dagsläget består Furuboda Assistans av ca 700 medarbetare. Vi strävar efter att vara ett föredöme inom hållbart företagande. För oss handlar hållbart företagande om att ha ett starkt kundfokus, välmående personal samt att eftersträva en låg klimat- och miljö-påverkan.

Vill du ha ett meningsfullt och utvecklande arbete där du gör verklig skillnad i en annan människas vardag? Vi söker nu ansvarsfulla och lyhörda timvikarier till flera av våra kunder i Kristianstad med omnejd.

Att arbeta som personlig assistent är mer än ett jobb. Hos oss får du möjlighet att lära känna en annan människa, vara en viktig del av vardagen och samtidigt utvecklas själv. Vi erbjuder ett tryggt och givande arbete där relation, lyhördhet och respekt står i centrum.

Om jobbet

Som personlig assistent stöttar du en av våra kunder i deras vardag så att hen kan leva ett så självständigt, aktivt och tryggt liv som möjligt. Alla våra uppdrag är unika och anpassade efter den person du arbetar hos.

Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:

    Hjälp med personlig omvårdnad
    Stöd i vardagliga sysslor och rutiner i hemmet
    Följa med på aktiviteter, utflykter eller träning
    Vara ett tryggt, närvarande och flexibelt stöd i vardagen
    Övriga uppgifter utifrån kundens specifika behov och önskemål

Arbetstiderna varierar (dag, kväll, natt och helg). Du kan arbeta hos en och samma kund över tid eller hos flera olika kunder utifrån din tillgänglighet och verksamhetens behov.

Vem söker vi?

Du behöver inte ha arbetat som personlig assistent tidigare – tidigare erfarenhet är meriterande, men vi lägger absolut störst vikt vid personlig lämplighet och matchning. Vi söker dig som:

    Är ansvarstagande, lyhörd och pålitlig
    Är trygg i dig själv och har ett genuint intresse för att arbeta med människor
    Är flexibel och anpassningsbar efter olika individers behov och personligheter

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Ett meningsfullt och utvecklande arbete där du gör skillnad på riktigt
    Grundlig introduktion och stöd inför dina uppdrag
    Ett flexibelt extrajobb utifrån dina möjligheter
    Goda möjligheter till fortsatt och mer omfattande arbete framöver

Ansökan

Vi rekryterar löpande. Du ansöker enkelt genom att svara på några korta frågor i vårt ansökningsformulär – inget CV eller personligt brev krävs.

Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag!

Övrigt



Som anställd på Furuboda Assistans blir du erbjuden ett meningsfullt arbete med trygg anställning, friskvårdsbidrag på 2500 kronor, utbildningar och möjlighet till att utvecklas i ditt uppdrag. Vi tycker det är viktigt att medarbetare känner glädje och gemenskap på jobbet, och erbjuder därför en rad olika aktiviteter. Hos oss får du precis som våra kunder vara precis den du är. Vi har kollektivavtal och är medlemmar i IfA, Intresseföreningen för assistansberättigade, och möter deras höga kvalitetskrav som IfA-godkänd anordnare av personlig assistans

OULU

KOKKIAmarillo Oulu
Etsimme kokkia vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Amarillo Ouluun. Työaika on 90 h / 3 viikkoa, ja työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan.

Kokin työ Amarillossa on monipuolista à la carte -ruoan valmistusta osana ammattitaitoista keittiötiimiä. Työ on vuorotyötä ravintolan aukioloaikojen mukaisesti niin arkena kuin viikonloppuisin. Katso tarkemmat aukioloaikamme TÄÄLTÄ.

Odotamme sinulta
- alan koulutusta; aiempi kokemus katsotaan eduksi
- oma-aloitteisuutta, positiivista työotetta sekä sitoutumista laadukkaaseen työnjälkeen ja hygieniapassia
- joustavuutta ja hyvää paineensietokykyä sekä halua toimia palveluammatissa vaihtelevissa ja ajoittain kiireisissä tilanteissa

Tehdään yhdessä ihan tavallisia töitä – meiltä saat poikkeuksellisen hyviä etuja
- yhteen pelaavan tiimin, jossa kaveria ei jätetä
- MaRaVa TES:n mukaisen palkkauksen 13,70–15,04 €/h aiemmasta kokemuksestasi riippuen sekä mahdollisuuden tulospalkkioon, jopa 1,3 €/h
- kattavan perehdytyksen sekä tuen työssä onnistumiseen ja ammatilliseen kehittymiseen
- S-ryhmän loistavat henkilöstöedut, joista voit lukea lisää TÄÄLTÄ

Meillä saat olla oma itsesi, ja kohtelemme kaikkia tasapuolisesti. Arvostamme yhteistyötä, toistemme kunnioittamista ja halua onnistua yhdessä. Haluamme rakentaa työyhteisöä, jossa jokainen voi kehittyä omassa työssään ja kokea työnsä merkitykselliseksi.

Jos ihan tavallinen työelämä houkuttaa, laitathan hakemuksesi tulemaan!

Hakuaikaa on 14.10.2026 saakka. Kutsumme hakemusten perusteella jatkoon valitut haastatteluun.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa keittiöpäällikkö Mika Jokinen, p. 044 788 6690.

Amarillon sydän sykkii yhdessä syömiselle ja hyvälle fiilikselle. Amarillo yhdistää niin ystävät kuin tuntemattomat ja saa jengin viihtymään saman pöydän ääressä. Tyyliltään Amarillo on raikas ja reilu, mutkaton ja energinen

jobs.description:
Statens institutionsstyrelse, SiS, är en myndighet som ansvarar för individuellt anpassad tvångsvård för ungdomar med komplex psykosocial problematik och för vuxna med missbruk. SiS verkställer även sluten ungdomsvård. Det gör vi på ungdomshem och hem för vuxna med missbruk, över hela landet. Hos oss på SiS blir ditt arbetsliv en spännande utmaning. Oavsett var i vår organisation du arbetar, eller vilken tjänst du har, hjälper du till att skapa livsviktig förändring.



SiS ungdomshem Ljungaskog tar emot icke skolpliktiga flickor med psykosocial problematik, missbruk och självskadeproblem. Institutionen har i uppdrag att bedriva vård för flickor med särskilda vårdbehov.





Arbetsbeskrivning

Vill du vara med och skapa den livsviktiga förändringen för utsatta människor? Då är jobbet som behandlingspedagog hos SiS en meningsfull utmaning.



Som behandlingspedagog arbetar du i team tillsammans med behandlingsassistenter och behandlingssamordnare och tillsammans ansvarar ni för att de



ungdomar och klienter som bor hos oss får den trygghet, vård och behandling som de behöver. Vi möter ofta människor i kris, vilket innebär att du



jobbar med kvalificerat omvårdnads-och motivationsarbete och med att vara ett stöd i vardagen. Med stöd av dina kunskaper inom vård- och



behandlingsarbete bidrar du aktivt till att behandlingsplaner fullföljs. Dokumentation är en viktig del av ditt arbete, och bidrar bland annat till



rättssäkerhet, planering och uppföljning av vår verksamhet. Du bidrar till att säkerheten upprätthålls enligt våra rutiner och du medverkar till att



vardagen flyter på med skolgång, städning, matlagning med mera.Kontaktmannaskap är också en av dina arbetsuppgifter. I arbetet kan det även ingå att



vara handledare åt nya medarbetare och praktikanter. Det här är ett arbete för dig som ser en positiv utmaning i att få arbeta med utsatta människor i en



svår livssituation. Jobbet är många gånger krävande men också stimulerande, glädjefyllt och omväxlande.



Vår vision är att vara en plats för förändring och det genomsyrar vårt bemötande, vårt engagemang och vårt förhållningssätt.



Arbetstiden är enligt schema dag - kväll och helg.

jobs.title: Growth & Marketing Associate
jobs.description:
Lindholmen, Gothenburg (Hybrid) Scope: 50%, with strong potential to grow into full-time as the role and company develop Contract: 1 year to start, with good opportunities for extension Start: As soon as possible

About us

Cyber Instincts is a Gothenburg-based cybersecurity consultancy working at the forefront of cybersecurity and AI, together with our group companies FutureSpex (cybersecurity and AI training/certification) and UltraDefy (AI strategy and governance). We're a small, fast-moving team, which means this role comes with real ownership from day one rather than a narrow, predefined lane.

About the role

We're looking for a Growth & Marketing Associate to help build our market presence, generate new business opportunities, and drive our continued growth. This is both a strategic and hands-on role, ideal for someone who enjoys combining marketing, networking, and business-driving activities — and who's comfortable figuring out how to get there, not just executing a fixed playbook.

We're intentionally not looking for someone who waits for detailed instructions. Our processes are still evolving, so you'll be expected to spot gaps, bring your own ideas to the table, and take initiative on what "good" looks like — working closely with the team, but driving your own area independently.

Responsibilities

Growth & business development

    

Identify and create new business opportunities

    

Own lead generation and prospecting

    

Support sales processes and client conversations

    

Contribute to developing our pipeline and revenue opportunities

    

Build and maintain relationships with clients and partners

Marketing & digital presence

    

Manage our visibility on social media

    

Plan and publish content

    

Contribute to content for our website, articles, and campaigns

    

Drive brand-building activities

Events & networking

    

Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities

    

Build new contacts and business opportunities

    

Help plan and coordinate events

Coordination & support

    

Provide administrative support across business and marketing processes

    

Coordinate activities tied to marketing and partnerships

    

Work closely with leadership on various growth initiatives

What we're looking for

    

1–4 years of experience in marketing, sales, growth, or business development

    

Experience in B2B environments

    

A proactive, self-driven mindset — someone who brings new ideas rather than waiting to be told what to do

    

Comfortable working independently, in a fast-changing environment

    

Strong communication skills in both Swedish and English

    

Enjoys building networks and creating new business opportunities

    

Thrives in an entrepreneurial, fast-paced environment

Nice to have

    

Experience with LinkedIn and digital marketing

    

Experience with lead generation and prospecting

    

Background in tech, cybersecurity, or consulting

What we offer

    

A broad, developing role in a growing company

    

Significant ownership and real influence over how things are built

    

Exposure to cybersecurity, AI, and digital transformation

    

Hybrid work from our office at Lindholmen

Application

We interview candidates on a rolling basis and the role may be filled before the application deadline. Start: as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Vil du bruke dialog til å skape reell endring?
jobs.description:
Hvordan skaper vi tillit når avstanden mellom mennesker øker? Hvordan møtes vi når perspektivene står langt fra hverandre? Og hvordan kan dialog bidra til å forebygge konflikt og styrke demokratiet?

Dette er spørsmål Nansen Fredssenter har arbeidet med i mer enn tre tiår. Gjennom praktisk freds- og dialogarbeid i Norge og internasjonalt har vi utviklet en unik tilnærming til dialog som verktøy for å bygge tillit, transformere konflikter og skape konstruktive møter mellom mennesker.

Nå søker Nansen Fredssenter en seniorrådgiver dialog som vil være med på å anvende, formidle og videreutvikle dette arbeidet.

 

Rollen

Som seniorrådgiver dialog vil du arbeide i skjæringspunktet mellom mennesker, fag og samfunn. 

Du blir en viktig faglig bærer av Nansen Fredssenters dialogmetodikk og bidrar til å videreutvikle både metodikk, faglig innhold og nye prosjekter.

Rollen gir stor grad av frihet og selvstendighet. Derfor ser vi etter deg som tar initiativ, ser muligheter og får ting til å skje. Du må trives med å drive eget arbeid fremover, etablere relasjoner og omsette ideer til konkrete aktiviteter og prosjekter - i Norge og internasjonalt.

 

Du vil blant annet:

  • koordinere, gjennomføre og videreutvikle kurs, seminarer og undervisning – fysiske og digitale
  • lede og fasilitere dialogprosesser i Norge og internasjonalt
  • anvende, formidle og bidra til å videreutvikle Nansen Fredssenters dialogmetodikk
  • initiere, utvikle og lede prosjekter fra idé til gjennomføring og rapportering - inkludert søknader og finansiering
  • utvikle samarbeid og bygge relasjoner med relevante fagmiljøer, organisasjoner og samfunnsaktører
  • representere Nansen Fredssenter nasjonalt og internasjonalt

 

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter en selvgående og personlig engasjert person med faglig tyngde og sterk relasjonell kompetanse.

Du følger med på samfunnsutviklingen nasjonalt og internasjonalt, og interesserer deg for menneskene og mekanismene som former våre liv og samtid. Du er komfortabel med kompleksitet og ulike perspektiver, og har evnen til å skape tillit også når utgangspunktet er krevende.

Samtidig har du gjennomføringskraft. Du trenger ikke å bli fortalt hva neste steg er - du ser det selv og tar ansvar for å komme videre. Du er robust og tåler perioder med ubekvemme arbeidstider, helgearbeid og reising.

 

Vi legger særlig vekt på:

  • erfaring med prosjekt- og prosessledelse
  • svært gode formidlings- og kommunikasjonsevner
  • evne til å arbeide selvstendig, ta initiativ og drive prosesser fremover
  • erfaring fra eller interessen for internasjonale og tverrkulturelle sammenhenger
  • evne til å bygge tillit og skape gode relasjoner på tvers av kulturer og perspektiver
  • et tydelig og genuint samfunnsengasjement

Du har:

  • relevant høyere utdanning, gjerne på masternivå
  • flere års relevant arbeidserfaring
  • erfaring fra ett eller flere relevante fagområder, eksempelvis dialog- og konfliktarbeid, demokrati- og menneskerettighetsarbeid, integrering, utdanning, forskning, offentlig sektor, sivilsamfunn eller internasjonalt arbeid
  • god muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne på norsk og engelsk

Det er en fordel om du har:

  • erfaring fra freds- og dialogarbeid
  • erfaring med prosjekt- og/eller prosessledelse
  • andre språkferdigheter
  • relevante faglige nettverk

Vi er opptatt av mangold i perspektiver og erfaringer, og oppfordrer kandidater med ulik faglig og profesjonell bakgrunn til å søke. Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt.

 

Hvorfor Nansen Fredssenter?

Hos oss får du muligheten til å bruke kompetansen din i arbeid med tydelig samfunnsmessig betydning. Du blir en del av et nasjonalt og internasjonalt anerkjent fagmiljø med mer enn 30 års erfaring innen dialog, konflikttransformasjon og fredsarbeid, samtidig som du får stor frihet til å påvirke hvordan arbeidet utvikles videre.

Du får arbeide på tvers av fag, kulturer og landegrenser med problemstillinger som er aktuelle, komplekse og viktige. Rollen gir en unik mulighet til å bidra til varig endring gjennom dialogprosesser som styrker tillit, forståelse og samarbeid mellom mennesker og samfunn.

Nansen Fredssenter kjennetegnes av et sterkt faglig fellesskap, et inkluderende og godt arbeidsmiljø, og et engasjement som gjennomsyrer hele organisasjonen. Her møter du kollegaer som brenner for samfunnsoppdraget, som deler kunnskap og erfaringer, og som er opptatt av å støtte hverandre i arbeidet med å skape positive samfunnsendringer.

Vi ønsker mangfold i erfaringer, perspektiver og bakgrunner, og oppfordrer kvalifiserte kandidater med ulik bakgrunn til å søke. Hos oss verdsettes ulike perspektiver og bakgrunn som en styrke, fordi gode dialogprosesser bygger på nettopp mangfold, nysgjerrighet og gjensidig respekt.

 

Arbeidssted: Lillehammer
Stilling: Fast
Søknadsfrist: 1. november 2026

 

For spørsmål om stillingen eller rekrutteringsprosessen, kontakt Kristine Bugge Lie Owe, seniorrådgiver i Jefferson Wells på epost: kristine.owe@jeffersonwells.no eller +47 40 72 40 05.

 
 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Nansen Fredssenter er et ledende fagmiljø innen dialog, fredsbygging og demokratisk deltakelse. Gjennom dialogprosesser, kompetanseutvikling og internasjonalt samarbeid arbeider vi for å styrke tillit, inkludering og konstruktiv håndtering av uenighet. Vårt mål er å bidra til samfunn der mennesker med ulike erfaringer, perspektiver og interesser kan møtes, lytte til hverandre og skape løsninger sammen.

jobs.title: Office Manager
jobs.description:
About us

Hacksaw Studios is a Stockholm-based game studio focused on creating innovative, high-quality gaming experiences. With a focus on performance and precision, we bring ideas to life through technical expertise and creative collaboration. We have wide distribution, and our games are played by millions of people every month by players all over the world.

We are now looking for a proactive and service-minded Office Manager who enjoys creating structure, solving problems, and making sure the office is a great place to be.

You are someone who notices the small things before anyone has to ask. Whether it’s preparing for an upcoming event, making sure the office is fully stocked, welcoming a delivery, or finding a quick solution to an unexpected problem, you approach each task with energy and a positive attitude.

The Role

As our Office Manager, you will play an important part in the everyday experience at our Stockholm office. You will help ensure that the workplace remains organized, welcoming, and ready for whatever the day brings.

This is a hands-on role with plenty of variety. It offers the opportunity to gain practical experience in office coordination, administration, and event planning while working in a creative and fast-moving environment.

Your key responsibilities include:

    Making sure shared office areas are tidy, welcoming, and well-stocked
    Coordinating purchases and orders for office supplies, snacks, and other essentials
    Receiving deliveries and handling practical office-related requests
    Supporting the planning and coordination of internal events and activities
    Assisting with day-to-day office administration
    Identifying practical improvements and helping put them into action
    Handling unexpected situations calmly and finding effective solutions
    Contributing to a positive office experience for employees and visitors

What We’re Looking For

You enjoy helping others and take pride in creating an organized and welcoming workplace. You are reliable, attentive, and comfortable managing both planned tasks and unexpected situations.

You bring:

    A proactive, practical, and solution-oriented approach
    Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
    Previous experience in administration, office coordination, hospitality, or another service-oriented role
    The ability to manage several tasks and shift priorities when needed
    Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
    A positive attitude and a strong sense of responsibility
    Fluency in English and Swedish
    Availability to work from our Stockholm office

Nice-to-have:

    Experience supporting internal events or workplace activities
    An interest in games, technology, or the creative industries

Practical Details

    Employment type: Full-time, permanent employment starting with a probationary period
    Location: On-site at our Stockholm office
    Start date: As soon as possible

Ready to Join the Game Makers?

Think you can keep things running smoothly while adding good vibes along the way? Apply now! We review applications on a rolling basis.

If you have any questions about the role or the application process, don’t hesitate to reach out.

Join Hacksaw Studios and help keep the creativity flowing!

Forward Deployed Architect
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Forward Deployed Architect on Notion’s Services team, you will help customers turn AI ambition into operational reality and unlock the full potential of our platform. You will partner directly with customers to design, build, and launch AI-native workflows that drive adoption, usage, and measurable business outcomes.

This role sits at the center of Notion’s workflow-led GTM motion. You will partner directly with customers to understand their business goals, operating processes, technical environment, governance needs, and adoption barriers, then translate that context into scalable Notion architectures that drive measurable value.

You will be hands-on across discovery, solution design, workspace architecture, workflow build, AI implementation, launch planning, adoption and handoff. You will work deeply with customers to define what Notion should own, where it should integrate with existing systems, and how Notion can become a durable operating layer for their teams.

The best candidates combine strong consultative discovery, systems thinking, technical fluency, AI-native workflow design, implementation judgment and exceptional customer presence. You should be comfortable reasoning through technical tradeoffs, designing scalable solutions, and partnering closely with Forward Deployed Engineering when deeper engineering support is required.

In this role, you own the engagement outcome. You will lead our most complex, multi-workstream engagements in Korea, decide when Forward Deployed Engineers are needed for code-intensive work, and coach others to raise the bar across our Services practice.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Lead Notion’s most complex, multi-workstream customer engagements in Korea end to end, from scoping and discovery through launch, adoption and handoff, often where the future state and success measures are not yet defined.

 - Shape Services scope, effort estimates and implementation strategy with account teams during pre-sales, then deliver against the agreed scope, timeline and outcomes, recovering engagements that go off track.

 - Drive executive alignment on ambiguous, high-stakes decisions: facilitate discovery and architecture workshops, frame tradeoffs clearly and deliver hard messages directly.

 - Decide where Notion should own, complement or connect to existing systems, and design scalable architectures and AI-native workflows to a production quality bar, including permission design, AI evaluation, human-in-the-loop controls and operational ownership.

 - Orchestrate Forward Deployed Engineers, partners and internal teams: define when deeper engineering is required and set clear scope, ownership and handoffs.

 - Lead change management and adoption through stakeholder alignment, champion programs, phased rollouts and enablement, so customer teams sustain usage and realize measurable value.

 - Coach other architects and partners, and scale the Korea Services practice through reusable reference architectures, packaged solutions and localized enablement.

 - Turn field patterns into evidence-backed product signals (customer pain, business impact, expected outcome and frequency) that influence Notion’s roadmap.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - 5+ years of experience in tech services/consulting, solutions architecture, implementation, customer engineering, or a similar customer-facing role.

 - Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer goals into clear workflows, implementation plans, solution architectures, and measurable success criteria.

 - Strong consultative discovery skills, including the ability to map current-state workflows, identify customer pain, understand operating models, surface technical constraints, and define practical future-state solutions.

 - Hands-on AI builder mindset, with experience using AI tools to design, prototype, automate, or improve real business workflows.

 - Proven track record of designing and deploying AI-powered workflows or agents in production for customers.

 - Hands-on technical depth in data modeling and permission design, API and integration patterns, agent design and evaluation, enterprise security and governance, and data validation with SQL or scripts. You do not need to write production code.

 - Strong experience delivering implementations that drive adoption, change management and long-term customer value.

 - Strong project and engagement management skills, including ownership of scope, timeline, deliverables, stakeholder alignment, risks, decisions, dependencies and launch readiness.

 - Experience scoping Services work, estimating effort and delivering within agreed commercial boundaries.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for business, technical, and executive audiences.

 - Strong executive presence and customer judgment, with the ability to build trust, frame tradeoffs clearly, and move ambiguous decisions forward.

 - Experience coaching consultants or architects, and building methods, reference architectures or packaged services that others adopt.

 - Bias toward action, high learning velocity, and comfort building in fast-changing AI-native product environments.

 - Professional fluency in Korean and English.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience with Notion, APIs, MCPs, Workers, coding agents or developer platform workflows.

 - Experience delivering for large Korean enterprises and navigating complex, multi-stakeholder decision processes.

 - Experience enabling or co-delivering with implementation partners.

 - Previous experience in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment.




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Data Analyst, WMU-LRF Maritime Observatory
jobs.description:
The World Maritime University (WMU) was founded in 1983 within the framework of the International Maritime Organization (IMO), a specialized agency of the United Nations, as its premier centre of excellence for maritime postgraduate education, research and capability development. The University offers unique postgraduate programmes, conducts wide-ranging research in maritime and ocean-related studies, and advances maritime capability development in line with the UN Sustainable Development Goals.

The WMU–Lloyd's Register Foundation Maritime Observatory is a new strategic initiative established to strengthen the availability, analysis and use of high-quality evidence in support of maritime policy and decision-making. The Observatory will combine data analytics, evidence synthesis and policy-relevant research to generate insights on important and emerging maritime issues.

The Data Analyst will support the establishment and operation of the WMU-LRF Maritime Observatory across the full analytical cycle: identification, acquisition, management, analysis and visualization of maritime data and the development of evidence-based knowledge products such as dashboards, models, reports and briefs.

The incumbent will report to the Head of Data and Insights (WMU-LRF Maritime Observatory) and work closely with other members of the Observatory team to develop its data and analytical capabilities. The position requires a combination of technical data skills, analytical curiosity and an interest in applying data and evidence to maritime policy questions.

This is an opportunity to join a strategic initiative, the Observatory, at its founding stage. The successful candidate will have an opportunity to contribute directly to the development of its data infrastructure, analytical methods, AI workflows and knowledge products. It is an opportunity to shape how the Observatory works from the outset, and contribute to its work supporting international maritime policy-making.

WMU offers an attractive remuneration package including a tax-free annual net base salary starting at the applicable P1 level (subject to mandatory deductions for pension contributions and health insurance), with a variable post adjustment, dependency benefits, education grant, relocation and repatriation expenses, as applicable under the relevant rules.

Candidates will be contacted if they are short-listed.

This vacancy is open to eligible candidates that satisfy the education, experience and language criteria noted above.

WMU is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment of mutual respect. WMU recruits and employs staff regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, religious, cultural and ethnic backgrounds or disabilities.

Application

Applicants must apply online through the University’s website

jobs.title: Site Engineering and Reliability Lead
jobs.description:
The Engineering Lead is responsible for providing engineering and reliability guidance and direction to the Helsingborg Site ensuring they are delivering “best-in-class” approaches with respect to all elements of engineering and reliability maintenance practices.  This person will actively work by: Supporting strategic decisions related to Helsingborg Site, providing flawless execution knowledge related to capital equipment & deployment of reliability initiatives, point of contact between the Site and the regional Technical Operation organization, and supporting engineering related urgent issues during the execution or manufacturing phases.

Responsibilities:                    

    Responsible for the site engineering and equipment reliability strategy.
    Responsible for site engineering project portfolio & asset stewardship consolidation in partnership with site Leadership.
    Responsible to commission and qualify all new and existing upgraded equipment at site inline with Kenvue’s C&Q policy.
    Direct, guide and provide oversight for the site CapEx portfolio including forecasting, prioritizing budgeting, controlling and reporting of the site capital plan, communicating status and health to site and network stakeholders.
    Responsible for delivering equipment, capital and automation upgrades and innovation at site through working with regional and global team.
    Responsible for Standard deployment of capital programs in line with health authority requirements meeting Kenvue compliance and quality standards.
    Coordinate and develop of Site Master Plan (3-5 years).
    As site leadership team member develop department annual budgets, monitoring/controlling performance of site.
    Responsible for 5-7 direct reports and their performance and developments.



Qualifications

    A bachelor’s degree of Engineering (preferable Masters) with functional and people management experience (preferably in OTC/Pharma).
    Ability to drive engineering operational excellence across the organization with measurable, financial, quality and cycle time results is required-
    Experience in engineering project management, capital portfolio and installations.
    Knowledge across corrective, planned and reliability maintenance.
    Expert in continuous improvement, coot cause problem solving and operation excellence.
    Proven ability to work effectively and drive alignment in a matrix management environment through effective communication, collaboration and influence.
    Strong understanding of the asset management and NPI (new product introduction) processes.
    Fluent in English language – writing, speaking and understanding.



Kenvue Helsingborg

The Kenvue site in Helsingborg, Sweden is the home of the strong and growing brand NICORETTE®, a global market leader in smoking cessation. In 2021 our production facility was recognized as a Lighthouse by World Economic Forum, marking us as a beacon in The Fourth Industrial Revolution.

The Helsingborg site is one of the largest employers in the city of Helsingborg, and the business is divided in two separate departments: Operations, where we house our manufacturing activities and R & D, our global development center for excellence working in three therapeutic areas for selfcare treatments: Smoking Cessation, Digestive Health and Cough & Cold. For more information, click here.

Background checks in the recruitment process

As a final candidate in our recruitment process, you may be subject to a background check. This process is important for us to ensure the quality of our recruitment process.

As part of this, it is important that we encourage you to make sure that the information in your CV is correct before submitting your application to us.

To carry out these background checks, we use a background check company. Different checks may be carried depending on the position that you are applying for. This could be, for example:

    Reference checks
    CV-validation
    Financial checks
    Litigation checks, including criminal cases

The background check company is an independent data controller for any personal data that they will process during the check, and if you have any questions about the processing, you may turn to the background check company.

Due to our business activities and daily operations, we may also carry out drug tests as part of our recruitment process.



What’s in it for you:  

    Competitive Benefit Package      
    Learning & Development Opportunities        
    Employee Resource Groups                

Kenvue is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. We therefore encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.

jobs.title: AUTOMEKAANIKKO – EKODRIVE OY, KERAVA
jobs.description:
**AUTOMEKAANIKKO – EKODRIVE OY, KERAVA**

Ekodrive Oy etsii **itsenäistä ja vastuullista automekaanikkoa** pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen Keravalle.

Työvoiman tarve on arviolta **loka–marraskuussa 2026**, mutta etsimme sopivaa henkilöä jo nyt. Jos olet tällä hetkellä töissä mutta harkitset työpaikan vaihtoa myöhemmin syksyllä, voit myös ottaa yhteyttä.

Etsimme mekaanikkoa, joka pystyy hoitamaan tavallisia korjaamotöitä itsenäisesti, tekee työnsä loppuun sovitussa ajassa ja **kantaa vastuun työnsä lopputuloksesta**.

Työhön kuuluu mm.

- määräaikaishuollot ja öljynvaihdot

- jarrujen huolto ja korjaus

- alustan ja ohjauksen korjaukset

- katsastuskorjaukset

- moottori- ja vaihteistoöljyjen vaihdot

- jakohihnojen ja jakopään osien vaihdot

- vikojen etsintä ja perusdiagnostiikka

- rengastyöt

- ilmastointihuollot

- muut tavalliset henkilöautojen korjaamotyöt


Sinun ei tarvitse osata kaikkea, mutta **tavalliset korjaamotyöt pitää pystyä tekemään itsenäisesti**.

Arvostamme mekaanikkoa, joka osaa ajatella käytännöllisesti: vika tutkitaan, korjataan järkevällä tavalla ja työ saatetaan loppuun ilman tarpeetonta asioiden monimutkaistamista.

Odotamme sinulta

- B-luokan ajokorttia

- vastuullisuutta ja luotettavuutta

- oma-aloitteista työotetta

- kykyä tehdä päätöksiä oman työn yhteydessä

- kiinnostusta autoihin ja korjaamiseen

- halua kehittää omaa ammattitaitoa

- kykyä työskennellä normaalisti osana pientä työporukkaa


**Autosähkön, diagnostiikan ja hitsauksen osaaminen on selvä etu.**

Aikaisempi työkokemus autokorjaamolta ja suomen kielen taito ovat plussaa. Työpaikalla voidaan kommunikoida **suomeksi tai venäjäksi**.

Meillä arvostetaan hyvää työilmapiiriä, keskinäistä kunnioitusta ja sitä, että jokainen hoitaa oman työnsä kunnolla.

Meille asiakkaan auto on tärkeä riippumatta sen merkistä, iästä tai arvosta. **Jokainen auto on asiakkaalle tärkeä ja meille työtä.**

Tarjoamme

- vakituisen työn sopivalle henkilölle

- työajan **37,5 h/vko**

- ma–pe **klo 8.00–16.00**

- 6 kuukauden koeajan

- pienen ja kehittyvän työyhteisön

- mahdollisuuden saada enemmän vastuuta ja kehittyä yrityksen kasvaessa

- palkka: **kerro palkkatoiveesi**


Myös **oppilaitoksen kautta tuleva työharjoittelu tai virallinen työkokeilu** voi olla mahdollinen, jos hakijalla on hyvä tekninen perusta, oikea asenne ja realistinen mahdollisuus jatkaa myöhemmin työntekijänä.

HAKEMINEN – VAIN SÄHKÖPOSTITSE

Puhelinhakemuksia emme käsittele.

Pitkää hakemusta ei tarvita. Lähetä lyhyt sähköposti **suomeksi tai venäjäksi** ja vastaa seuraaviin kysymyksiin:

1. Kuinka paljon sinulla on kokemusta automekaanikon työstä?

2. Mitkä korjaukset pystyt tekemään täysin itsenäisesti?

3. Oletko tehnyt jakohihnan/jakopään vaihtoja itsenäisesti?

4. Millainen kokemus sinulla on diagnostiikasta ja autosähköstä?

5. Onko sinulla kokemusta rengastöistä ja ilmastointihuolloista?

6. Onko sinulla voimassa oleva B-ajokortti?

7. Mikä on palkkatoiveesi?

8. Milloin voisit aloittaa?

9. Miksi etsit uutta työpaikkaa ja millaista työpaikkaa etsit pidemmällä aikavälillä?


**Hakemukset ja yhteydenotot ainoastaan sähköpostitse ekodrivepro@gmail.com**

**Ekodrive Oy Kerava**

jobs.title: Senior Accountant Central Europe
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Senior Accountant Central Europe for a company in Gothenburg. Start is ASAP, 8 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Gothenburg.

Assignment description and main responsibilities

    

Manage and oversee - together with Group Accounting and SSC team - all accounting operations, including billing, accounts receivable/payable, general ledger, and inventory accounting.

    

Lead Shared service team (SSC) with the SSC Team leads, review and oversee all activities related to the month-end, half-year and year-end close processes, ensuring accuracy, timeliness in coordination with internal teams (group accounting, tax.).

    

Secure implementation of accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls in liaison with HQ Finance teams and Group Accounting.

    

Safeguard company assets and ensure SOX compliance. SoX controls performed by SSC team.

    

Prepare and present financial statements with SSC, EY, Auditors.

    

Review reconciliations, prepare reports, and analyses to senior leadership. (SSC team performing the monthly reconciliations)

    

Ensure compliance with accounting standards, tax regulations, and all relevant legal requirements in liaison with HQ Group Accounting, Tax and Technical Accounting.

    

Manage partnerships with external auditors, tax/regulatory authorities.

    

Drive process improvements requests and leverage technology to increase efficiency and accuracy.

    

Provide leadership and oversight across a shared service accounting function, ensuring alignment with company standards, service level agreements, and seamless integration with internal operation

﻿

Collaborate with:

    

Group Accounting, Tax, Internal Control & SSC team* to ensure monthly closing, compliance with Local legal/Group policies and Statutory filing on time.

    

Cross functional teams across the PSUs and Regions Governance and Control – secure execution and improvement of internal controls set by our global internal control team.

    

Liaise with external and internal auditors and ensure compliance with Sarbanes-Oxley controls.

﻿

*SSC responsible for performing R2R, AP/AR, Cash & Bank activities

﻿

Deliveries

The Senior Accounting Manager for Central Europe will play an important role in managing the core accounting and financial report functions and operational efficiencies in the region. You will lead our accounting and financial report operations through strategic guidance, deep understanding of accounting principles and regulatory compliance. You will play a pivotal role in shaping our financial future, ensuring compliance, and supporting our mission to deliver exceptional value to our customers and stakeholders. This role will be a key member of our finance community, ensuring consistent alignment across our business units and seamless integration of accounting operations in Central Europe, which today consists of a group of legal entities located in Austria, Germany and Switzerland. This role reports to the Regional CFO.

﻿

Competence requirements

    

Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or related field required.

    

Master’s Degree in a related field, MBA and/or CPA Certification preferred.

    

5-10 years of progressive accounting experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.

    

Proven experience managing and collaborating across shared service accounting teams, ensuring high-quality performance and effective partnership.

    

Experience in the automotive industry or a related sector is strongly preferred.

    

Deep knowledge of GAAP/IFRS, financial reporting, and compliance requirements for the markets within the region.

    

Proven abilities working for a U.S. listed company environment with strong understanding of Sarbanes-Oxley Act and other regulatory requirements.

    

Demonstrated ability to lead and develop high-performing teams.

    

Proficient in accounting software and ERP systems; experience with dealership management systems a plus.

    

Skilled at identifying process gaps and driving optimization initiatives across various functions.

    

Thrives in a fast-paced environment with a passion for innovation and teamwork.

﻿

Other requirements

    

Fluent in English. German, Italian and French a plus.

    

Ability to navigate complexity in matrixed organizations

    

Strong prioritization abilities both in your own scope, your team, and deliverables to best support business objectives

﻿

This is a full-time consultant position in Gothenburg through Incluso. Start is ASAP, 8 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Gothenburg.

Please submit your CV as soon as possible since we will review the applications on an on-going basis.

For more information about this role, please contact Marianne Nilsson recruiter at Incluso.

jobs.title: MIG/MAG welder, Salo Region (Ongoing recruitment)
jobs.description:
Are you a MIG MAG welder in the Salo Region? You could be the right fit for the role!

Location: Salo Region, Finland
Employment Type: Fixed-term contract, a possibility of permanent employment
Salary: 14 - 18 € / hour

We are looking for a MIG/MAG Welder for our client company for a long-term position in the Salo region. Our client is a manufacturer specializing in steel structures, turning their customers' ideas into finished products – from design and production to assembly and delivery. In this role, you will work with bigger metal products in a modern industrial environment.

Your role

You will get to MIG MAG weld in project that consists of large metal components with material thicknesses ranging from 5 to 25 mm. The work is performed in a clean and safe production environment in a two-shift system, Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week.

You will have access to high-quality tools and equipment and receive a thorough introduction to the company's products and working methods. If you are relocating from another area, we can assist with accommodation arrangements when needed.

As part of the recruitment process, candidates will complete a welding test at the client's premises.

What we expect from you

* Proven experience in MIG/MAG welding

* An unwavering commitment to attention to detail and quality

* Flexibility to work both morning and evening shifts

* English and/or Finnish language skill

* A valid work permit for Finland is a must

* Ability to read technical drawings

Considered an advantage

* Previous experience with welding heavy products and thick materials.

What we offer

* A stable, long-term position with a respected company in the metal industry

* Competitive hourly pay based on your experience and skills

* Salary and employment conditions based on the Finnish Technology Industry Collective Agreement

* Clean and safe working facilities with high-quality equipment

* Comprehensive onboarding and opportunities to further develop your skills

* Assistance with accommodation arrangements if needed

* Salary 14-18 € / hour depending on skills

About Wellpack

You will be employed by Wellpack, a personnel services company established in 2013. Wellpack is known as a trusted partner, particularly within the industrial and defence industry sectors. We connect skilled professionals with quality employers and contribute to building sustainable employment in Finland.

Apply now!

This is an ongoing recruitment process, and we fill positions as production grows and staffing needs arise. We review applications as they arrive and contact suitable candidates as positions become available.

Submit your application through the "Apply" link in the job advertisement. Your application will be stored in our recruitment system. In your application, be sure to tell about your previous work experience and skills.

For more information about the position, please contact Wellpack's recruitment team by email at wellpack@wellpack.fi [wellpack@wellpack.fi].

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive - EMEA
jobs.description:
About Abacum

Abacum is the leading Business Planning solution for finance teams to drive performance. By automating reporting, enabling collaboration, and simplifying planning and forecasting, we help finance teams shift from number crunching to driving strategic decisions.

Founded in 2020 by two former CFOs, we’ve grown into a global team of 100+ people across 30+ nationalities. Headquartered in New York, we have offices in Toronto and Barcelona. We’re trusted by industry leaders such as Dish Networks, Strava, BetterUp, Kajabi, JG Wentworth, Abridge, Cortex, and hundreds more.

We have raised over $100m, closing in June 2025 our $60M Series B, led by Scale Venture Partners, with the strong participation of Cathay Innovation, Y Combinator, Atomico, Creandum, and angel operators from Adyen, Zapier, and Twitch.

Our mission is ambitious and we can’t do it alone - join Abacum as we build the future of Business Planning!

We are looking for...

An enterprise seller who already knows the Office of the CFO. You've carried a number selling planning, EPM, FP&A or finance software. You know how a CFO buys, how a steering committee stalls, and how to get a multi-stakeholder deal signed.

At Abacum you'll own a named territory of enterprise and upper mid-market accounts across EMEA. Many of them run legacy planning tools or spreadsheets that can't keep up with the business. Your job is to show them a better foundation, and win.

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will...

- Own the full sales cycle for a named book of enterprise accounts, from first meeting to signed contract

- Build and run your own pipeline through targeted outbound, events, and partner co-selling with ERP vendors and implementation partners

- Sell to CFOs, VPs of Finance and Heads of FP&A, and bring IT, procurement, security and legal along the way

- Run complex evaluations: discovery, business cases, proofs of concept, and competitive displacements

- Forecast with discipline and keep a clean pipeline in CRM

- Work with Solutions Engineering, Product and Leadership to shape deals, and feed what you hear in the market back into the roadmap

What we need...

- 6+ years of quota-carrying B2B SaaS sales, with at least 3 years closing enterprise deals

- Experience selling EPM, FP&A, planning, or other Office-of-the-CFO software (finance, ERP, spend, or data platforms)

- A track record of closing six-figure ARR deals with 3–6 month cycles and hitting or beating quota

- Comfort leading multi-stakeholder deals with finance, IT, procurement and security at the table

- Experience displacing an incumbent, whether a legacy system or a spreadsheet-based process

- A consultative, value-based approach: you build a business case in a CFO's language

- The drive to build your own pipeline, not wait for inbound

- Clear, sharp written and verbal communication, including running demos with senior buyers

- Based in EMEA, with the ability to travel to customers and events

Bonus points if you have...

- Sold with or through ERP ecosystems (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics) or implementation partners

- Worked in finance, or you're comfortable talking models, drivers and variances with an FP&A team

- Used a structured sales method (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, or similar)

- Been an early seller at a scaling company and helped build the enterprise playbook

Why sell Abacum

You know the category. Here's why this is the product you want in your bag.

1. A market ready to switch. Finance teams are stuck between rigid legacy planning tools that need a rebuild every time the business changes, and spreadsheets and AI tools no one can trust. Abacum is the governed, AI-native foundation that fixes both. That's a displacement story you can tell in every account.

2. AI that stands up to a CFO. Plenty of vendors claim AI. Ours runs on a governed financial model, so the AI reasons and the math stays exact. CFOs and IT teams can trust the output, and that wins technical evaluations.

3. Faster time to value than legacy EPM. 700+ integrations and self-service data pipelines mean customers see value in weeks, not after a long implementation. That shortens your cycle and makes the business case easy to sign.

4. Channels that bring you deals. Abacum is the only FP&A platform to pass NetSuite's SuiteCloud Developer Network review, is listed on the Sage Intacct Marketplace, and is a verified Microsoft Dynamics 365 partner. Those ecosystems and our implementation partners mean co-sell pipeline, not just cold outbound.

5. A product that keeps getting stronger. New AI skills ship every week. Abacum works where finance already works: Excel, Slack, Claude and ChatGPT, through MCP-native infrastructure. You'll have something new to show every quarter.

6. Funded to win enterprise. Abacum raised a $60M Series B to scale into larger customers. You'll join as we build the enterprise motion, with the room to shape it and grow with it.

What you get

- Competitive base, uncapped commission, and equity

- Remote in EMEA, with hubs in New York, Toronto and Barcelona

- Direct access to leadership and a real say in how we sell to enterprise

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation including equity package

  • Competitive vacation policy

  • Medical Insurance

  • L&D budget

  • Access to Meditopia (wellbeing platform)

  • Language courses (English / Spanish)

Our Values

Customer Obsession: We share the understanding that Abacum's sole purpose is to create value for customers and relentlessly deploy all creativity and energy to that end.

Audacious Ambition: We dream big and embrace discomfort. We assume risks, make on-time mistakes and learn how to methodically accomplish our goals.

Good People: We are self-reflective and praise diversity of thought. We don't justify the end with the means and know where to draw the line. We have fun every day.

Tough Love: We truly care for everyone in the team and embrace honest feedback and radical candor as ways to genuinely help each other.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Permanent Control
jobs.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.


Please make your application, including your CV, in English Language. We are a global compliance team headquartered out of London.

About the role

As a Senior Analyst – Permanent Controls, you will join the Permanent Controls team, a global Second Line of Defence (2LoD) function based across Paris and Mauritius. Reporting directly to the Head of Permanent Controls within the Compliance department, you will focus on the financial perimeter, exercising second-line control, independent oversight, and framework monitoring over the organization's finance domain. You will partner closely with the First Line of Defence (1LoD) to establish control standards, design control matrices, and provide guidance when needed. You will also execute 2LoD control plans, issue formal findings, and track recommendations through to resolution.

 

Sitting in the Second Line of Defense, the global Permanent Controls team serves as an ongoing, trusted advisor and objective challenge to operational teams (1LoD), helping them design robust controls and ensure operational integrity across the organization.

Unlike periodic audit functions, Permanent Controls operates continuously to proactively identify vulnerabilities, standardize control frameworks, and foster a strong risk culture.

 

Note on Governance: This is a 2LoD function focused on ongoing control design, execution, and 1LoD enablement. It is distinct and independent from the Internal Audit (3LoD) function within Checkout.com.

 

Key responsibilities

  • Control Design: Collaborate with stakeholders to translate identified risks into comprehensive 2nd line control plans, standards, and templates.

  • 1LoD Enablement: Partner with the First Line of Defence teams to design, refine, and assess their control matrices, ensuring alignment with internal standards and regulators' expectations (ACPR, FCA..).

  • Execution & Testing: Formalize and execute second line permanent controls across critical perimeters, including:

    • Financial regulatory reporting across global entities (France, UK, US, etc.).

    • Accuracy of financial data, accounting standards, and reconciliations.

    • Internal financial processes, procedures, and statutory compliance (including the Order of 3 December 2014).

    • Safeguarding mechanisms (flow of funds, compliance with safeguarding measures, timelines, and incident monitoring).

  • Reporting & Escalation: Present detailed control findings and anomaly reports to the Head of Permanent Controls; track the implementation of remediation recommendations.

  • Proactive Continuous Improvement: Identify operational control gaps, take the initiative to propose practical solutions, and drive improvements to the overall control framework.

  • Tooling & Automation: Contribute to the implementation and optimization of automated control tools, tracking dashboards, and recommendation monitoring systems whenever possible.

 

About You

  • Experience: 5 years of experience in Financial Audit, Internal Control, or Financial Reporting within the financial services (banking, Fintech..) or payments industry.

  • Regulatory Context: Familiarity with regulatory frameworks and ACPR expectations is strongly preferred.

  • Mindset & Working Style:

    • Proactive & Autonomous: A "go-getter" who takes ownership, anticipates control gaps, and brings actionable solutions to the table rather than waiting for direction.

    • Naturally Curious: A drive to understand end-to-end business operations, data flows, and complex payment mechanics.

    • Rigorous & Analytical: Meticulous attention to detail with an ability to leverage data analytics to evaluate controls, transactions and processes objectively.

  • Languages: Fluency in French and English is required.

  • Communication: Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate clear findings and influence decision-making across lines of defence.

 

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram
