jobs.title: Représentant(e) commercial(e) - Marseille
jobs.description:
Salonkee est l'une des entreprises beauty-tech à la croissance la plus rapide en Europe. Nous aidons des milliers de salons à simplifier leurs opérations quotidiennes et à offrir une expérience client hors du commun.

Notre logiciel tout-en-un simplifie la prise de rendez-vous, les paiements et la gestion client, permettant ainsi aux professionnels de se concentrer sur l'essentiel : délivrer une prestation exceptionnelle. Nous sommes fiers de façonner l'avenir de l'industrie de la beauté grâce à l'innovation, la collaboration et une approche résolument humaine.

Après avoir digitalisé le secteur de la beauté dans plusieurs pays d'Europe, nous recherchons nos premiers commerciaux pour faire de la France une de nos plus grandes réussites.

L'opportunité

Rejoins notre équipe en tant que représentant(e) commercial(e) et deviens l'un des visages de la révolution digitale du secteur. Chez Salonkee, tu as l'opportunité unique de piloter des projets ambitieux, de collaborer avec des experts passionnés et de marquer de ton empreinte l'expansion d'une scale-up en plein essor.

Tes missions

  • Maîtrise du cycle de vente (A à Z) : tu pilotes l'intégralité du parcours d'acquisition de nouveaux clients pour Salonkee. Cela inclut la chasse initiale, la prise de rendez-vous qualifiés, la réalisation de démonstrations percutantes et le closing des contrats.

  • Ambassadeur(rice) de terrain : tu mènes des présentations produits directement sur site pour démontrer, avec clarté et conviction, la valeur ajoutée de nos solutions pour le business de tes clients.

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in Bioinformatics and Computational Biology
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a position as PhD Research Fellow in bioinformatics and computational biology available at the Department of Clinical Molecular Biology (EpiGen), Campus Ahus, University of Oslo.

 

The preferred starting date is as soon as possible.

 

The fellowship period is three years and is free of any teaching obligations. No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

 

The position is based at the Department of Clinical Molecular Biology (EpiGen; https://epigenahuscom.wordpress.com/) at the University of Oslo, Ahus Campus, Lørenskog. EpiGen is a joint research unit established by the University of Oslo (UiO) and Akershus University Hospital (Ahus). It is actively involved in several major national research initiatives and provides an outstanding research environment with state-of-the-art laboratories and dedicated research facilities. The position is funded by the Research Council of Norway.

 

 

The successful candidate will join an interdisciplinary team of molecular biologists, bioinformaticians, physicists, and pathologists to develop a biophysically interpretable machine learning model that integrates diverse biological data—including transcription factor (TF)–DNA interactions, epigenetic features, and three-dimensional (3D) genome organization—to identify functional long-range gene regulatory interactions in cancer. The candidate will work with researchers at UiO, Ahus, and Oslo University Hospital (OUS), as well as by international collaborators in the United States. The research conducted during the appointment is expected to culminate in a PhD thesis submitted to the University of Oslo.

 

We seek a highly motivated candidate with a strong background in molecular biology, human genetics/genomics, data mining, machine learning, and computational programming. The ideal candidate will hold a Master's degree in bioinformatics or computational biology. Applicants with an MSc in physics, computer science, applied mathematics, or statistics are also encouraged to apply, provided they can demonstrate a strong interest and aptitude for learning molecular biology and human genetics.


More about the position

The project aims to develop novel computational methods and tools for predicting functional non-coding mutations in the cancer genome. These methods will integrate diverse sources of information, including the biophysical principles of protein–DNA interactions, the genetic and epigenetic features of DNA sequences, and the three-dimensional (3D) organization of the genome and its regulatory landscape. A particular focus will be on integrating multi-omics data generated from single-cell experiments to improve both predictive accuracy and biological interpretability.

 

The PhD research fellow will primarily focus on developing data mining methods such as network analysis in 3D genome regulation that integrate diverse biological information, including transcription factor (TF)–DNA interactions, epigenetic features, and 3D genome organization, to identify functional non-coding mutations and their targets in long-distance regions. Subsequently, the predictions will be validated in cancer by using both in vivo and in vitro experimental data.

 

Depending on the candidate's qualifications and the progress of the project, there may be an opportunity to undertake a 3–6-month research visit to the laboratory of one of our international collaborators in the United States. This visit will provide advanced training in computational approaches for studying single-cell 3D genome regulation and further strengthen the international collaboration.


What skills are important in this role?

Candidates for the PhD fellowships will be expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

 

Required qualifications:

  • To be admitted to the PhDprogramme at the University ofOslo, an applicant musthave a five-year master'sdegree or equivalent studiesthat the faculty have recognised as forminga sufficient basisfor admission.
  • The facultiesmay stipulate additional admission requirements.
  • To be employed as aPhD ResearchFellow, admission toa doctoral program is required,or a binding agreementfor admission must be in place. Normally, one must apply foradmission to a Ph.D. program within3 months after thestart of the research project leading tothe Ph.D. degree.
  • Good written and oral Englishproficiency.
  • Master's degree in bioinformatics or computational biology. Applicants with an MSc in physics, computer science, applied mathematics, or statistics are also encouraged to apply, provided they can demonstrate a strong interest and aptitude for learning molecular biology and the human genome.
  • Documented knowledge of statistical theory and methods, data mining, and machine learning methods.
  • Documented shell script, R, Python, and C programming skills. 
  • Documented experience in big data analysis.
  • Documented experience in high-throughput sequencing data analysis.

 

Language requirement:

  • Good written and oral English proficiency.
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:
  • https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

 

Grade requirements:

  • The average grade point for the course in the Bachelor's degree must be C or better (Norwegian educational system)
  • The average grade point for the course in the Master's degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master's thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

 

 

 

Personal qualities 

  • Academic and personal ability to finish tasks on time
  • Ability to work either independently or collaboratively in an interdisciplinary team
  • Self-motivated to learn, easily adapted to new tasks, and interested in solving challenging scientific problems.
  • Good communication skills and openness to new perspectives

 

Desired qualifications

  • Experience with ChIP-seq, ATAC-seq/scATAC-seq, RNA-seq/scRNA-seq, WGS, WGBS, or Hi-C data analysis.
  • Experience in computational genome studies (e.g., TF-DNA interactions, gene networks, DNA mutations, and histone modifications). 
  • Experience with integrated multi-omics data analysis.aaa

 

Employment in the position is basedon a comprehensive assessment of allqualification requirements applicable tothe position, including 

personal qualifications.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We offer
  • Exciting and meaningfultasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing toknowledge development, education, andenlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, andknowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. A pleasantand stimulatingwork environment.
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5hours a week of exercise during working hours. A workplace with good development and careeropportunities.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes,with beneficialmortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in the position as DoctoralResearch Fellow, position code1017 in the salary range of NOK 550 800 -600 000, depending oncompetence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent isdeducted in statutory contributions to theState Pension Fund.
  • Read more about the benefitsof working in thepublic sector at Employer Portal.

Application

Your application should include:

  • Application cover letter (statement of motivation and research interests) 
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and academic work - scientific publications)
  • A copy of the Master's thesis, a list of publications and academic works (maximum 5) that you wish to be considered by the committee
  • Certified copies of the original Bachelor and Master's degree diploma and the transcripts of records
  • Documentation of English proficiency if applicable
  • Contact information for at least 3 references (name, relation to the candidate, institutional email address and telephone number)

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge’s CV form and cannot be submitted only as an attachment. This requirement is intended to ensure correct documentation and record-keeping in accordance with the Public Administration Act, Section 15.

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


Contact information 

For further information, please contact:

  • Junbai Wang, junbai.wang@medisin.uio.no

 

For questions regarding Jobbnorge, please

  • Maren Retterstøl Olaisen, HR advisor, m.r.olaisen@medisin.uio.no

Place of service:

Department of Clinical Molecular Biology (EpiGen)

University of Oslo, Ahus campus

1748 Lørenskog


General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews. 

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Institute of Clinical Medicine (Klinmed) is one of three institutes under the Faculty. Klinmed is responsible for the Faculty's educational and research activities at Oslo University Hospital and Akershus University Hospital. With about 900 employees spread over approximately 425 man-labour years, Klinmed is the university's largest institute. Our activities follow the clinical activity at the hospitals and are spread across a number of geographical areas.

jobs.title: Resepsjonist
jobs.description:
Resepsjonist – fast nattevakt 80 %

Thon Hotel Notodden

Vil du være den som sørger for at gjestene våre får en trygg, hyggelig og god start på dagen – også når resten av byen sover?

Thon Hotel Notodden søker nå en fast nattevakt til resepsjonen.

Hos oss er gjesten alltid i sentrum, og vi er stolte av å skape gode hotellopplevelser – fra gjesten sjekker inn, til de reiser videre med et smil. Vi ønsker oss derfor en trygg, selvstendig og serviceinnstilt person som trives med å jobbe på egen hånd og som liker å ha ansvar.

Som nattevakt hos oss får du en variert og viktig jobb

Natten på hotell handler om langt mer enn å sitte i resepsjonen. Du er hotellets ansikt utad når de fleste andre sover, og har ansvar for at gjestene våre føler seg trygge og ivaretatt gjennom natten.

Arbeidsoppgavene vil blant annet være:

  • Betjene resepsjonen og ta imot gjester som kommer sent

  • Håndtere innsjekk, utsjekk og gjestehenvendelser

  • Sørge for god service og være tilgjengelig for gjestene gjennom natten

  • Håndtere telefoner og forespørsler

  • Følge opp eventuelle hendelser og situasjoner som oppstår

  • Ha oversikt over hotellet og bidra til trygghet og sikkerhet gjennom natten

  • Utføre rutiner knyttet til nattarbeid og dagsoppgjør

  • Kontrollere og klargjøre fellesområder

  • Sørge for at hotellet er ryddig og innbydende til morgenen

  • Forberede og klargjøre frokosten

  • Sørge for at frokostområdet er klart når de første gjestene kommer

  • Ta imot våre morgenfugler og bidra til en hyggelig start på dagen

  • Følge opp tidlige utsjekker og gjester som skal tidlig videre

  • Utføre andre forefallende oppgaver som naturlig hører til en nattevakt på hotell

Frokosten er viktig for oss!

For oss er frokosten en viktig del av hotellopplevelsen. Den skal ikke bare være på plass – den skal være innbydende, ryddig og gi gjestene våre en god start på dagen.

Som nattevakt vil du derfor ha en viktig rolle i å gjøre frokosten klar før resten av hotellet våkner. Du må like å ha orden, være nøye og ha et øye for detaljer.

Når den første gjesten kommer inn til frokost, skal det være hyggelig å møte dagen hos oss.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi tror du passer godt hos oss hvis du:

  • Er serviceinnstilt, positiv og imøtekommende

  • Trives med å jobbe selvstendig

  • Er ansvarsbevisst og trygg på å ta egne avgjørelser

  • Har godt humør – også på natt

  • over 20 år

  • Har sans for orden og detaljer

  • Takler uforutsette situasjoner på en rolig og profesjonell måte

  • Liker å møte mennesker fra mange forskjellige steder

  • Forstår betydningen av god gjesteservice

  • Er fleksibel og løsningsorientert

  • Trives med nattarbeid og liker å ha ansvar

Hotellerfaring er en fordel, men ikke et absolutt krav. Det viktigste for oss er hvem du er, hvordan du møter mennesker og at du har lyst til å skape gode gjesteopplevelser.

Hos oss blir du en del av laget

Thon Hotels legger stor vekt på menneskene som jobber på hotellene, og på mulighetene for utvikling internt. Norlandia Hotel Group beskriver også medarbeiderne som sin viktigste ressurs og legger stor vekt på å skape ekstraordinære gjesteopplevelser og gjøre det lille ekstra for gjesten.

På Thon Hotel Notodden blir du en del av et hyggelig hotellteam hvor vi spiller hverandre gode og jobber sammen for å gi gjestene våre en best mulig opplevelse.

Vi er et hotell med 60 rom, midt i sentrum av Notodden, og har både fritidsreisende, forretningsreisende, konferansegjester og andre besøkende gjennom året.

Vi kan tilby

  • Fast stilling som nattevakt

  • En selvstendig og variert arbeidshverdag

  • Et hyggelig arbeidsmiljø

  • Møte med mange forskjellige mennesker

  • Mulighet til å utvikle deg innen hotell og reiseliv

  • En jobb hvor du faktisk gjør en forskjell for gjestenes hotellopplevelse

Arbeidstid: Natt – etter oppsatt turnus.

Arbeidssted: Thon Hotel Notodden, Torvet 8, 3674 Notodden.

⭐ Er du vår nye nattevakt?

Hvis du liker å jobbe når andre sover, trives med ansvar og synes det er givende å sørge for at andre får en god natt og en enda bedre morgen – da vil vi gjerne høre fra deg!

Vi behandler søknader fortløpenede, og gjennomfører intervjuer løpende.

Ansettelse: snarest

Send oss en søknad og fortell litt om deg selv og hvorfor du har lyst til å bli en del av teamet på Thon Hotel Notodden.

Norlandia Hotel Group drifter totalt 37 enheter i Norge og Sverige.

jobs.title: HR Business Partner to Husqvarna Group
jobs.description:
We’re one of the world’s oldest start-ups — and we’re just getting started.

At Husqvarna Group, innovation is in our DNA. With over 330 years of heritage and a passion for pioneering technology, we design and deliver world class products and solutions for forest, park, garden and construction care. From robotic lawn mowers to cutting-edge chainsaws and sustainable battery systems, we’re shaping the future — and we want you to be part of it.

Are you an experienced HR professional who enjoys working close to the business and has a genuine interest in technology, people and change? Then this could be the role for you. We are looking for an HR Business Partner to work closely with our R&D organization in Huskvarna. You will support leaders and teams at the heart of our product development – an environment where engineering, technology and innovation come together to shape the products and solutions of tomorrow.

R&D is going through significant change. New technologies are changing not only what we develop, but also the capabilities we need and how we organize our work. As an HR Business Partner, you will play an important role in helping our leaders navigate that change and build an organization ready for the future.

About the role:

You will work closely with R&D managers on both day-to-day HR matters and longer-term people and organizational topics. The role covers a broad range of HR processes, but a particular focus will be on supporting transformation, capability development and organizational development.

Together with your stakeholders and HR colleagues, you will identify needs, challenge existing ways of working and turn business priorities into practical people initiatives. You will be expected to take ownership, bring your perspective to the table and help create the conditions for our people and teams to perform and develop.

About you:

We are looking for someone with solid experience, approximately 5-10 years, within HR and a relevant university degree. You understand the fundamentals of HR, but you are equally interested in understanding the business behind them.

You are curious about technology and comfortable working in an environment where priorities and capability needs evolve. You enjoy getting close to the organization, asking questions and understanding what is really happening before jumping to solutions.

Building strong relationships comes naturally to you. You communicate clearly, collaborate well with different stakeholders and are comfortable both supporting and challenging leaders when needed. Experience of working with organizational change, transformation or capability development would be particularly valuable.

Your skills and background:

    5-10 years of experience in HR, preferably in a business-facing role and relevant university degree.
    Experience in organizational change, transformation, or capability development.
    Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
    Fluent in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.

Location

Our Husqvarna office

How we work  

We believe the best ideas happen when we're connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive. This is a role where being close to the organization matters. You will therefore spend a significant part of your time together with your stakeholders at our office in Huskvarna.

Your Application:

Apply as soon as possible. We are screening on an ongoing basis and will fill this position as soon as we have found the right person. For more information about the position, contact hiring manager Addis Doric on addis.doric@husqvarnagroup.com  For questions regarding the process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Kristin Sundlo on Kristin.sundlo@husqvarnagroup.com

Processing of personal data

When you send in your application we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we may ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer.

For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and your rights, please see our privacy notice.

Winning Through Culture

At Husqvarna Group, you'll find an international, inclusive, and diverse environment with plenty of opportunities for personal and professional growth. We believe our differences are our strengths, and we live a culture based on three pillars: We’re Bold, We’re Dedicated, and We Care

As part of our HR community, you will have colleagues in Huskvarna as well as across the globe to collaborate with, learn from and contribute to. If you want to work close to technology, people and change – and help shape the capabilities and organization we need for the future – we'd be happy to hear from you.

jobs.title: Customer Service Representative
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Customer Service Representative to join Stronger for a one-year maternity cover starting in January 2027.

At Stronger, Customer Service is an important part of the entire customer journey. We are looking for someone who combines a genuine passion for service with a strong technical understanding, a solution-oriented mindset and confidence working across different digital systems.

The Role

As a Customer Service Representative, you will support our customers across email, chat and some phone support, helping with everything from product and order questions to deliveries, returns, payments and technical issues related to the e-commerce journey.

You will work closely with other teams within Stronger and play an important role in identifying recurring customer issues, sharing insights and contributing to improvements in our customer experience and internal processes.

Key Responsibilities

    Provide professional and solution-oriented customer service via email, chat and phone.
    Assist customers with products, orders, deliveries, returns and payments.
    Investigate and troubleshoot technical and system-related issues.
    Work across several systems and platforms to resolve customer cases.
    Collaborate with E-commerce, Operations, Logistics and Tech when needed.
    Identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve processes and the customer journey.
    Work towards Customer Service KPIs and shared team goals.

Who We’re Looking For

You are proactive, structured and solution-oriented, with a genuine interest in providing great customer service. You enjoy taking ownership and are comfortable working both independently and as part of a team.

Technical understanding and system confidence are important in this role. You don't need to be a developer, but you should enjoy understanding how systems work, investigating problems and finding solutions.

We are looking for someone who has:

    Previous Customer Service experience, preferably within e-commerce or a digital environment.
    Strong technical aptitude and confidence working across multiple digital systems.
    Good problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
    The ability to work in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high service quality.
    Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.

Meritorious Experience

It is a strong advantage if you have experience with:

    Zendesk
    Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central
    Centra
    Technical troubleshooting within e-commerce
    Automation, AI-supported customer service tools or similar technologies
    Additional languages – German is particularly meritorious, as well as French or Dutch

How to Apply

Please send your CV and personal letter to madelene@stronger.se

In your application, we would especially like you to highlight if you have experience in any of the systems, technical areas or additional languages listed above, including your level of proficiency.

Please use “Customer Service Representative – Maternity Cover” as the subject line.

Employment: Maternity cover, approximately 12 months, 80%

Start date: January 2027

Location: Stockholm

We look forward to hearing from you!

Det jag uppskattar mest med att jobba här är gemenskapen och känslan att vi verkligen finns där för varandra. Både i det lilla och det stora stöttar vi varandra, och man behöver aldrig känna sig ensam. Det är en trygg och fin arbetsplats där man får fråga, lära sig och växa tillsammans. - Malin

jobs.title: Founding Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
Who we are looking for

As our Founding Business Development Representative (BDR), you'll be the engine behind our sales pipeline - the first Birdsview person many prospects talk to. You'll open doors across Europe and beyond, working closely with our sales team to turn interest into qualified opportunities.

Birdsview - Prolonging the lifetime of the built world

Birdsview is a Norwegian technology company on a mission to change the way we preserve critical infrastructure to ensure a more sustainable and secure future.

Infrastructure is one of society’s most important assets. It includes the buildings we live in, the bridges we cross and the power grid that provides us with electricity. These structures are aging rapidly, and solutions that help preserve and secure critical infrastructure are now needed more than ever.

Birdsview's state-of-the-art technology combines radar (GPR), lidar, and AI to visualize what’s inside structures without destructive interventions. This allows for efficient and cost-effective inspection and monitoring of our most precious infrastructures - and enables clear, user-friendly visualizations that enhance understanding, extend asset lifespan, and promote material reuse - ultimately reducing costs and CO₂ emissions.

We are 17 people, we have customers in 9 countries, and we raised NOK 40.5 million from leading Nordic VC's to scale internationally.

About the job and why it matters

Much of concrete inspection today still relies on manual methods and fragmented, ageing non-destructive testing (NDT) equipment. You will help structural engineers, contractors, surveying specialists, and asset owners see clearly what is hidden inside the concrete. New critical data, faster inspections, and real cost savings are why they want our technology in their daily projects.

As a Founding BDA, you will be the engine behind our international growth. The role is to reach the right prospects, understand the problems they face, and show them what our technology does. You will build target account lists in HubSpot, make cold calls, drive LinkedIn and email outreach, and book qualified meetings for our sales team. This is a foundational role in a newly established sales team, where you will have a direct impact on our strategy, processes, and success.

  • Build the target list
    Research accounts across Europe and North America, and find the people who actually make the decision.

  • Run outbound
    Personalised outreach by phone, email and LinkedIn - plus follow-up on inbound leads and contacts from conferences.

  • Qualify and book
    Qualify opportunities, book meetings for the sales team, and keep our CRM clean enough that we can see what works.

  • Know the product and the market
    Deeply enough to have real conversations, not scripted ones.

  • Sharpen the message
    Feed back what you hear from prospects so marketing can build on it.

What we're looking for

  • Hunger and dedication to win.

  • Clear writing, thoughtful research, and confidence on the phone.

  • Outbound experience in SaaS, tech or another B2B role is a plus, not a requirement. Able to build pipeline yourself.

  • Organised and self-driven.

  • Comfortable working in a CRM. We use HubSpot.

  • At home where the process is still being figured out, you're helping figuring it out.

  • Fluent in English. Norwegian, German, Spanish or French is a strong plus given where our customers are.

Why this is interesting

  • Top-tier colleagues
    Work alongside leading people in a supportive and ambitious team culture, with regular social events and company trips.

  • Build it yourself
    Be a foundational member, directly shaping our international sales strategy and playbook.

  • Room to grow
    We're building the commercial team right now. What you own in a year depends on what you build in the first six months.

  • Impact
    Make a tangible impact on preserving critical infrastructure and fostering a circular economy.

  • Compensation
    Competitive salary, commission, and equity - become an owner.

  • Location
    Work in Bergen or Oslo with a fast-moving, hands-on team. Excellent working facilities at StartupLab centrally located in both cities.

View the full details for the job here.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Bioinformatics and Computational Biology
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a Postdoctoral Research Fellow position in Bioinformatics and Computational Biology at the Department of Clinical Molecular Biology (EpiGen), Campus Ahus, University of Oslo.
The preferred starting date is as soon as possible.
The appointment is for a period of three years. In accordance with University of Oslo regulations, no individual may be appointed to more than one Postdoctoral Research Fellowship period at the University.


The position is based at the Department of Clinical Molecular Biology (EpiGen) at the University of Oslo, Campus Ahus, Lørenskog. EpiGen is a joint research unit established by the University of Oslo (UiO) and Akershus University Hospital (Ahus). The department is actively involved in several major national research initiatives and offers an outstanding research environment with state-of-the-art laboratories, advanced computational infrastructure, and dedicated research facilities. The position is funded by the Research Council of Norway.
The successful candidate will join an interdisciplinary research team comprising molecular biologists, bioinformaticians, physicists, and pathologists. The project aims to develop a biophysically interpretable machine learning framework that integrates diverse biological data—including transcription factor (TF)–DNA interactions, epigenomic features, and three-dimensional (3D) genome organization—to identify functional long-range gene regulatory interactions in cancer. The postdoctoral researcher will collaborate closely with students, PhD candidates, researchers, and national and international partners. The work is expected to result in high-quality scientific publications as well as broadly applicable computational resources, such as open-source software and bioinformatics tools.

 

We seek a highly motivated and ambitious researcher with a strong background in molecular biology, human genetics/genomics, bioinformatics, machine learning, data mining, and computational programming, including software or package development. The ideal candidate will hold a PhD in bioinformatics or computational biology. Applicants with a PhD in related disciplines, such as computer science, physics, applied mathematics, statistics, or a closely related quantitative field, are also encouraged to apply, provided they demonstrate a strong interest in and commitment to applying computational methods to molecular biology and human genetics/genomics.


More about the position

The project aims to develop novel computational methods and tools for predicting functional non-coding mutations in the cancer genome. These methods will integrate diverse sources of biological information, including the biophysical principles governing protein–DNA interactions, the genetic and epigenetic features of DNA sequences, and the three-dimensional (3D) organization of the genome and its regulatory landscape. A particular emphasis will be placed on integrating multi-omics data generated from single-cell experiments to enhance both predictive accuracy and biological interpretability.


The Postdoctoral Research Fellow will primarily focus on developing a biophysically interpretable machine learning framework that integrates multiple layers of biological information, including transcription factor (TF)–DNA interactions, epigenetic features, and 3D genome organization, to identify functional long-range gene regulatory interactions from in vivo data. The candidate will also be involved in the validation of predictions from cancer genomes.
 

Throughout the fellowship, the Postdoctoral Research Fellow will be supported by a structured career development plan. This may include opportunities to teach and supervise bioinformatics students, present research at international conferences, and undertake research visits to leading international laboratories. The fellowship is designed to equip the candidate with the scientific expertise, professional skills, and international research experience needed to pursue a competitive research career within or beyond academia. The University of Oslo (UiO) is committed to supporting the Fellow's career development by providing ongoing mentoring and access to career guidance throughout the postdoctoral appointment.


About the position

You must have
To be appointed as a postdoctoral fellow, a doctoral degree is required.

  • Good written and oral English proficiency.
  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in bioinformatics, computational biology, or other relevant research fields to the project. The doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the application deadline. Only applicants with an approved doctoral thesis and public defense are eligible for appointment.
  • Personal suitability and motivation for the project.
  • Documented knowledge of statistical theory and methods, data mining, and machine learning methods.
  • Documented shell script, R, Python, and C programming skills.
  • Documented experience in big data analysis and computational tool/package development.
  • Documented experience in high-throughput sequencing data analysis or computational genome regulation.
     

Personal qualities
 

  • Academic and personal ability to finish tasks on time
  • Ability to work either independently or collaboratively in an interdisciplinary team
  • Self-motivated to learn, easily adapted to new tasks, and interested in solving challenging scientific problems.

  • Good communication skills and openness to new perspectives

     

Desired qualifications
Experience with ChIP-seq, ATAC-seq/scATAC-seq, RNA-seq/scRNA-seq, WGS, WGBS, or Hi-C data analysis
Experience in computational genome studies (e.g., TF-DNA interactions, gene networks, DNA mutations, and histone modifications).
Experience with integrated multi-omics data analysis and software/package tool development

 

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.
 


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We offer
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. A pleasant and stimulating work environment
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours. A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in the position as Postdoctoral Fellow, position code 1352, in a salary range from NOK 595000 to 679000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.
  • Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.

Application

Your application should include:

  • Application cover letter (statement of motivation and research interests)

Har du interesse for sosiale medier, er det et pluss – men ikke et krav 👍

Er dette noe for deg?

jo-bpa@hotmail.com
951 32 813

Tiltredelse snarest

jobs.title: BPA assistent søkes til aktiv og glad gutt på 11 år – Drammen, Åssiden
jobs.description:
Vi søker en trygg, ansvarsfull og aktiv BPA assistent til vår hyggelige gutt på 11 år som bor sammen med familien sin på Åssiden i Drammen.

Han er en blid og sosial gutt som liker å være sammen med andre. Han er veldig glad i å være ute og ønsker å være aktiv, og vi ser derfor etter en BPA assistent, som kan bidra til en trygg, men samtidig morsom og innholdsrik hverdag.

Han liker blant annet å være ute, være sammen med dyr, huske, spille litt piano og synge. Han kan si noen ord og korte setninger, men har begrenset evne til kommunikasjon og trenger derfor en voksen som er tålmodig, oppmerksom og flink til å forstå hans behov og signaler.

Om ham

Han har autisme og moderat psykisk utviklingshemming. Han trenger hjelp og veiledning i de fleste deler av hverdagen.

Han har ikke tilstrekkelig forståelse for fare og trenger derfor tett oppfølging og en voksen som tar ansvar for sikkerheten hans. Det er viktig at du er oppmerksom, trygg og i stand til å handle raskt dersom det oppstår situasjoner som krever det.

Han klarer å gå på toalettet selv og kan tørke seg, men trenger fortsatt påminnelser og veiledning, blant annet om hva han skal gjøre og om håndvask.

Han trenger også hjelp til blant annet:

  • personlig hygiene og påminnelser i hverdagen

  • matlaging og tilrettelegging rundt måltider

  • å komme seg trygt ut på aktiviteter

  • aktiviteter og lek

  • å være sammen med andre

  • struktur og veiledning gjennom dagen

  • å ivareta sikkerheten hans

Arbeidstid

Arbeidet vil hovedsakelig være:

  • ettermiddager og kvelder

  • helger

  • skole- og feriedager/fridager

  • det kan også bli aktuelt med enkelte nattevakter etter avtale

En viktig del av jobben vil være å finne på og gjennomføre aktiviteter sammen med ham, særlig utendørs aktiviteter. Vi ønsker en BPA assistent som liker å være aktiv og som kan bidra til at han får oppleve mestring, glede og gode opplevelser.


Vi ser etter deg som

  • er trygg, tålmodig og omsorgsfull

  • tar jobben og ansvaret på alvor

  • er stabil og pålitelig

  • liker å være aktiv og være ute

  • er oppmerksom og kan ha oversikt over situasjonen

  • kan følge rutiner og samtidig være fleksibel

  • har respekt for ham og ser gutten bak diagnosene

  • gjerne har erfaring med barn, autisme eller utviklingshemming, men personlig egnethet er svært viktig

  • har førerkort

  • gjerne har tilgang til egen bil

Vi ser fortrinnsvis etter en person i alderen 20–45 år, men det viktigste er at du er riktig person for jobben.

Hvem er du?

Du trenger ikke være perfekt eller ha alle svarene fra første dag. Det viktigste for oss er at du er en trygg voksen som møter ham med respekt, tålmodighet og godt humør.

Vi ønsker en person som kan bli en trygg og positiv del av hverdagen hans – en som både kan ta ansvar når det trengs og samtidig være med på å skape gode, morsomme og aktive opplevelser.

Hvis du kjenner deg igjen i dette og tror du kan passe godt sammen med vår gutt, håper vi å høre fra deg!


Hvorfor skal du velge Humana?

Hos Humana er du mer enn bare en ansatt. Vi er opptatt av din trivsel, og du får god oppfølging fra dag én. Du blir en del av et støttende assistent-team, og vi tilbyr både veiledning og kurs for at du skal lykkes i jobben.

Dette er noe av det du får ved å jobbe hos oss:

  • Veiledning og opplæring

Humana omsorg og assistanse utvikler og leverer omsorgs- og assistansetjenester etter enkeltmenneskers behov og samfunnets ønsker. Vi yter tjenester innenfor områdene helse og omsorg, brukerstyrt personlig assistanse, barnevern institusjon og fosterhjem, praktisk bistand og hjelpetiltak.

jobs.title: Researcher in Environmental Psychology
jobs.employer: NTNU FAKULTET FOR SAMFUNNS OG UTDANNINGSVITENSKAP
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You can find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the Job

We have a vacancy for a researcher at the Department of Psychology in the research group for Citizens, Environment and Safety for 2 years. 

The position combines work in three externally funded projects: 

(1)  The HARMONI project aims to develop a comprehensive knowledge toolbox for hybrid products that combine the benefits of cultivated and plant-based meat alternatives, enabling the creation of appealing new food concepts and expanding future food choices. To achieve this, HARMONI brings together a consortium of Cellular Agriculture and Bioprocess Engineering (Technical University of Munich), Meat Science, Cultivated Muscle Cells and Nutrition (Aarhus University), Material Science and Microbial Systems (Katholieke Universiteit Leuven), Sustainable Food Systems (University of Helsinki), and Environmental and Consumer Psychology (NTNU), complemented by leading industrial partners. The part of NTNU is to study consumer perceptions of such products with focus group interviews, experiments and surveys. Data is likely collected in Norway, Germany, Belgium, and Finnland.

(2)    The cells4energy project is a real-world laboratory for 100% renewable energy systems. At its core lies the systemic energy cell approach, where locally generated renewable energy is intelligently stored, utilized, and interconnected with other cells. Through digital technologies and innovative business models, we test in real-world environments how a flexible, resilient, and scalable energy supply can be achieved for the future. The task for NTNU in this project is to implement and analyse the results from an automatized internet-based intervention platform to motivate energy saving. Data will be collected in Austria. 

(3)    The SaferClay project is a research project focusing on developing methods to assess changes in quick clay landslide risk with time. SAFERCLAY will provide a new approach for adapted and sustainable risk management for living and building in quick clay areas, including recommendations to ensure both public and environmental safety. NTNUs task in this project is analysing perceptions of quick clay and its effects on behaviour in different stakeholder groups. A survey has been designed and is currently implemented in Norway. 

What binds the work in all three projects together is the focus on collecting citizen / stakeholder perceptions on novel products, risk factors, and behaviour interventions. In all three projects, these will primarily be studied with quantitative methods, thus excellent knowledge of quantitative analysis methods, data curation and handling, as well as designing research and surveys is essential. 

Your immediate leader is the head of department.


Duties of the position
  • Designing surveys, experiments and qualitative interviews with the respective project groups
  • Implementation of data collections (in cells4energy coordinated with an external technology provider for the internet platform)
  • Data cleaning and curation
  • Data analyses (mainly quantitative, but also qualitatitve)
  • Preparation of research papers based on the analyses
  • Feedback and coordination with the research partners
     

Required selection criteria
  • A finished degree or PhD in psychology with a specialization in environmental psychology, social psychology, behavioural psychology or closely related fields
  • Excellent skills in data management, curation and complex statistical analysis (e.g. structural equation modelling)
  • Experience in empirical work in the field
  • Good written and oral English skills

Preferred selection criteria
  • Experience with work in interdisciplinary fields
  • Experience with project management
  • Ability to communicate in at least one of the languages data in the different projects will be collected in (Norwegian, German, Finnish, Flemish, French) in addition to English
  • Experience with qualitative work

Personal characteristics
  • Flexibility
  • Ability to structure your work and handle three projects at the same time
  • Openness for collaboration with other disciplines and practice partners

We offer
  • exciting and stimulating tasks in a strong international academic environment
  • an open and inclusive work environment with dedicated colleagues
  • favourable terms in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
  • employee benefits

Salary and conditions

As a researcher (code 1109) you are normally paid from gross NOK 633 400 per annum before tax, depending on qualifications and seniority. As required by law, 2% of this salary will be deducted and paid into the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund.

The position is subject to external funding.

The engagement is to be made in accordance with the regulations in force concerning State Employees and Civil Servants, and the acts relating to Control of the Export of Strategic Goods, Services and Technology. Candidates who by assessment of the application and attachment are seen to conflict with the criteria in the latter law will be prohibited from recruitment to NTNU.   

After the appointment you must assume that there may be changes in the area of work. For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.  


About the application

Your application and supporting documentation must be in English.

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English. 
Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.
If, for any reason, you have taken a career break or have had an atypical career and wish to disclose this in your application, the selection committee will take this into account, recognizing that the quantity of your research may be reduced as a result.

Your application must include:

  • CV, diplomas, and certificates
  • A motivation letter (max 2 pages) outlining your motivation and fit for the position
  • Academic works – published or unpublished – that you wish to be considered during assessment of your application (up to 5 items)
  • A description of the scientific/artistic works you consider most relevant, which you particularly wish to be factored into the assessment
  • A complete publication list
  • Details of projects for which you have served as project manager or had a significant position in, including information on financing, duration, and scope
  • Names and contact information for three relevant referees

It is important that you both document and reflect on your competence. You are encouraged to use the NTNUs competence matrix as a guide for documentation of your competence.

Joint work will also be considered. If it is difficult to identify your specific input to a joint project, you must include evidence of your contributions. 

In the evaluation of which candidate is best qualified, emphasis will be placed on education, experience and personal and interpersonal qualities. Motivation, ambitions, and potential will also count in the assessment of the candidates. Open scientific practice will be recognized.

NTNU is obliged by the evaluation criteria for research quality in accordance with The San Fransisco Declaration on Research Assessment – DORA and The obligations in the Coalition for Advancing Research Assessment ( CoARA) on responsible assessment of research and recognition of a wider range of academic contributions to science and society. This means that we will pay particular attention to the quality and academic range demonstrated by your scientific work to date. We will also pay attention to research leadership and participation in research projects. Your scientific work from the last five years will be given the most weight.

Your application will be considered by a committee at the department. Candidates of interest will be invited to an interview.


General information

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse, and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals.   

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education.  

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability, and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time. 

As an employee at NTNU, you must continually maintain and improve your professional development and be flexible regarding any organizational changes.

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you want to reserve yourself from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the reservation is not accepted.

For the sake of transparency, candidates will be given expert evaluations of their own and other candidates. As an applicant you are considered part of the process and are stipulated by rules of confidentiality.

jobs.title: Helsefasgarbeider, 100 % fast stilling
jobs.description:
Helsefagarbeider søkes til hjemmetjenesten i Lunner kommune – vil du gjøre en forskjell i folks hverdag? 

Vil du være med på å skape trygghet og gode tjenester for mennesker i eget hjem? 

Hjemmetjenesten i Lunner avdeling Harestua søker en engasjert og faglig trygg helsefagarbeider til 100 % fast stilling. Stillingen inngår i turnus med dag- og aftenvakter og arbeid hver 3. helg. 

Om oss: 

Hjemmetjenesten i Lunner kommune består av to avdelinger som samarbeider tett på tvers ved hjelp av elektronisk ruteplanlegger. Vi holder til i moderne lokaler ved Lunner helse- og omsorgssenter og Roa aktivitets- og omsorgssenter.

Som vår nye kollega blir du en del av et godt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med:

  • 11 sykepleiere
  • 2 fagsykepleiere
  • En erfaren og kompetent gruppe helsefagarbeidere

Vi legger stor vekt på faglig kvalitet, samarbeid og et godt arbeidsmiljø. 

Hos oss får du en variert og meningsfull arbeidshverdag der du møter mennesker med ulike behov og får bruke kompetansen din til å gjøre en forskjell.

Vi ønsker oss en kollega som liker å arbeide selvstendig, samtidig som du verdsetter samarbeid og det å være en del av et godt fagmiljø. I hjemmetjenesten møter du mennesker i ulike livssituasjoner, og ingen arbeidsdager er helt like.

Arbeidsoppgaver/ansvarsområde

Som helsefagarbeider hos oss vil du blant annet:

  • Gi nødvendig helsehjelp, pleie og omsorg til hjemmeboende brukere
  • Observere, vurdere og følge opp endringer i brukernes helsetilstand
  • Utføre legemiddelhåndtering etter gjeldende kompetanse, opplæring og prosedyrer
  • Bidra til at brukerne opplever trygghet, mestring og størst mulig grad av selvstendighet i hverdagen
  • Dokumentere og rapportere i kommunens elektroniske journalsystem
  • Samarbeide tett med sykepleiere, helsefagarbeidere og øvrige faggrupper
  • Samarbeide med pårørende, fastleger og andre aktuelle samarbeidspartnere
  • Bidra aktivt til fagutvikling, kvalitetsarbeid og et godt arbeidsmiljø
  • Veilede elever, lærlinger og kollegaer ved behov 
Kvalifikasjonskrav

Vi søker deg som:

  • Har norsk autorisasjon som helsefagarbeider/hjelpepleier
  • Har gode norskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig
    • Ved fremmedspråklig bakgrunn kreves dokumentert bestått norsk B1
  • Har grunnleggende digitale ferdigheter og er komfortabel med bruk av elektroniske arbeidsverktøy
  • Har førerkort klasse B 

Det er ønskelig at du har:

  • Erfaring fra hjemmetjeneste, kommunehelsetjeneste eller tilsvarende arbeid
  • Erfaring med personer med sammensatte og varierte helseutfordringer
  • Kompetanse innen legemiddelhåndtering
  • Interesse for fagutvikling og velferdsteknologi

Vi oppfordrer også nyutdannede helsefagarbeidere til å søke. 

Personlige egenskaper

For å trives i hjemmetjenesten tror vi at du:

  • Er trygg, omsorgsfull og respektfull i møte med brukere og pårørende
  • Har gode samarbeidsevner og bidrar positivt til arbeidsmiljøet
  • Er selvstendig og tar ansvar for egne arbeidsoppgaver
  • Er strukturert og klarer å prioritere når arbeidshverdagen endrer seg
  • Er fleksibel og løsningsorientert
  • Har gode kommunikasjonsferdigheter
  • Er faglig nysgjerrig og ønsker å utvikle deg
  • Ser den enkelte bruker og er opptatt av brukermedvirkning, mestring og gode tjenester

Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt. 

Politiattest

Tilfredsstillende politiattest, ikke eldre enn tre måneder, må leveres før tiltredelse i stilling. Politiattest med merknader som innebærer yrkesforbud etter Helse- og omsorgstjenestelovens § 5-4a, vil medføre at tilbud om stilling bortfaller. 

Det forutsettes at krav til tuberkulosekontroll er oppfylt.  

Lønns og arbeidsvilkårVi kan tilby:
  • Gode låne-, forsikrings- og pensjonsordning gjennom KLP
  • Fri gruppelivs- og ulykkesforsikring
  • Inkluderende arbeidslivsordning
  • Lønn etter avtale  
  • En variert og meningsfull arbeidshverdag
  • Et arbeidsmiljø med dyktige og engasjerte kollegaer
  • Mulighet til å utvikle deg faglig og bidra til videre utvikling av hjemmetjenesten
  • Selvstendige og varierte arbeidsoppgaver

 

 

Vi ønsker et arbeidsmiljø preget av mangfold, og at våre ansatte skal gjenspeile befolkningen for øvrig. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert til å søke jobb hos oss uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, eller minoritetsbakgrunn. Vi legger vekt på å tilrettelegge arbeidsforholdene dersom du har behov for det.

Etter søknadsfristens utløp, vil det bli satt opp en offentlig søkerliste inneholdende navn, alder, stilling eller yrkestittel og bosteds- eller arbeidskommune for hver søker. Det kan gjøres unntak fra innsyn for opplysninger om en søker dersom vedkommende selv ber om det. Opplysninger om en søker kan bli offentlige selv om søkeren har anmodet om ikke å bli ført opp på søkerlisten. Dersom anmodningen ikke blir tatt til følge vil søkeren bli varslet om dette, jf. Offentleglova § 25.

Tjenesteområdet Helse og mestring i Lunner kommune skal levere tjenester av høy kvalitet. Virksomhetene er inne i en spennende utvikling, med fokus på hverdagsmestring, kompetanse og tjenesteutvikling. Nye omsorgsboliger på Roa og nytt helse- og omsorgssenter på Harestua er tatt i bruk. . jobs.title: Head of Formal Verification (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Your mission

You own the direction of our formal verification business. Our managers keep delivery predictable. You decide what the organisation becomes.

You report to the CEO and are a member of the executive leadership team. You carry the FV consulting business as a whole — where it goes, how it performs, who leads it — and you answer for it. You will not solve verification problems, and you will rarely run a project or an account yourself. Concretely, you own:

  • Direction. The roadmap for FV consulting. Which capabilities, markets and problem domains we pursue, and what we decline.
  • Customers. You are the face of LUBIS EDA to our key accounts and at executive level. You open the doors your managers cannot, and you carry the conversations that decide a long-term relationship.
  • Organisation. Structure, standards, playbooks, talent pipelines, and the career framework in practice. You keep improving how we work, and you decide when a new technology — AI among them — changes the way we deliver.
  • Leaders. Our Verification Managers report to you. You hire them, develop them, and grow the bench behind them. This is the main measure of the role.
  • Quality. Holding the quality bar under commercial pressure. Our entire positioning depends on it.
  • Product interface. What our engineers learn on customer projects is the best input our software roadmap gets.


Your profile

You have developed leaders, not "only" engineers. You have set direction where there was no precedent, made the calls, and carried an organisation with you. You build systems that outlast your attention.

You need credibility in formal verification. Not to overrule your senior engineers. You need it to make the calls only you can make: is a capability gap real, is a quality standard achievable at the price we quote, does a bet on a new formal domain hold.

YOUR EXPERIENCE

  • 12+ years in semiconductor verification, EDA or adjacent engineering services.
  • 5+ years in leadership, including managers reporting to you.
  • Fluent in formal methods and their trade-offs. Credible with a customer’s engineering leadership and on a conference stage.
  • You know how technical services are priced and defended on quality rather than volume.
  • Nice-to-have: you have scaled a technical organisation past start-up stage, where the systems had to be built.


Why us?

LUBIS is growing, and we’re looking for a Head of Formal Verification.

This is one of those roles where you don’t just join an organisation. You help build it.

Our formal sign-off business is growing. Our customers are getting bigger. So are our ambitions. We’re looking for someone who wants real ownership of what comes next: how we develop our people, how we deliver outstanding projects, how we work with our customers, and what world-class technical consulting at LUBIS should look like.

You’ll work directly with our leadership team. You’ll have the freedom to shape structures and standards. You’ll build an organisation around some of the strongest formal verification expertise in the market.

We’re not looking for someone to maintain what already exists. We’re looking for someone who gets excited about making it better, bigger and more professional.

If you want a leadership role with real influence, and the chance to build something you’ll be proud of, come build it with us.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow at the interaction between information systems and machine learning
jobs.employer: OSLO UNIVERSITETSSYKEHUS HF BEDRIFTSHELSETJENESTE OSLO UNIVERSITETSSYKEHUS
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a Postdoctoral Research Fellow position in action-oriented modeling for trustworthy AI, available at the Department of Informatics, University of Oslo.

The starting date is no later than 01.03.2027 and as soon as possible after the appointment.

The appointment is a full-time position for a period of three years.

The fellowship is funded in full by TRUST for the whole period. No teaching, supervision, or research-assistance duties are required in the position, and the fellowship period can therefore not be extended to four years on that basis.

No one can be appointed for more than one Postdoctoral Research Fellowship at the University of Oslo.

The place of work is the Department of Informatics at the University of Oslo. The successful candidate will be part of the daily research and social life of TRUST – the Norwegian Centre for Trustworthy AI, and of the information systems research group.


Project description

The position is funded by TRUST, the Norwegian Centre for Trustworthy AI, which is a research centre dedicated to developing trustworthy AI systems that are accurate, fair, transparent, safe, and well-governed. The centre brings together researchers from computational and data science, law, social sciences, and philosophy to develop new AI technologies and study their societal impact in areas such as healthcare, industry, governance, security, and climate. TRUST is led by University of Oslo, SINTEF, and Norwegian Computing Center. With a consortium of over 70 partners from academia, industry, government, and civil society in Norway and internationally, TRUST’s research is theoretical, methodological, legal, and empirical in nature.

The postdoc will conduct the research project Action-Oriented Modeling for Trustworthy AI in Practice. The project addresses a persistent problem in applied AI: statistically accurate models routinely fail when they meet the organizations and ecosystems meant to use them. Models are misaligned with local procedures and decision processes, too rigid for resource-constrained operational systems, and opaque to the decision-makers who must act based on them. We treat this as a methodological problem rather than a technical one.

The primary deliverable of this position is a theoretical and methodological template that we call Action-Oriented Modeling. Rather than delivering finished algorithms, the template specifies how to build deliberately context-agnostic model architectures that expose methodological choices as parameters, and how local actors then configure, tune, and operate them. Its novelty lies in integrating three dimensions normally treated separately: configurable architectures that let domain experts shape model behavior without machine learning expertise; iterative field validation inside operational workflows; and governance mechanisms that transfer model ownership to local users.

The successful candidate will lead the development of this template into a generic, transferable, and theoretically grounded contribution. Your main tasks are to:

  • Develop, formalize, and publish the Action-Oriented Modeling template. This is the central output
  • Validate the template empirically through an action research design approach supplemented by participatory design methods
  • Define governance principles for model ownership that let stakeholders revise models as operational contexts change
  • Coordinate collaboration between the core development team, implementation partners, and local stakeholders, and act as a competence hub for action-oriented AI across TRUST

Two contrasting cases provide the empirical ground. The primary case is climate-sensitive disease prediction supporting public health decisions in low- and middle-income countries, built on DHIS2 and the action research network of the Health Information Systems Programme (HISP), with national health teams in ten countries. The complementary case is KoSy, the DHIS2-based municipal surveillance platform run by the Norwegian Institute of Public Health. We seek a candidate motivated by the methodological contribution to these and other empirical settings.

The main purpose of a postdoctoral fellowship is to provide candidates with enhanced skills to pursue a scientific top position within or beyond academia. To promote a strategic career path, all postdoctoral research fellows are required to submit a professional development plan no later than one month after commencement of the postdoctoral period.


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in information systems, informatics, computer science, science and technology studies, or another relevant field. The applicant must document that the degree corresponds to the requirement. The doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing date. Only applicants with an approved doctoral thesis and public defense are eventually eligible for appointment
  • Documented experience with engaged, qualitative research methods in organizational settings, such as action research, design science research, or participatory design
  • Documented ability to publish conceptual, theoretical, or methodological contributions in high-ranking peer-reviewed journals or conferences
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English

Desired qualifications:

  • Demonstrated experience conducting sociotechnical research on information systems, examining how technology, people, and organizational contexts interact
  • Understanding of machine learning and predictive modeling sufficient to engage critically and constructively with data scientists, for example on data quality and model assumptions
  • Technical skills sufficient to deploy and test models

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


What are we looking for in you?

In terms of personal skills:

  • You are motivated by methodological questions, enjoy qualitative fieldwork, and are excited about the academic challenge of turning messy empirical data into clear theoretical contributions
  • You work well both independently and as part of an interdisciplinary team, and you communicate across the boundary between technical and institutional expertise
  • You collaborate respectfully and effectively with practitioners and decision-makers who are not researchers
  • You work in a professional and structured manner and adapt quickly to new tasks
  • You are dependable and high-performing, also in hectic periods
  • You prefer being present at work and contribute actively to the professional and social environment you are part of

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development
  • A position at the centre of a national research effort on trustworthy AI, with access to the TRUST network and to operational partners in ten countries
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.  
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Postdoctoral development programmes.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Salary in position as Postdoctoral Fellow, position code 1352 in salary range NOK 595 000 - 690 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter, stating your motivation, summarizing your scientific work, and describing your research interests. The cover letter should not be written with the help of AI
  • A research statement of no more than three pages, setting out how you would approach the development and validation of the Action-Oriented Modeling template. The statement must connect clearly to the development of the template, and it is the main basis on which the evaluation committee will assess your fit for the position
  • CV summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience, and other qualifying activity
  • Copies of educational certificates and academic transcript of records
  • A complete list of publications and up to 5 academic works that you wish to be considered by the evaluation committee. Please link these 5 publications, do not send them, except if they are still in manuscript format
  • Names and contact details of 2 to 3 references, with name, relation to candidate, e-mail, and telephone number

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.

Please see the guidelines and regulations for appointments to Postdoctoral fellowships at the University of Oslo.

If an applicant has applied for and been granted funding for a fulltime research stay abroad while being employed as a Postdoctoral Research Fellow, the employment will be prolonged with the equivalent time as the research stay, but for no longer than of twelve months ( thus extending the employment to a maximum of four years).

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results a.o.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The Department of Informatics (IFI) is one of nine departments belonging to the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences. IFI is Norway’s largest university department for general education and research in Computer Science and related topics. 

The Department has more than 1800 students on bachelor level, 600 master students, and over 240 PhDs and postdocs. The overall staff of the Department is close to 370 employees, about 280 of these in full time positions. The full time tenured academic staff is 75, mostly Full/Associate Professors.

jobs.title: Uimaopettaja tai vauvauinninohjaaja
jobs.description:
Tule meille uimaopettajaksi tai vauvauinnin ohjaajaksi!

Flamingo on Suomen suosituin vesipuisto ja Spa & saunamaailma. Etsimme joukkoomme osa-aikaisia uimaopettajia ja vauvauinnin ohjaajia täydentämään iloista ja ammattitaitoista tiimiämme.

Työ sopii hyvin myös sinulle, joka haluat ohjata esimerkiksi yhden vakituisen ryhmän viikossa tai tehdä sijaisuuksia oman aikataulusi mukaan. Myös itsenäiset yrittäjät ovat tervetulleita tekemään kanssamme yhteistyötä.

Työ painottuu aamu- ja ilta-aikoihin. Meillä pääset osaksi rentoa ja huumorintajuista työyhteisöä sekä luomaan onnistumisen iloa ja mukavia uintikokemuksia niin pienille kuin vähän isommillekin vesipedoille.

Tehtäväsi

- Uimaopetus ja/tai vauvauinnin ohjaaminen
- Turvallisen ja kannustavan uintikokemuksen luominen
- Asiakkaiden palveleminen iloisella ja asiantuntevalla otteella
- Liikunnan ammattilaisille on tarjolla myös vesiliikunnan ohjausta

Tarjoamme

- Joustavan työmäärän oman tilanteesi mukaan
- Mahdollisuuden vakituisiin viikkoryhmiin ja sijaisuuksiin
- Mahdollisuuden työskennellä osa-aikaisena tai itsenäisenä yrittäjänä
- Kilpailukykyisen tehtäväkohtaisen palkkauksen
- Rennon ja kannustavan työyhteisön
- Mahdollisuuden kehittää ja laajentaa osaamistasi
- Lämpimän työympäristön – opetusaltaidemme vesi on vähintään +32 °C

Työajat

Työmäärä sovitaan tilanteesi mukaan. Voit ottaa vastuullesi yhden tai useamman viikkoryhmän tai toimia sijaisena. Tunnit sijoittuvat pääasiassa aamu- ja ilta-aikoihin.

Odotamme sinulta

- Uimaopettajan pätevyyttä tai uimaopettajan ja vauvauinnin ohjaajan pätevyyttä
-
Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa. Kyky palvella asiakkaita myös englanniksi katsotaan eduksi.

- Täysi-ikäisyyttä ja kykyä toimia itsenäisesti
- Iloista, reipasta ja asiakaslähtöistä työskentelytapaa
- Innostusta opettamiseen ja erilaisten uimareiden kohtaamiseen

Kiinnostuitko?

Tule mukaan luomaan asiakkaillemme upeita uintikokemuksia!

Lähetä hakemuksesi meille mahdollisimman pian. Kerro samalla, millaisesta tuntimäärästä ja työskentelytavasta olet kiinnostunut. Lisätiedot Palvelupäällikkö Anni Perttula, anni.perttula@flamingospa.f
