jobs.title: Stateful Services Engineer
jobs.description:
Build the infrastructure behind the next generation of AI-powered customer communications

Diabolocom is building an AI-first communication platform where AI and human agents, business workflows and communication channels work together seamlessly.

As we enter our next phase of growth, we are looking for a Stateful Services Engineer to help build and operate the infrastructure foundation behind the platform.

This is a unique opportunity to work on an infrastructure environment combining carrier-grade voice systems, on-premise data centers, distributed systems and AI workloads, while helping us build the reliability and operational maturity required to support 3x growth.

You will report to the newly forming Stateful Services Lead and work closely with Engineering, SRE and Infrastructure teams to improve the reliability, scalability and evolution of our stateful systems.

Your mission

Your goal is to build, operate and improve Diabolocom’s stateful services, with a strong focus on databases and data stores.

You will help ensure that our databases and stateful systems remain highly available, reliable and performant, while evolving our infrastructure so that maintenance, upgrades and scaling can be performed safely and with minimal to no downtime.

Working closely with the Stateful Services Lead, you will take ownership of specific technical projects and contribute to the evolution of our stateful infrastructure.

You will:

  • Operate and maintain our stateful services, including PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, RabbitMQ and Kafka/Redpanda.
  • Contribute to the design, evolution and scaling of our database infrastructure, with 50+ PostgreSQL clusters and increasingly complex data workloads.
  • Work on projects aimed at making database maintenance, upgrades and migrations safer and less disruptive to our services.
  • Improve high availability, replication, failover, backup/restore and disaster recovery across our stateful systems.
  • Contribute to rebuilding our PostgreSQL clusters to support automatic failover between data centers and reduce the impact of maintenance operations.
  • Help improving our queueing infrastructure, including projects such as quorum-based RabbitMQ.
  • Help building and maintaining stable Redis infrastructure and improve the reliability of our stateful services.
  • Investigate and solve complex performance, scalability and reliability issues across databases and distributed systems.
  • Work closely with development teams to understand their needs, support their use of databases and help them build reliable solutions.
  • Collaborate with SRE, networking and infrastructure teams to ensure that our stateful services operate reliably within our broader infrastructure.
  • Contribute to monitoring, automation and operational practices that make our infrastructure easier and safer to operate.
  • Participate in our on-call and incident management rotation, helping diagnose and resolve production issues when needed.
  • Stay hands-on and close to the technology: you will be expected to understand how our systems work, how they fail and how to improve them.

Who we are looking for

We’re looking for a technically strong and hands-on Stateful Services Engineer who enjoys solving complex infrastructure problems and taking ownership of production systems where reliability really matters.

You have experience operating databases or stateful services in production and understand that running these systems is about much more than simply maintaining them. You know how to troubleshoot them, how they behave under load, how they fail, and how to make them more reliable as they scale.

You’ll work on specific technical projects defined with the Stateful Services Lead, while having the autonomy to investigate problems, propose solutions and contribute to technical decisions.

We care more about your technical depth, curiosity and ability to take ownership than the exact number of years of experience you have.

Must Have

  • Strong hands-on experience as a DBA, Database Engineer, SRE or similar, with solid experience in PostgreSQL.
  • Experience operating and maintaining production databases, including upgrades, migrations, replication, backups, recovery, monitoring and performance troubleshooting.
  • Good understanding of high availability and reliability for stateful systems: failover, redundancy, replication, disaster recovery and minimising downtime during maintenance.
  • Good understanding of distributed systems, including replication, consistency, fault tolerance and the challenges of operating stateful services at scale.
  • Experience working with on-premise infrastructure or a willingness and ability to quickly adapt to an on-premise/bare-metal environment.
  • Good system design skills and the ability to reason about scalability, reliability and performance.
  • Experience collaborating closely with software development teams, understanding their requirements and helping them build reliable solutions around databases and stateful services.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex production issues.
  • Strong hands-on mindset: you enjoy getting into the technical details and solving problems yourself.
  • Comfortable participating in on-call and incident management.
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken. French or other languages are a plus.

Nice to Have

Experience with some of the following:

  • ClickHouse or another complex database/data platform.
  • Kafka or Redpanda and event-streaming infrastructure.
  • RabbitMQ, particularly quorum-based configurations.
  • Redis and distributed caching.
  • Other database technologies such as Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, MySQL, Cassandra or MongoDB.
  • Advanced Linux systems administration, including processes, storage, networking and troubleshooting.
  • Bare-metal infrastructure and data-center environments.
  • Observability and monitoring of stateful systems.
  • Capacity planning, performance analysis and load testing.
  • Infrastructure automation and configuration management.
  • Incident management, root-cause analysis and post-mortem practices.

About You

  • You take ownership. When you see a reliability or scalability problem, you investigate it and work towards a solution.
  • You are genuinely technical. You like understanding how things work under the hood and are comfortable diving deep when something breaks.
  • You think in systems. You understand that databases don't operate in isolation and enjoy working across infrastructure, networking, SRE and development teams.
  • You care about reliability. You want systems that can be maintained, upgraded and scaled without putting the business at risk.
  • You are pragmatic. You can make sensible technical trade-offs in complex environments.
  • You are curious and self-driven. You learn by doing, investigate unfamiliar technologies and are comfortable figuring things out independently.
  • You enjoy solving complex problems. You like working on systems where there isn't always an obvious answer.
  • You communicate clearly. You can explain technical topics and work effectively with the teams relying on your services.
  • You are comfortable taking responsibility. You don't need to be a manager to have an impact or take the lead on a technical problem.
 
Why join us
  • Own critical infrastructure: your work will directly impact the reliability and scalability of Diabolocom’s platform.
  • Solve complex technical challenges: work with large-scale databases and stateful services, including PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Kafka, Redis and RabbitMQ.
  • Work on real infrastructure challenges: help improve PostgreSQL clusters, cross-data-center failover, RabbitMQ and Redis reliability.
  • Stay hands-on: spend your time solving challenging technical problems rather than managing people.
  • Learn and grow: work across databases, distributed systems, messaging and infrastructure in a diverse technical environment.
  • Work across teams: collaborate closely with Engineering, SRE and Infrastructure to build reliable systems at scale.

Recruitment Process

  1. Introductory call with Jade — 30 min
    Get to know each other and discuss your background.
  2. Interview with Sergey, CTO — 1 hour
    Discuss your technical background, skills and knowledge.
  3. On-site System Design interview with Sergey, CTO — 1 hour
    Work through a technical case study and explore your system design approach.
  4. Team & cultural fit — 1 hour
    Meet members of the team, onsite or via video.

Logistics

📍 Paris, rue de la Paix, 75002
🏢 Hybrid model: 3 days onsite / 2 days remote
💻 Equipment: choose your preferred setup (Mac/Linux + monitors)
🍽 Lunch vouchers
🚇 Navigo: 50% of the monthly pass reimbursed

One More Thing

We are not necessarily looking for someone who has already worked in this exact role or with every technology in our stack.

The strongest candidates are often engineers who have built and operated complex infrastructure, taken ownership of production systems and learned new technologies along the way.

If you enjoy solving difficult technical problems, want to work close to the infrastructure and are excited by the challenge of making stateful systems more reliable and scalable — we would love to talk.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.description:

WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion sits at a rare intersection: a product people love, a flexible system businesses run on, and a new platform for people and AI to work together. We’re hiring a Product Manager to turn that opportunity into products that feel inevitable. You’ll find consequential customer problems, set a bold but grounded strategy, and build alongside design, engineering, data science, research, and go-to-market partners. This is a high-agency role for someone excited to shape what Notion becomes next—and make powerful new capabilities feel simple, trustworthy, and delightful to millions of customers.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.



WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Uncover the customer problems and product opportunities that will define Notion’s next chapter, then turn them into a focused strategy and roadmap.

 - Take ambitious ideas from first principles to launch, building closely with design and engineering to create experiences that feel simple, useful, and distinctly Notion.

 - Make the hard calls—balancing customer impact, business opportunity, technical complexity, speed, and long-term product quality.

 - Shape how AI changes both the product and the way we build, using it to improve research, decisions, experimentation, and execution.

 - Raise the bar for product thinking across the team by creating clarity, accelerating learning, and establishing principles and success measures that endure.


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Demonstrated ability to identify meaningful customer problems and turn them into products that are intuitive, useful, and built with a high level of craft.

 - Strong product judgment and the ability to make sound tradeoffs among user experience, business impact, technical complexity, quality, and speed.

 - A track record of moving ambiguous, cross-functional work from problem definition to shipped outcomes while creating clear ownership and alignment.

 - Customer depth: you can learn directly from users across segments and translate differing needs into a coherent strategy rather than a collection of one-off requests.

 - Practical AI fluency: you use AI to sharpen research, product thinking, decisions, and execution, and you’re excited to rethink how people and agents work together.


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience building collaborative, productivity, or AI-powered products used by a broad range of customers.

 - Experience operating across both zero-to-one product development and the improvement of products at scale.

 - Technical fluency and comfort partnering deeply with engineering on complex product systems.

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $238,000 - $250,000 per year.

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy and NYLL 144.

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

Hi there! We're hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our Product Marketing team.

We're a group that cares about getting the story right, not just getting it out the door. We work closely with product, sales, and demand gen, and we hold ourselves to a high bar because our work directly shapes how the market understands what we build.

This role gives you real ownership. You'll shape positioning and messaging for a meaningful piece of our product portfolio, build the competitive intelligence that keeps our field teams sharp, and work directly with sales leaders who depend on your materials to close deals. It's a role with visible impact, not one where your work disappears into a shared drive.

As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you'll drive go-to-market strategy for your area, from positioning through launch through enablement, while partnering with product and sales to make sure the message actually lands. This role matters because clear, credible product marketing is what turns a strong platform into a business result. Camunda operates in a technical, complex space, and getting that translation right is not optional.

What You Will Do

  • Own positioning and messaging for your product area, translating technical capability into a clear value proposition for both technical and business buyers.

  • Build and maintain a competitive intelligence program that sales actually uses, not just battlecards that sit in a folder.

  • Lead go-to-market execution for launches in your area, coordinating across product, sales, and demand gen so the message is consistent everywhere it shows up.

  • Arm the field with content that works in real conversations: pitch decks, demos, solution briefs, and objection handling.

  • Use market and customer research to inform product and positioning decisions, not just to validate ones already made.

  • Mentor and support other marketers on your team, sharing what you've learned without being asked.

What You Will Bring to the Role

  • Significant experience in B2B product marketing, ideally in enterprise software, with a track record of owning positioning and messaging end to end, not just contributing pieces of it.

  • A real competitive intelligence practice under your belt. You've built and maintained a program that sales relied on, not just responded to research requests as they came in.

  • Comfort marketing technical products to technical buyers. You can go deep enough into a technical concept to be credible with a developer, and simplify it enough to be clear to an executive.

  • Field enablement experience at scale. You've built programs that changed how a sales team talked about a product, and you know how to tell if it worked.

  • Strong cross-functional instincts. You know how to build trust with product and sales without relying on authority, and how to bring people along on a positioning decision rather than just announcing it.

  • Comfort using AI tools in your day to day work. This isn't a checkbox, it's part of how the role actually operates.

This role is an existing vacancy

We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

  • Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

AI in our hiring process: Camunda may use AI tools to aid the screening of applications and during the interview process. You can learn more here

Die collana health AG fungiert als digitales Kompetenzzentrum für das schweizerische Gesundheitswesen. jobs.title: People & Talent Lead
jobs.description:
Remote from France or Germany · Full-time

Become Kestra’s first dedicated People hire. Help us grow from 50 to 100 people over the next 12 to 18 months, and strengthen the foundations that help a distributed team work well together.

You will own recruitment and People operations, working directly with the founders and hiring managers. This is a hands-on role with room to shape the function as we grow.

Reporting to: Emmanuel (CEO) and Ludovic (CTO), our co-founders
Working language: English

Why Kestra

Orchestrate everything, everywhere. From one control plane.

Data, infrastructure, business processes and AI agents. Build, run and govern them all, in the cloud or on your own servers. AI agents follow the same rules as everything else.

We believe orchestration is becoming a shared layer of enterprise architecture: the layer that coordinates what runs across tools, teams and environments. Kestra is building that foundation as an open-source platform, giving enterprises a common way to manage increasingly complex automation.

Founded in France, we are growing our enterprise business in Europe and the United States. In March 2026, we raised a $25M Series A led by RTP Global, with Alven, ISAI and Axeleo. Teams at JPMorgan Chase, Apple, TotalEnergies, Crédit Agricole, Leroy Merlin, Bloomberg and Deutsche Telekom run Kestra in production.

The opportunity

Our next stage depends on bringing in the right people and helping them succeed. We are hiring across Sales, Engineering, Product, Marketing and Customer Operations, with substantial growth planned across functions and all the regions where we operate.

You will bring dedicated People and Talent leadership to an established organisation, working with the founders, hiring managers and the Administration, Workplace Operations and Finance teams that already support our People processes.

With colleagues across more than ten countries and many recent joiners, the work goes beyond hiring. People need a good start, clear expectations and connections across teams. You will help make that experience consistent as we grow.

What you will own

  • Recruitment from sourcing to signed offer. Find and engage candidates, run initial conversations, coordinate focused interview processes and keep the ATS reliable. Work with the founders and leaders across functions to prioritise roles and help hiring managers make well-supported decisions.

  • People operations across countries. Work with our Administration, Workplace Operations and Finance teams to coordinate contracts, payroll partners, EOR providers, benefits, time off and employee requests. Keep records and deadlines clear, and work with local providers and advisers on employment requirements.

  • Onboarding that gets people started well. Make the practical setup smooth and help managers give new joiners clear expectations, useful context and the right relationships from day one.

  • Compensation and performance processes. Develop the framework with the founders, then run the cycles: salary reviews, levels, performance reviews and equity administration, including BSPCE where applicable.

  • How we work as a distributed team. Organise all-hands and the company offsite, strengthen internal communication and build routines that help people collaborate across locations.

  • A clear view of progress. Give the founders useful information on hiring, headcount and employment costs. Use it to identify bottlenecks and decide what needs attention.

What you bring

  • Experience combining People and Talent in a growing company. You have worked through a period of significant hiring and know which processes become necessary as a team grows.

  • Recruitment experience you have built yourself. You have sourced candidates, assessed them with hiring managers and closed offers. You can explain the difficult searches, the hires that worked and what you learned from those that did not.

  • Experience recruiting across functions. You have hired technical and business profiles, understand how to adapt your approach to different roles and markets, and work with managers to assess evidence of performance beyond a convincing interview.

  • Practical knowledge of international employment. You have worked with EOR providers, payroll partners and local advisers, and know when a situation needs specialist input.

  • Strong operational judgment. You are comfortable in an ATS, HRIS and payroll platforms, handle sensitive information carefully and follow through on details.

  • The ability to build and operate. You can introduce a useful process, run it yourself and improve it without adding unnecessary complexity.

  • Fluent professional English. French or German is useful for working with local employees and providers.

Experience in developer tools or open source, a background in operations or consulting, or experience supporting US employment from Europe would be valuable.

How you will work

You will build on an established organisation, supported by the Administration, Workplace Operations and Finance teams that already carry our People processes. Your role is to bring dedicated expertise, coordinate this work and help it scale as the company grows.

We already use Kestra to automate business and administrative workflows, improving them as our needs evolve. You will continue this approach with the teams involved: simplify processes, automate repetitive work and keep human attention where it matters.

Managers remain responsible for their hiring decisions and teams. You will guide them, challenge them when necessary and agree priorities with the founders as recruitment and employee needs evolve.

What we offer

  • Compensation discussed in the first conversation, based on the scope and level of the role rather than your current salary.

  • Equity participation, through BSPCE where applicable.

  • Remote work from France or Germany, with flexibility around team commitments.

  • An annual company offsite.

  • Equipment, conference and training budgets, with time to learn.

  • Direct access to the founders and the opportunity to build a function that grows with the company.

How we hire

  1. 45 minutes with Emmanuel and Ludovic: the role, your experience and your questions.

  2. 60 minutes on your work: a hiring process you ran end to end and a complex international People situation you resolved.

  3. 45 minutes with two future colleagues: one from the commercial team and one from the technical team.

Three conversations, no take-home exercise, and a decision within two weeks of the first call.

Send your CV or LinkedIn profile.

As a Global Security Program Manager on Notion’s Global Safety & Security team, you’ll help protect our people, workplaces, and operations across a distributed global portfolio. This role exists to bring greater consistency to physical security programs as Notion scales—strengthening technology, vendor operations, incident readiness, and local execution without losing the welcoming experience we want employees and guests to feel.  - By the end of your first year, take ownership of Notion’s physical security technology program, improving how systems, data, and operating practices support safe and resilient workplaces.

 - By the end of your first year, demonstrate program ownership in one major physical security or safety pillar, such as business continuity and disaster recovery, event security, travel risk management, monitoring operations, crisis management, guard force operations, or governance.

 - By the end of your first year, deliver multiple international projects with clear plans, sound judgment, and effective coordination across regions, vendors, and cross-functional partners.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Effective project management skills, with the ability to move multiple international projects from ambiguity to clear plans, decisions, and delivery.

 - Clear, thoughtful communication with internal partners, vendors, building management, and local stakeholders—especially when translating security requirements into practical action.

 - A service-oriented approach and eagerness to help create secure, welcoming workplace experiences; you bring curiosity, ownership, and sound judgment to how you work with others.

Dygtig og selvstændig kok søges

KŌBŌ Box er et nyopstartet asiatisk takeaway i hjertet af Aarhus. Her sammensætter gæsterne deres egen boks med forskellige retter. Vi har fokus på god autentisk smag, friske råvarer og høj kvalitet.

Vi søger 2 dygtige og selvstændige kokke som vil være med til at få vores nye køkken godt fra start.

Dine arbejdsopgaver :

  • Tilberedning af asiatiske retter.

  • Klargøring af råvarer og løbende produktion.

  • Sikring af ensartet smag, kvalitet og præsentation.

  • At holde overblik over råvarer og bidrage til at begrænse madspild.

  • Rengøring, egenkontrol og overholdelse af køkkenets hygiejnekrav.

Vi forventer at du :

  • Har erfaring med det asiatiske køkken.

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine opgaver.

  • Arbejder struktureret og bevarer overblikket, når der er travlt.

  • Har sans for smag, kvalitet og detaljerne i maden.

  • Er mødestabil, fleksibel og god til at samarbejde.

  • Bidrager til en god stemning og hjælper til, hvor der er behov.

Vi tilbyder :

  • Et job i en virksomhed, hvor du bliver en vigtig del af den daglige drift og får mulighed for at præge arbejdet i køkkenet. Hos os bliver du en del af et engageret team med fokus på god mad, samarbejde og gode oplevelser for vores gæster.

Arbejdstider og løn aftales nærmere efter kvalifikation.

Har ovenstående vakt din interesse? Så send os en kort ansøgning, billede og dit cv til vores mail adresse. Fortæl meget gerne om din erfaring med det asiatiske køkken og hvornår du kan starte.

Vi søger kokke til opstart med det samme.

Vi søker en pålitelig og faglig dyktig betong bilsjåfør for utleieoppdrag i Bergen og omegn. Dette er en praktisk og variert stilling innen sjåfør og transport, med leveranser til byggeplasser. Vi ser etter deg som trives med ansvar for kjøretøy og kvalitet i leveransene.

  • Levering av betong til byggeplasser i Bergen og nærliggende områder.

Vi tilbyr:

BDO Luxembourg is looking for a Change Management Specialist to support the transformation of its Accounting, Corporate, Fund and Payroll practices.

Who are we?

BDO is present in over 169 countries and we offer an extensive range of services in the areas of Audit, Tax, Advisory, Accounting, Business Services and Outsourcing. At BDO Luxembourg, our mission is to provide our clients with the expertise of our global network tailored to the unique needs of the Luxembourgish market, delivering personalized services and building valued relationships. With over 700 employees representing more than 40 nationalities, we embrace diversity and encourage skills and people development among our employees. Our core values, honesty, integrity, quality, respect and responsibility, define our culture. Hence, our People can expect to grow in a stimulating work environment that supports professional development and fosters inclusivity.

What will you do?

As Change Management Specialist, you will:
• Support the transformation core team in organising, monitoring and steering the overall transformation agenda.
• Contribute to the definition and implementation of change management plans across departments.
• Assess the impact of transformation initiatives on teams, roles, responsibilities, processes, behaviours and client service delivery.
• Work closely with sponsors, department representatives, managers and operational teams to ensure that change is understood, accepted and adopted.
• Identify adoption risks, resistance points, communication needs, training needs and operational readiness issues.
• Prepare stakeholder communications, internal updates, user engagement material and change adoption reporting.
• Support the preparation of change impact assessments, stakeholder maps, readiness assessments and adoption dashboards.
• Coordinate with the central IT Business Application team, project teams and other internal stakeholders to align implementation plans with business change needs.
• Promote a pragmatic and user-oriented approach to transformation, focused on operational adoption and sustainable change.

This position is for you if:

• You have 4 to 6 years of experience in change management, business transformation, organisational change, consulting, operational excellence or a similar field.
• You have contributed to transformation programmes involving several stakeholders, business teams or departments.
• Experience with accounting, corporate services, fund administration or professional services environments.
• You can translate strategic objectives into practical change actions.
• You are able to assess how change impacts people, processes, roles, responsibilities and ways of working.
• You are comfortable facilitating discussions, structuring feedback and turning complex situations into clear action plans.
• You have strong communication skills and can adapt your message to partners, managers and operational teams.
• You are structured, autonomous and pragmatic, with the ability to monitor progress without taking ownership of each individual project.
• You have a good understanding of digital transformation, business applications and the role technology can play in improving processes, collaboration and service delivery.
• You are familiar with the potential of AI in a business environment and have already used, tested or contributed to practical AI-related use cases.
• You are fluent in English and French.
…then this offer is probably made for you!

It would be an advantage if you also have:

• Exposure to software implementation or digital transformation programmes.
• Knowledge of change management methodologies such as Prosci, ADKAR, Kotter or similar approaches.
• Experience preparing change plans, communication plans, adoption material, training support or stakeholder engagement plans.
• Good command of Microsoft 365 tools, including PowerPoint, Excel, Teams and SharePoint. Experience with project or collaboration tools would be an asset.

What we offer

• A key role in a strategic transformation programme within one of BDO Luxembourg's core business practices.
• The opportunity to work closely with senior stakeholders, business teams and technology specialists.
• A varied role combining change management, stakeholder engagement, communication and transformation monitoring.
• A collaborative, multicultural and entrepreneurial working environment.
• The opportunity to contribute to the future operating model of our Accounting, Corporate, Fund and Payroll practices.
• Ongoing learning and development opportunities in line with your strengths and career aspirations.

What´s in it for you:

- a discretionary performance bonus

SENIOR LEGAL COUNSEL M/M/F


About the role

We are delighted to represent a leading asset manager within a global financial group, committed to delivering long-term value through responsible investment solutions and sustainable practices.

Based in Luxembourg, you will join an international and multicultural Fund Law team, working alongside experienced legal professionals across multiple locations. As a trusted legal partner to the business, you will provide pragmatic legal solutions that enable business opportunities while ensuring compliance with Luxembourg and European regulatory requirements.

This role has a primary focus on the legal aspects of a UCITS Management Company and AIFM, including governance, outsourcing arrangements, regulatory compliance and corporate legal matters. You will also support investment fund-related activities, including fund documentation and product development.

Key Responsibilities:

• Lead, coordinate and support legal and regulatory projects and strategic initiatives, with a primary focus on Management Company and AIFM legal matters.
• Advise the business on governance, corporate legal matters, outsourcing frameworks and other Management Company-related regulatory requirements.
• Draft, review and negotiate a broad range of legal documentation, including outsourcing agreements, service agreements, prospectuses, board resolutions and other corporate legal documents.
• Provide practical legal advice on Luxembourg and European regulatory requirements applicable to Management Companies, AIFMs and investment funds.
• Coordinate and manage regulatory filings and interactions with the CSSF and other competent authorities where required.
• Partner closely with Governance, Compliance, Risk, Product Development and other business functions, as well as external legal advisers.
• Support investment fund-related matters, including fund documentation, product launches, cross-border distribution and ongoing legal maintenance.
• Drive continuous improvements to legal processes, governance frameworks and documentation standards.
• Build trusted relationships with stakeholders by providing proactive legal guidance and helping identify legal and regulatory implications of business initiatives.

Profile sought

• Master's degree in Law or an equivalent legal qualification.
• 10+ years of post-qualification experience within the asset management industry, a leading law firm or a consulting environment.
• Strong experience within the Luxembourg investment funds industry, including extensive exposure to Management Company and/or AIFM legal matters.
• In-depth knowledge of the Luxembourg legal and regulatory framework applicable to UCITS Management Companies, AIFMs and investment funds.
• Demonstrated experience advising on governance, outsourcing arrangements and regulatory requirements applicable to Luxembourg Management Companies.
• Proven track record of interacting with the CSSF on Management Company and fund-related matters.
• Strong commercial judgement with the ability to translate complex legal and regulatory requirements into practical business solutions.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience collaborating across international and cross-functional teams.
• Proactive, solution-oriented and comfortable working in a dynamic environment with evolving regulatory requirements.
• Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a collaborative international team.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. French and/or German would be considered a strong advantage.

Application process:

As an equal opportunity employer, we embrace diversity and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Please note, however, that candidates must possess a valid Luxembourg work permit. As we represent our clients, we are required to submit only those who meet this requirement. Unfortunately, if you do not have a valid work permit, we will not be able to consider your application.

If you are selected for the position, you will be asked to provide supporting documentation, such as copies of your diplomas, proof of prior employment, and a standard criminal record check, as part of the final steps in our recruitment process.

We appreciate your interest in our company and look forward to the possibility of working together.

jobs.description:
SD-26145- RESEARCH SCIENTIST IN INTER-SATELLITE COMMUNICATIONS & COOPERATIVE NETWORKING

Fixed term contract | Belval | 18 Months
Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organization (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?
You will be mainly in charge of:
• Designing and evaluating inter-satellite link (ISL) architectures tailored to GEO proximity operations, covering both RF and optical crosslink technologies.
• Developing cooperative communication protocols enabling real-time coordination, sensing cueing, and state exchanges between heterogeneous satellite payloads.
• Defining interface specifications to ensure seamless integration of the networking layer with onboard optical and RF sensing systems.
• Designing predictive and resilient networking strategies leveraging orbital geometry and interference-aware link adaptation.
• Contributing to system-level integration and ground-based demonstration activities validating the communication architecture.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

Education
• PhD in Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a closely related field

Experience and skills
• Research experience in the areas of satellite communications, inter-satellite links, or non-terrestrial networks (NTN)
• Strong background in communication protocol design, including cross-layer optimization, QoS management, and time-critical networking
• Familiarity with 5G/6G architectural concepts and their applicability to space systems (deterministic latency, distributed scheduling, AI-driven link management)
• Experience with simulation and modelling tools for satellite communication systems
• Knowledge of RF and/or optical link technologies is an asset
• Experience in multi-partner research projects is an asset
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Ability to work autonomously and collaboratively within a multi-disciplinary, international team

Language skills
• Fluency in English, both oral and written. Other relevant languages are an asset.

Your LIST benefits
• An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects
• Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society
• Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square meters, including innovations in all that we do
• An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas
• Personalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skills
• Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce
• Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfill their personal and professional ambitions
• Gender-friendly environment with multiple actions to attract, develop and retain women in science
• 32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month salary, statutory health insurance
• Flexible working hours, home working policy (not remote) and access to Digital lunch vouchers

Apply online
Your application must include:
• A motivation letter oriented towards the position and detailing your experience
• A scientific CV with contact details
• List of publications (and patents, if applicable)
• Contact details of 2 references
Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by email will not be considered.

Application procedure and conditions
We kindly request applicants to provide their nationality for statistical purposes only, as part of our commitment to promoting diversity and ensuring equal opportunities in our workforce. This information will be kept confidential and will not be used for any discriminatory purposes.
LIST is dedicated to maintaining an inclusive work environment and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, hiring, and retaining a diverse workforce. All applicants will be considered for employment without discrimination based on race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, religion, age, or disability.
Applications will be continuously reviewed until the position is filled. An assessment committee will thoroughly evaluate applications, adhering to guidelines designed to ensure equal opportunities. The primary criteria for selection will be the alignment of the applicant's existing skills and expertise with the requirements mentioned above.
As part of our recruitment process, the selected candidate might be subject to a background check in accordance with applicable laws and institutional policies. Further checks and restrictions might apply to candidates in compliance with export controls requirements
For the purposes of the position and in accordance with applicable legislation, the successful candidate may be requested to provide a recent criminal record certificate.
Due to the requirements of the project, we can only consider applications from nationals of a NATO Member Country, from an EU EEA/EFTA Country or from one of the following NATO Indo-Pacific Partners: Australia, Japan, Republic of South Korea and New Zealand.
This position offers a gross monthly salary between €6094 and €6678, paid over 13 months (€79.222–€86.814 annually) based on full time employment. The final salary offer within this range will be determined based on the candidate's overall profile, qualifications and professional experience .
For part time employment, the salary is adjusted pro rata

The Luxembourg branch plays a major part in its operations, offering clients high value-added services extending from custody to securities lending, fund administration, performance measurement and ratings, and bond issuance services.

The Private Capital department is specialized in Alternative Investment Fund, offering Fund Managers the full range of services to administer their business. At the earth of the department, the Fund Accounting Team is responsible to calculate the NAV of the funds and produce various types of reports.

WHAT'S YOUR DAY-TO-DAY MISSION?

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES:

• You will calculate and validate statutory and consolidated Net Asset Values for Alternative Investment Funds
• You will perform all the tasks to produce the Net Asset Value calculation, which includes:
1. Participation in the launch of new funds, sub-funds, SICAR and unregulated entities.
2. Review of all entries in the General Ledgers.
3. Control the consistency of the valuation received and used for underlying assets.
4. Execution of 1st level controls if any in respect with BP2S procedures.
5. Follow up of the liquidation of funds (or sub-funds), SICAR and unregulated entities.
6. Assistance in the preparation of financial statements.
7. Completion of annual and interim audit requests

MISSIONS ARE IMPORTANT, BUT SO ARE THE TEAM AND THE WORK ENVIRONMENT!

Your working environment

• You will be joining a young, diversified, and international team of professionals dedicated to constantly innovating the services provided to Private Capital clients
• The Private Capital department has its main office in Luxembourg Kirchberg. Our open space is located on the 3rd floor of the Equinox Building. The position is eligible for teleworking and work from the satellite offices, as per the rules defined by the Bank.
• You will be joining one of the Fund Accounting teams and work also closely with all the other teams of the department. You will also be in direct contact with our clients and with external auditors.
Benefits of this position?

By joining this evolving team, you will be given a broad scope of responsibilities that directly impact the operations of BNP Paribas CIB's Private Capital clients. You will also have the opportunity to increase your experience of the Private Capital industry. You will be fully involved in the development of the new services BNP Paribas CIB is developing and implementing. You will be able to use your communication skills to maintain a good relationship with all the stakeholders.

WORKING WITHIN BNP PARIBAS MEANS:

• Being part of a solid and committed financial group, where everyone has a role to play in making our society more sustainable and can give meaning to their daily professional lives:
Our commitments and actions for clients and society | BNP Paribas
• Taking advantage of a wide range of training opportunities to continually develop your skills and prepare you for the professions of tomorrow, in a constantly changing world
• Broadening your horizons and exploring different jobs throughout your professional life, thanks to the diversity of our activities and our dynamic career management
• Preserving your work-life balance thanks to our flexible working hours, two satellite offices near the Belgian and French borders, and remote work options
• Thriving daily in an environment where it's great to live and work. Listening to the voices of our employees, we are committed to providing a high-quality work environment based on respect, diversity, inclusion, and a spirit of camaraderie.

ARE YOU OUR FUTURE PRIVATE CAPITAL FUND ACCCOUTANT?

Professional experience and/or degree

• Master's degree in Accounting, Finance or Audit, or ACCA qualification
• Experience in the fields of Fund Accounting or knowledge of Fund industry (Private Capital being an advantage)

Behavioural skills

• Ability to collaborate / Teamwork
• Attention to detail / Rigor
• Organisational skills
• Adaptability
• Ability to deliver / Results driven
• Communication skills - Oral & Written
• Client focused
• Ability to share/pass on knowledge
• Critical thinking
• Proactivity

Transversal skills:

• Ability to understand, explain and manage change
• Analytical skills
• Ability to develop and adapt a process
• Ability to anticipate business/strategic evolution
• Ability to inspire others & generate people's commitment
• Ability to develop others & improve their skills
• Ability to work with Agile methods

Technical skills

• Pack Office
• Excellent understanding of Private Capital Funds services in Luxembourg
• Expertise in Private Debt Funds, Private Equity and Funds of Funds.
• Knowledge of FIA (Front Invest Alternative) software

Language skills

Fluent in English
French, German/other languages will be considered as an asset.

In a changing world, diversity, equity and inclusion are key values for the well-being and performance of teams. At BNP Paribas, we want to welcome and retain all talents without distinction: this is how, together, we will build the innovative, responsible and sustainable finance of tomorrow.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Specialist (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description:

Founded in 1979 through a partnership between Electrolux and the World Health Organization (WHO), B Medical Systems has grown into a global leader in vaccine cold chain solutions and a trusted provider of temperature-controlled solutions for the healthcare, global humanitarian procurement, pharmaceutical, life sciences, and blood transfusion sectors. For over four decades, we have designed and manufactured innovative medical refrigeration and vaccine cold chain solutions that protect vaccines, blood, biological samples, and other temperature-sensitive products in more than 170 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Luxembourg, B Medical Systems combines innovation, engineering excellence, and advanced manufacturing capabilities to deliver solutions that meet the highest international standards.

To support our continued growth, we are recruiting a dynamic, business-minded, and performance-driven professional for the position of:

Digital Marketing Specialist (m / f / d)

The Digital Marketing Specialist will be responsible for driving B Medical Systems' digital growth by increasing the visibility and discoverability of the company, its brand portfolio and products, and converting digital engagement into qualified leads. The role will own and continuously develop the company's digital marketing ecosystem across traditional and AI-powered search, website, paid media, social media campaigns and other relevant digital channels.

Key Responsibilities:

• Own and execute the digital growth and lead-generation strategy, with clear accountability for generating qualified inbound leads.
• Develop integrated digital campaigns across Google Ads/PPC, LinkedIn and other paid social, display and relevant emerging channels across relevant market segments, products, and customer groups to increase awareness, traffic, engagement and conversion.
• Own and continuously improve B Medical Systems' visibility across traditional search engines and AI-powered search and discovery platforms, including Google, ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude etc.
• Develop and execute SEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and related strategies to increase brand and product discoverability and generate relevant traffic and leads.
• Manage key elements of technical and on-page SEO, including search intent, metadata, internal linking, crawlability and indexation, structured data/schema, site architecture, backlinks and website performance.
• Act as a key business owner of the B Medical Systems website from a visibility, user journey, lead-generation and conversion perspective.
• Create, update and optimise webpages, product pages, landing pages and campaign pages using CMS platforms such as WordPress.
• Continuously improve website traffic quality, conversion rates, calls-to-action, lead-capture mechanisms and overall digital customer journeys.
• Evaluate and leverage new advertising opportunities, including AI-powered platforms, as they become relevant.
• Review French and/or German translations of marketing materials.
• Support e-commerce, catalogues, marketplaces and other online product-placement platforms where relevant.
• Define and monitor KPIs covering digital leads, pipeline contribution, traffic, AI/search visibility, conversion rates, campaign performance, CPL/CPA and other relevant commercial metrics.

Education:  Bachelor's degree in marketing, Digital Marketing, Business, Communications or a related discipline.

Experience:

• Minimum 5 years of demonstrated experience in digital, growth or performance marketing, preferably within a B2B environment.
Technical Knowledge:
• Strong knowledge of SEO and modern search optimisation, including AEO, GEO and AI-driven discovery.
• Proven experience generating leads through digital marketing and managing paid acquisition campaigns, including Google Ads/PPC and LinkedIn.
• Hands-on experience in creating, managing and optimising websites and landing pages through CMS platforms such as WordPress.
• E-commerce/digital product platform experience would be an advantage.
• Working proficiency in English and, French or German is mandatory.

Skills:

• Strong ownership and accountability, with the ability to drive initiatives independently from concept through execution and optimisation.
• Hands-on and proactive, with the ability to develop strategy while personally executing campaigns, website improvements and experiments.
• Collaborative and organised, with the ability to work effectively across teams while managing multiple priorities, stakeholders and deadlines.
• High attention to detail, commitment to quality and a positive, collaborative working approach.

Miscellaneous:  Preference will be given to a candidate who can join immediately or within a short period of time.

If you are interested in gaining experience in a growing Luxembourg-based company and are analytical and detail-oriented, we would like to meet you.
What we offer you? A fast-growing company, an international environment, exciting challenges, a dynamic workplace
… And more reasons to join us … If you are interested in this position and meet
the job requirements, please apply via our web site:  https://www.bmedicalsystems.com/en/about-us/career/

jobs.title: Securities Lending Product Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Securities Lending Product Manager (f/m/d)

Location: Luxembourg, LU
Company: Deutsche Börse Group

Your area of work

As a Senior Securities Lending Product Manager, you will play a leading role in shaping, developing, and commercializing Clearstream's securities lending and borrowing proposition within the broader Collateral, Lending & Liquidity Solutions (CLLS) franchise. The role combines strategic product leadership with practical product ownership across securities lending and borrowing, aligned with collateral management and liquidity, settlement efficiency, regulation, risk, digital transformation, and commercial growth.

You will drive the evolution of securities lending solutions for various clients' segments, ensuring the proposition remains competitive, scalable, risk-aware, operationally robust, and aligned with client demand, market structure, regulatory expectations, and digital capabilities. You will work closely with Trading, Sales and Relationship Management, Client Service, Collateral Management and Liquidity Products, Operations, Technology, Legal, Risk, Compliance, Tax, Finance, and Pricing to translate market opportunities into deliverable product outcomes and resilient day-to-day operating models.

Your responsibilities

• Define, support and execute the strategic roadmap for securities lending and borrowing solutions, aligning product development with client needs, market trends, regulatory change, operational resilience, and the wider CLLS growth strategy.
• Identify opportunities across securities lending, funding and financing, balance-sheet optimization, and settlement efficiency, translating overlapping needs into scalable product capabilities and commercial solutions.
• Lead end-to-end product initiatives from concept and business case through design, governance, implementation, launch, operational readiness, post-launch performance review, and continuous enhancement.
• Develop clear product positioning, value propositions, pricing approaches, commercial proposals, and go-to-market materials that support client adoption and differentiate Clearstream in the securities finance market.
• Act as a senior subject matter expert on securities lending market structure, lender and borrower dynamics, collateral flows, settlement efficiency, and regulatory developments including SFTR, CSDR, T+1, and evolving capital and liquidity requirements.
• Translate regulatory and market changes, into practical product, operational, legal, and control requirements. Coordinate the alignment across Product, Legal, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and client-facing teams.
• Drive digital transformation across the securities lending proposition, including data-led decision-making, automation, workflow optimization, digital client channels, analytics, AI-enabled use cases, APIs, KPIs, and platform scalability.
• Use market data, client feedback, trading insights, operational metrics, incident trends, and performance analytics to identify opportunities for revenue growth, risk reduction, operational efficiency, and improved client experience.
• Maintain strong awareness of risk, credit, collateral eligibility, control frameworks, and operational dependencies to ensure the robustness of the securities lending proposition
• Represent Clearstream at industry conferences, client events, market forums, trade associations, and working groups, contributing to thought leadership and strengthening the firm's market presence.
• Prepare and coordinate cross-functional stakeholders across Sales and Relationship management, Trading, Client Service, Operations, Technology, Legal, Risk, Compliance, Tax, Finance, and Pricing to ensure successful product delivery, adoption, and operational sustainability.
• Mentor colleagues and contribute to a collaborative, commercially focused, risk-aware, and innovation-oriented product culture.

Your profile

• University degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Financial Markets, or a related discipline; an MBA or relevant professional qualification is an advantage.
• 7+ years of experience in securities lending, securities finance, collateral management, market infrastructure, product management, or related capital markets activities.
• Good understanding of securities lending and borrowing, funding and financing market dynamics
• High awareness of the links between securities lending, collateral management, liquidity, funding, capital efficiency, risk, credit, control frameworks, and regulatory constraints in a financial market infrastructure environment.
• Proven track record of executing product strategy, building business cases, managing roadmaps, defining pricing approaches, and delivering complex cross-functional initiatives in regulated financial services.
• Ability to translate market and regulatory change into clear product impacts, operational requirements, legal documentation needs, control considerations, and implementation priorities.
• Commercial mindset with the ability to convert market intelligence, client feedback, trading insights, operational metrics, and industry developments into practical product enhancements and revenue opportunities.
• Strong digital and data orientation, with practical understanding of analytics, automation, workflow tools, dashboards, AI-enabled use cases, APIs, platform transformation, KPIs, and Agile delivery concepts.
• Experience engaging in industry forums, client events, working groups, conferences, or market associations,
• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders, build consensus across matrix teams, and drive clarity in complex, technical, or ambiguous situations.
• Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills,
• Fluency in English is essential; additional European languages are considered an advantage.

jobs.title: Market Head for Central and Northern Europe (m/f)
jobs.description:
Market Head for Central and Northern Europe

Permanent contract

At HSBC, we're a trusted international organisation with a global customer base of around 39 million customers worldwide through a network that covers 62 countries and territories. In Europe, our ambition is to become the leading international wholesale bank and we need talent like you to help us meet our ambition. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top or in an exciting new direction—we offer opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

The HSBC Group in Luxembourg is a significant employer and operates several businesses including asset management, securities services, private banking and corporate banking.

By joining us, you'll help evolve and grow our private banking business.

What you will do:

As Market Head for Central and Northern Europe, you'll directly manage the Netherlands Desk based in Luxembourg and build profitable long-term client relationships. The role focuses on generating Net New Money (NNM), growing Assets Under Management (AUM) and increasing gross revenue through high-quality new client acquisition and deeper client solutions. You'll partner across Global Private Banking (GPB) and Commercial Banking (CMB) to bring the right products and services to clients and prospects. Success means delivering agreed financial targets through a strong pipeline, effective referrals across the Group and consistently high standards of client service. You'll also shape a strong risk and control environment with clear expectations on KYC, sales quality and compliance.

In this role, you will (but not limited to):

• Lead and manage the Netherland Market composed of Senior Relationship Managers (hunters), as well based out of PBLU.
• Drive business development efforts through the focus on new client acquisition of UHNW and Family Office segments in the Netherlands and other key International markets related to your business.
• Stir share of wallet increase discipline with the existing UHNW client base through systematic client planning, sales management, client connectivity and other means.
• Ensure collaboration with other markets and locations within HSBC Private Banking, as well as enhance connectivity with HSBC Commercial and Global Banking business lines in the Netherlands and other key International markets.
• Promote brand visibility of HSBC Private Banking in the Netherlands and other key International markets through various initiatives, including proactive marketing, communication, collaboration with business introducers.
• Actively promote, manage, train, develop and assess all members of the team within assigned area of responsibility.

You should apply if you have:

• Min. 10 years of relevant experience in Private Banking within UHNW Netherlands and other key International client segments.
• Strong hunter mindset, proven track record of growing the business and driving acquisition of new clients.
• Demonstrated track record of leading a team of Relationship Managers.
• Decision maker, capable of providing judgment and clear direction within the established framework.
• Fluency in English and Dutch. French and/or German would be an asset.

Even if you feel you do not meet 100% of our qualifications, we encourage you to apply, if you believe this role is right for you.

What you'll get in return:

The pay range for this role is €200,000 – €350,000.

HSBC operates multiple variable pay plans, to reflect the diverse nature of the businesses, roles and markets in which we operate. Variable pay is designed to reward colleagues for their individual performance and contribution, as well as the performance of their relevant Business / Infrastructure, and the overall Group.

We offer a comprehensive and competitive package of benefits usually covering health support, life assurance, pension, and family friendly leaves, as well as many other benefits to support your wellbeing.

HSBC has been certified “Top Employer 2026” in Europe. This recognition from the Top Employers Institute rewards our HR practices and recognises HSBC as an HR Leader in France, Germany, Italy, Ireland, Luxembourg, The Netherlands, Poland and Spain.

If you're looking for a career where you will be respected as an individual and valued for the contributions you make, please visit our career page, and discover how diversity drives our success.

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we're dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. If you have a need that requires accommodations or changes during the recruitment process, please let us know.

Please note that every selected candidate will have to provide us with a valid criminal record check in due time.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website. For any GDPR request, please send it to: lux.data.privacy@hsbc.com

For further information on building your career at HSBC, please visit: www.hsbc.com/careers

We’re looking for a Strategic Finance Business Partner to support our AI team and other business functions. Our Strategic Finance Business Partnership team serves as a trusted advisor to the company, driving our financial planning, forecasting, and review processes, and guiding critical decisions through insightful analyses and strategic thought partnership.

This is a high-impact role on a lean team: you’ll partner deeply across Engineering and Product to strengthen executive-level visibility into financial performance, improve forecast accuracy, and evaluate strategic investments across our product.

 - Strengthen AI cost data and reporting infrastructure by identifying data gaps, improving recurring workflows, and using AI and automation to make reporting more durable, scalable, and timely.

 - Strong work ethic, reliability, and attention to detail — “get it done” attitude

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

jobs.description: SVEUČILIŠTE JOSIPA JURJA STROSSMAYERA U OSIJEKU MEDICINSKI FAKULTET OSIJEK raspisuje NATJEČAJ za izbor 1. u Katedri za pedijatriju 1.1. izbor jednog (1) zaposlenika/zaposlenice na znanstveno-nastavno radno mjesto docenta iz znanstvenog područja Biomedicine i zdravstva, znanstvenog polja kliničke medicinske znanosti, na neodređeno vrijeme u nepunom radnom vremenu s 20% radnog vremena u Katedri za pedijatriju Medicinskog fakulteta Osijek u sastavu Sveučilišta Josipa Jurja Strossmayera u Osijeku. Kandidati natječaja za izbor zaposlenika/zaposlenice na znanstveno-nastavno radno mjesto docenta dužni su ispunjavati opće uvjete propisane Zakonom o radu („Narodne novine” br. 93/14., 127/17., 98/19., 151/22. i 64/23.) te posebne uvjete propisane člankom 39. stavkom 1. Zakona o visokom obrazovanju i znanstvenoj djelatnosti („Narodne novine” br. 119/22.), uvjete utvrđene Nacionalnim sveučilišnim, znanstvenim i umjetničkim kriterijima („Narodne novine“ br. 42/26.), člankom 123. stavkom 1. Statuta Sveučilišta Josipa Jurja Strossmayera u Osijeku, člankom 58. stavkom 1. Statuta Medicinskog fakulteta Osijek, pročišćeni tekst i člankom 3. Pravilnika o dodatnim uvjetima za izbor nastavnika na znanstveno-nastavna radna mjesta i izbor naslovnih nastavnika Medicinskog fakulteta Osijek, pročišćeni tekst. Svi navedeni akti objavljeni su na mrežnoj stranici Medicinskog fakulteta Osijek, www.mefos.unios.hr (dokumenti). Kandidati za izbor na znanstveno-nastavno radno mjesto docenta (točka 1.1.) prijavljuju se na Obrascu br. 1. koji je objavljen na mrežnoj stranici www.mefos.unios.hr. Obrasci za prijavu nalaze se na mrežnoj stranici Medicinskog fakulteta Osijek, www.mefos.unios.hr (dokumenti – izbor nastavnika i suradnika – obrasci za izbore u zvanja). Na obrascu za prijavu na natječaj obvezno je naznačiti točku iz natječaja i radno mjesto na koje se kandidat prijavljuje. Sve informacije o tijeku postupka izbora bit će objavljene na mrežnoj stranici www.mefos.unios.hr Medicinskog fakulteta Osijek www.mefos.unios.hr. Za kandidate koji ne pristupe razgovoru/intervjuu pred Povjerenstvom smatra se da su povukli prijavu na natječaj i neće se smatrati kandidatima natječaja. Za kandidate Natječaja koji su strani državljani potrebno je priložiti dokaz o poznavanju hrvatskog jezika u skladu s Zajedničkim europskim referentnim okvirom za jezike napredno znanje (C2). Kandidati koji se na temelju posebnih propisa – Zakon o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“ br. 121/17., 98/19., 84/21. i 156/23.), članka 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata („Narodne novine“ br. 84/21. i 13/26.) i članak 48. f. Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata („Narodne novine“ br. 33/92., 57/92., 77/92., 27/93., 58/93., 2/94., 76/94., 108/95., 108/96., 82/01., 103/03., 148/13. i 98/19.), članak 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom („Narodne novine“ br. 157/13., 152/14., 39/18. i 32/20.) pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, obvezni su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo te priložiti sve dokaze koje posebni propisi propisuju za ostvarivanje tog prava. Navedeni kandidati ostvaruju prednost pri zapošljavanju u odnosu na ostale kandidate, samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Za kandidate koji se u prijavi na natječaj pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema Zakonu o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“ br. 121/17., 98/19., 84/21. i 156/23.) i Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata („Narodne novine“ br. 84/21. i 13/26.) popis dokaza potreban za ostvarivanje tog prava dostupan je na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843 Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom („Narodne novine“ br. 157/13., 152/14., 39/18. i 32/20.) u prijavi na natječaj dužni su se pozvati se na to pravo te priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, kao i dokaz o invaliditetu. Na natječaj se pod jednakim uvjetima mogu prijaviti osobe oba spola. Kandidatima prijavljenim na natječaj smatrat će se samo osoba koja podnese pravovremenu i potpunu prijavu te ispunjava formalne uvjete natječaja. Potpunom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u ovom natječaju i koja je vlastoručno potpisana od kandidata koji je podnio prijavu na javni natječaj. Nepravovremene i nepotpune prijave neće se razmatrati. Prijavom na Natječaj, kandidat daje privolu da se svi njegovi osobni podaci sadržani u natječajnoj dokumentaciji prikupljaju i obrađuju u svrhu provedbe natječaja u skladu s propisima koji uređuju zaštitu osobnih podataka posebno Uredbom (EU) 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i Vijeća od 27. travnja 2016. godine o zaštiti pojedinca u vezi s obradom osobnih podataka i o slobodnom kretanju takvih podataka te o stavljanju izvan snage Direktive 95/46/EZ (Opća uredba o zaštiti podataka). Kandidati Natječaja uz prijavu na natječaj obvezni su priložiti popunjen i potpisan Obrazac privole za prikupljanje i obradu osobnih podataka u svrhu provedbe natječaja. Obrazac privole objavljen je uz Natječaj na mrežnoj stranici Medicinskog fakulteta Osijek www.mefos.unios.hr. Bez uredno popunjenog i potpisanog Obrasca privole uz prijavu na Natječaj, prijava će se smatrati nepotpunom i neće se razmatrati. Svi kandidati Natječaja bit će obaviješteni o rezultatima Natječaja najkasnije u roku od petnaest (15) dana od dana njegova dovršetka. Medicinski fakultet Osijek zadržava pravo obavijestiti sve prijavljene kandidate i putem elektroničke pošte. Dokumentacija uz prijavu na natječaj i dokazi o ispunjavanju uvjeta podnose se u elektroničkom obliku na adresu medicina@mefos.hr s naznakom: „Prijava na natječaj pod točkom ___“ u roku od trideset (30) dana od dana objave natječaja.

jobs.title: POMOĆNIK/CA U NASTAVI
jobs.description: Na temelju članka 99. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (Narodne novine 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10 - ispravak, 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12 - pročišćeni tekst, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20 – Uredba, 151/22, 155/23 i 156/23) Osnovna škola Ivana Granđe objavljuje Javni poziv za zapošljavanje osobe/a za obavljanje poslova pomoćnika u nastavi u Osnovnoj školi Ivana Granđe POMOĆNIK U NASTAVI Broj traženih osoba: - 1 pomoćnik u nastavi Vrsta zaposlenja: Na određeno, nepuno radno vrijeme, do kraja školske godine 2026./2027. Radno vrijeme: 22 sata tjedno Način rada: 2 smjene Naknada za prijevoz: u cijelosti Mjesto rada: Osnovna škola Ivana Granđe, Soblinečka 68, Soblinec,10 360 Sesvete UVJETI za radno mjesto su: prema članku 21. Zakona o osobnoj asistenciji (Narodne novine 71/23):•punoljetna zdravstveno sposobna osoba •završena najmanje razina obrazovanja 4.2. HKO-a •završen Program obrazovanja za pomoćnika u nastavi •pomoćnik u nastavi ne može pružati potporu tijekom odgojno-obrazovnog procesa svom članu obitelji, osim kada na području osnivača odgojno-obrazovne ustanove nije moguće zaposliti pomoćnika u nastavi, a to nije u suprotnosti s interesima učenika s teškoćama u razvoju. Nepostojanje zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa u školskoj ustanovi iz članka 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi („Narodne novine broj“ 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 i 156/23) i članka 23. Zakona o osobnoj asistenciji („Narodne novine“ br. 71/23). OPIS POSLOVA Pomoćnik u nastavi je osoba koja pruža neposrednu potporu učeniku s teškoćama u razvoju tijekom odgojno-obrazovnog procesa. Potpora tijekom odgojno-obrazovnog procesa koju pruža pomoćnik u nastavi može obuhvatiti: potporu u komunikaciji i i socijalnoj uključenosti, potporu u kretanju, pri uzimanju hrane i pića, u obavljanju higijenskih potreba, u obavljanju školskih aktivnosti i zadataka te suradnju s radnicima škole, kao i s vršnjacima učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u razredu, što podrazumijeva razmjenu informacija potrebnih za praćenje i unapređivanje rada s učenikom, a u svrhu izrade izvješća o posebnostima u radu s učenikom te plana rada pomoćnika u nastavi za sljedeću školsku godinu. Poslovi pomoćnika u nastavi određeni su Zakonom o osobnoj asistenciji i Pravilnikom o pomoćnicima u nastavi i stručnim komunikacijskim posrednicima. DODATNA ZNANJA I VJEŠTINE Uvažavanje različitosti, afinitet prema djeci s teškoćama u razvoju, otvorenost, odgovornost, fleksibilnost, razvijene komunikacijske vještine, sklonost individualnom i timskom radu, točnost u izvršavanju poslova, organiziranost i emocionalna stabilnost. POŽELJNO •iskustvo u volontiranju •iskustvo u neposrednom radu s djecom s teškoćama u razvoju Odabir će se izvršiti uz pomoć stručnih metoda procjene kompetencija i osobina podnositelja zahtjeva. Sukladno članku 13. stavku 3. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova (Narodne novine, broj 82/08. i 69/17.) na javni poziv se mogu javiti osobe oba spola. Izrazi koji se koriste u Javnom pozivu, a imaju rodno značenje koriste se neutralno i odnose se jednako na muške i na ženske osobe. Kandidat je prilikom prijavljivanja dužan dostaviti sljedeće dokumente: •zamolbu za posao (vlastoručno potpisanu, navesti datum i mjesto rođenja, adresu stanovanja, broj mobitela i adresu elektroničke pošte), •životopis (ukoliko postoji iskustvo u volonterskom radu potrebno je navesti: naziv institucije/udruge/tvrtke gdje je ono ostvareno, njegovo trajanje ili navesti iskustvo u radu s djecom, poznavanje stranog/ih jezika i sl.), •dokaz o odgovarajućem stupnju obrazovanja (presliku diplome ili potvrdu o stečenoj stručnoj spremi i uvjerenje o završenom Programu obrazovanja za stjecanje djelomične kvalifikacije PUN/SKP), •dokaz nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak za neko od kaznenih djela iz članka 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi i članka 23. Zakona o osobnoj asistenciji (ne starije od 6 mjeseci od dana objave Javnog poziva). Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja prema posebnim propisima, dužne su u prijavi na javni poziv pozvati se na to pravo te priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, te imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osoba koja može ostvariti pravo prednosti: •sukladno čl. 102.
