jobs.title: Supplier Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity


As a Supplier Quality Engineer, you will own supplier quality for a portfolio of critical mechanical, electrical and mechatronic suppliers, from supplier qualification through production and continuous improvement.

The role exists to strengthen our supplier quality processes as ANYbotics scales production and introduces new products. You will work closely with Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, and will spend time directly with suppliers to solve quality issues at the source.

This is a hands-on role: you will not only define processes and requirements, but also audit suppliers, drive corrective actions and make sure improvements are implemented and sustained.


Your Impact

Your Impact

  • Define supplier qualification criteria and establish robust processes for assessing and approving new suppliers.

  • Prepare and maintain supplier audit and assessment frameworks, including questionnaires and checklists.

  • Conduct on-site assessments of critical suppliers and drive audit findings through to closure.

  • Monitor supplier performance, identify recurring quality issues and initiate improvement or development actions where needed.

  • Identify suppliers, manufacturers and service providers requiring Quality Assurance Agreements (QAAs).

  • Develop and maintain QAA templates aligned with ISO 9001 and ISO 80079-34 requirements.

  • Review and negotiate QAA terms with suppliers, covering responsibilities, control points, traceability, non-conformities and other quality requirements.

  • Coordinate internal Quality, Legal and Purchasing approvals for QAAs and monitor ongoing supplier compliance.

  • Define and maintain the supplier NCR process, from detection and reporting through escalation, follow-up and closure.

  • Establish effective NCR templates and tracking tools, and communicate non-conformities clearly with suppliers.

  • Analyse NCR trends and recurring issues to identify systemic quality problems and drive corrective actions.

  • Initiate supplier development, improvement plans or requalification where supplier performance falls below expectations.


Your Profile

  • 5 years  experience in supplier quality management with complex mechatronic product

  • Hands-on experience conducting supplier audits and driving corrective actions through to verified closure.

  • Strong understanding of root-cause analysis, 8D  and structured problem solving.

  • Experience defining and negotiating supplier quality requirements, ideally including Quality Assurance Agreements.

  • Ability to work effectively across Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, while challenging suppliers when quality or delivery requirements are not met.

  • Willingness to travel to suppliers and spend time on-site when required.


Bonus Points
  • Experience with ISO 9001 and/or ISO 80079-34, particularly in an industrial or manufacturing environment.
  • Experience building or improving supplier quality processes in a scaling manufacturing organization.
  • Familiarity with statistical quality tools such as SPC, Cpk/Ppk and Pareto analysis.

    • What We Offer

    • The opportunity to own supplier quality for a portfolio of components directly contributing to the production of autonomous mobile robots.

    • Direct collaboration with Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing and Quality teams in Zurich and with suppliers internationally.

    • The opportunity to build and improve supplier quality processes as ANYbotics scales its production and product portfolio.

    We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.
     
     
    Agency Policy: We are not currently partnering with external search firms or recruitment agencies. Any profiles or resumes submitted to ANYbotics employees without a prior written agreement will be considered public disclosure and the property of ANYbotics, involving no liability or fee for subsequent hiring.

    Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Product Portfolio Senior Manager: Education & Athletes Pathways
jobs.employer: Académie Internationale des Sciences et Techniques du Sport (AISTS)
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about creating seamless experiences in education and sport? Are you sensitive to serving the athletes and bringing them at the center of the sport ecosystem ?  
Do you thrive in dynamic, multicultural environments?  
Are you driven by developing projects and businesses?

Then join AISTS – the International Academy of Sports Management and Technology – and contribute to shaping the future of sports leadership.

About AISTS

AISTS, the International Academy of Sport Management and Technology, is a prestigious not\-for\-profit academic centre at the heart of the global sport industry. Founded in 2000 in Lausanne, Switzerland, it offers world\-class education and advisory services in sport management. AISTS's unique multidisciplinary approach combines expertise in technology, management, economics, medicine, career and leadership. With a network of over 750 alumni, 100 distinguished lecturers, and partnerships with leading sport organisations, AISTS shapes the future of international sport. Located in the Olympic Capital, it serves as a bridge between academia and industry, promoting excellence in sport management to drive positive global impact through the power of sport.

Your role

The Product Portfolio Senior Manager is responsible for translating the AISTS portfolio strategy into a coherent, prioritised and commercially viable product portfolio across three product areas: Education, Athletes Pathways, and Advisory. It initially owns direct responsibility for both Education and Athletes Pathways products streams.

The role ensures that AISTS moves from a primarily MAS\-centred organisation toward an integrated platform combining industry access, short and tailored education, athlete\-career transition solutions, and international sport organisations advisory services ( impact assessments, certification, research mandates, etc.).

Positioning \& Context

Reporting to the Executive Director, you will work in partnership with the Professors, experts, speakers and partners of the AISTS network. Internally, you will work closely with the Head of B2B Partnerships \& Development and the Head of Operations \& Delivery. Initially, you will manage the Sport Advisory Product Coordinator.

This role is established as part of a new strategy adopted and rolled out by AISTS. The scope of the role may evolve according to the deployment of the strategy.

Key responsibilities

**Portfolio Management**

* Own the consolidated product portfolio roadmap across Education, Athletes Pathways and Advisory.
* Establish common product management standards and coherence across products in terms of target audiences, value propositions, pricing logic, delivery model, resource needs and expected contribution.
* Prioritise product development using mission alignment, market demand, revenue potential, profitability, scalability, feasibility and strategic value.
* Translate strategic priorities into clear product briefs, annual product plans, performance indicators and implementation milestones.
* Maintain product governance discipline, ensuring that each product has an owner, business case, delivery model, quality criteria, review cycle and is aligned with B2B development (proposal development) and clearly framed for the Operations and Delivery team to operate
* Provide the Executive Director with a consolidated view of product performance, portfolio risks, dependencies and investment priorities.


**Product ownership**

**1\. Athlete Pathways**

* Design and develop the AISTS Athletes Pathways offer, including education, transition, employability, leadership, entrepreneurship and mentoring formats for active, retiring and retired athletes.
* Build the product value proposition for IFs, NOCs, Olympic stakeholders, athlete commissions, agencies, sponsors and individual athletes.
* Coordinate athlete\-specific curriculum development, mentor pools, career coaching components and storytelling opportunities with alumni, industry experts and corporate partners.
* Track performance of the athlete pathway product, including athletes supported, revenues, scholarships, partner satisfaction and post\-programme outcomes.


**2\. Master of Advanced Studies in Sport Management and Technology (MAS) \& Continued Education programmes**

* Coordinate curriculum architecture, learning formats, field visits, internships, Client Team Projects, research papers and industry exposure to maintain and strengthen the leading positioning of the programme.
* Work with delivery coordinators and academic partners to ensure programme design is feasible, coherent and quality\-controlled.

jobs.description:

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Administrator - Finance & Control to support the financial and administrative operations of a major construction project. The successful candidate will play a key role in maintaining financial records, monitoring project costs, supporting reporting activities, and ensuring compliance with company procedures and project requirements.



Key Responsibilities

    Provide administrative and financial support to the Project Management and Finance teams.
    Maintain project cost records and monitor expenditures against approved budgets.
    Process invoices, purchase orders, supplier payments, and expense claims.
    Assist with monthly cost reporting, forecasting, and budget updates.
    Monitor subcontractor and supplier documentation related to financial matters.
    Support project accounting activities, including reconciliations and accruals.
    Maintain accurate records of contracts, variations, and payment certificates.
    Prepare financial reports and supporting documentation for management review.
    Assist with audits and ensure compliance with internal controls and company policies.
    Coordinate with the site team, procurement department, subcontractors, and headquarters regarding financial and administrative matters.
    Ensure proper filing and document control for all finance-related project documentation.



Qualifications

    Bachelor's degree or diploma in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
    Minimum 3 years of experience in finance administration, project control, accounting, or cost control.
    Previous experience in construction, engineering, EPC, or industrial projects is highly preferred.
    Strong knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Office 365.
    Experience with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar.
    Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced project environment.
    Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
    Fluency in English; knowledge of Swedish is an advantage.

Personal Attributes

    Detail-oriented and highly accurate.
     Strong sense of responsibility and confidentiality.
    Proactive and capable of working independently.
     Excellent planning and time-management skills.
     Ability to collaborate with multicultural project teams.



We Offer

    Opportunity to work on a major international construction project.
    Dynamic and multicultural working environment.
    Professional development and career growth opportunities.
    Competitive compensation package.

Interested candidates are invited to submit their CV and cover letter, detailing their relevant experience in finance, administration, and construction project support.

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Architect
Growth Lead, France
jobs.description:
About the Team

The Growth team drives user and revenue growth across ChatGPT’s consumer and business segments worldwide. We work across the full funnel, from acquisition and activation to retention and monetization, through product experiments, in-product improvements, performance marketing, creative development, and AI-powered workflows.

The International Growth team works with regional leaders in priority markets to identify the user needs and product gaps that matter most for adoption, usage, and monetization. We turn country priorities into product roadmaps and growth plans, then partner with engineering, research, design, data science, marketing, finance, policy, and partnerships to test and ship improvements.

We combine product strategy with hands-on growth operations. We account for local behavior, competition, and product experience while building shared capabilities such as segmentation, lifecycle journeys, and experimentation systems. We measure what ships, adapt it to the market, and scale approaches that work across markets.

About the Role

We’re looking for a growth lead in France to shape and execute ChatGPT’s growth plans. You’ll partner with the France GM to understand local users, identify the biggest growth opportunities, and turn those priorities into product improvements, funnel optimizations, and performance marketing tests. You’ll work across acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization, collaborating with Product, Engineering, Design, Data Science, Partnerships, and Marketing teams to influence priorities and ship measurable impact. The role combines product growth and funnel optimization with performance marketing: connecting audience, message, creative, and channel learnings to better in-product journeys.

In this role, you will:

  • Partner with the France GM, regional teams, and central teams to set a country growth plan and roadmap priorities, with clear hypotheses, owners, dependencies, and measurable outcomes.

  • Use user research, funnel and cohort data, and competitive insight to find local friction and prioritize the opportunities that matter most to users.

  • Run performance marketing tests in collaboration with regional marketers across relevant channels, creators, and partners; use incrementally, CAC, payback, and LTV to decide what to scale.

Chez Lexroom, nous développons l'état de l'art de la recherche juridique agentique. Notre plateforme décompose chaque question juridique en sous-questions précises, puis mobilise des agents spécialisés pour explorer en parallèle les codes, jurisprudences, doctrines et textes européens. Chaque source est minutieusement analysée, les liens implicites entre principes sont identifiés, et toutes les informations sont synthétisées dans un rapport structuré, avec chaque affirmation soigneusement sourcée. Ce qui, auparavant, demandait une semaine à une équipe se réalise désormais pendant une pause café.

Notre mission : rendre le droit plus rapide, plus clair et plus fiable, afin que les avocats et les directions juridiques puissent se concentrer sur l'essentiel.

jobs.title: Senior Solution Engineer (FR)
jobs.description:
🌀 The Company

Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action.

Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

 

🎯 The Role

We're looking for a Senior Solution Engineer to join our Go-to-Market team and help us guide our most strategic prospects and customers in adopting and integrating Filigran’s open source platforms — OpenCTI & OpenAEV. You’ll play a key role at the intersection of technical expertise and client enablement by running demos, delivering workshops, building prototypes, and translating customer needs into integrated technical solutions.

Your work will directly support our Sales, Customer Success, and Product teams by enabling strong adoption, trust, and long-term success with Filigran’s ecosystem.

💼 Your Responsibilities

  • Deliver technical and functional guidance to key prospects and customers

  • Build and run product demonstrations and workshops tailored to use cases

  • Design technical solutions aligned to customer architecture and business goals

  • Lead successful Proof-of-Value (PoV) deployments and maintain healthy environments

  • Support smooth handovers from Sales to Customer Success

  • Represent Filigran as a technical advisor in client discussions, from dev teams to C-level

  • Contribute to technical documentation, training, and integration projects

  • Maintain strong relationships with the OpenCTI community and users

  • Work closely with Product, Engineering, and Marketing to feed back insights and influence the roadmap

🤝 Who You’ll Work With

  • Reports to the CRO or Head of Presales (depending on region)

  • Works cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering

  • Collaborates closely with leadership (CEO, CRO) on go-to-market strategies

  • Engages with community members and technical users of our open source platforms

🧬 Profile We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years in a Solution Engineering, Technical Account Management, Consulting, or Presales role

  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity or crisis management topics

  • Ability to explain technical concepts to both engineering and non-technical stakeholders

  • Experience leading workshops, technical trainings, or product demos

  • Comfortable operating in a remote-first, fast-paced, and collaborative environment

  • Fluent in French and English

  • Bonus: Prior experience in threat intelligence, SOC, breach and attack simulation/pentesting or public sector cybersecurity

🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job.

We are a fast-growing, global and remote-first company, and we believe the best work combines purpose, impact and innovation. You’ll work alongside talented people across the world who care about what they build, how they build it, and the impact they make on the broader cybersecurity ecosystem.

⭐ Be part of something bigger

We believe we do work that matters. Our open-source approach means that work extends beyond Filigran. You’re contributing to technology and ideas that strengthen a global community of defenders and help make cybersecurity more open and collaborative.

💻 Work at the edge of what’s next

We bring together cybersecurity, open source and AI — giving you the opportunity to work with emerging technologies, experiment with new ways of working, and contribute to how they are applied in practice.

🌍 Global opportunity without borders

Be part of a fast-growing, truly international team — collaborating across Europe, North America, APJ and beyond, with the flexibility of a remote-first environment. As we grow, you’ll have opportunities to expand your scope, take ownership, learn quickly and grow with us.

🧭 A culture grounded in CORE

Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity define how we work together — with openness, ownership, collaboration and respect. These are the principles that guide how we make decisions, treat people and grow together, especially when no one’s watching.

💰 What you can expect

  • Competitive compensation + equity — everyone shares in our success

  • Remote-first flexibility — work from wherever you’re based, with flexibility built into how we operate

  • 25 days PTO baseline — real time to disconnect, recharge and enjoy life outside work

  • Volunteer days — paid time to contribute to causes that matter to you

  • Set up for success — choose the equipment that works for you, with additional support for your remote work and development needs as our programs evolve

  • Two annual in-person get-togethers — one global company get-together and one team get-together, creating dedicated time to connect, collaborate and strengthen our culture beyond the screen

🌍 Equal Employment Opportunity

We enable cybersecurity through inclusion — from code to culture.

At Filigran, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe the diversity of our people makes our products and our team stronger. We welcome talent of every background, identity and lived experience, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability or veteran status.

What matters here is what you bring, not what you look like, where you’re from or how you identify.

🚀 Ready to Join Us?

Apply now and help us build the future of the cybersecurity ecosystem, together.

- Neuvojan tulee pyrkiä löytämään oikea tieto asiakkaan kysymykseen. Hänen tulee myös pystyä asioimaan asiallisesti ja ymmärrettävästi puhelimitse ja sähköpostitse eri palveluntuottajien ja viranomaisten kanssa. Työssä tarvitaan myös hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja, asiakaspalvelun ja kohtaamisen taitoja sekä kulttuurisensitiivisyyttä.

- Neuvojan suomen kielen taito tulee olla vähintään B2.2 taitotaso, jotta hän voi kommunikoida eri viranomaisten ja työntekijöiden kanssa sekä suullisesti että kirjallisesti, ja auttaa asiakkaita kirjallisesti lomakkeiden täytössä sekä muussa kirjallisessa viestinnässä. Hyvää suomen kielen taitoa tarvitaan myös erilaisessa tiedonhankinnassa sekä ohjauksen tiimityössä.

- Neuvojalla tulee olla vähintään ammatillinen peruskoulutus ja suoritettu ammatillinen tutkinto ja vähintään yhden vuoden kokemus maahanmuuttajien ohjaus- ja neuvontatyöstä tai vastaavasta työstä tai vapaaehtoistyöstä (esim. ohjaaja, kouluttaja tms.).

jobs.title: Global Head of Land Revenue
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As Global Head of Land Revenue, you’ll build and run the global operating system that drives Land: the strategy, programs, and operating mechanisms that create net-new and upgrade iARR across regions.

This role is the global owner for new business standards, pipeline programs, and operating cadence. You’ll set the way for landing new business revenue globally, partner with Regional GMs who own regional P&L outcomes, and ensure consistent execution through scalable programs, playbooks, enablement, and governance.

You’ll partner closely with Marketing, RevOps, Enablement, EPD, Partnerships, Sales leadership, and regional teams to improve pipeline quality, win rates, conversion, and time-to-productivity. You’ll also design operating standards that balance regional accountability with global program consistency.

You’ll be measured on qualified pipeline creation, coverage, conversion, program ROI, velocity, handoff quality, and BDR/SC ramp outcomes—requiring you to operate with strong systems thinking, executive presence, and cross-functional influence.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Build and lead the global net-new business motion: define strategy, program portfolio, operating cadence, governance, and performance standards across regions

 - Own the global net new business strategy for Land, including ICP and segmentation guardrails, plays, coverage model assumptions, annual and quarterly planning, sequencing, and investment trade-offs

 - Establish global definitions and standards for stages, qualification, handoffs, pipeline math assumptions, and reporting integrity

 - Build and run global pipeline generation programs in partnership with Marketing and regional leaders, including campaign-to-pipeline motions, partner-sourced pipeline programs, ABM or named-account plays, and field event program standards

 - Define the measurement framework for new business programs, connecting inputs to outputs and outcomes across cost, pipeline, iARR, velocity, and win-rate lift

 - Partner with SC leadership and practice owners to ensure the Land-side SC motion has standard plays, discovery patterns, demo and problem-solving expectations, certification paths, ramp mechanisms, and ongoing bar-raising rituals

 - Run the global new business operating cadence, including weekly program reviews, monthly pipeline health inspection, quarterly planning, escalation paths, and decision-rights models

 - Partner with Regional GMs, Marketing, RevOps, Enablement, EPD, Product, and Partnerships to align new business programs, systems, content, enablement, feedback loops, and change management




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Senior GTM leadership experience owning new business acquisition programs at scale across multiple regions

 - Deep understanding of pipeline mechanics and how to influence conversion levers end-to-end, including qualified pipeline creation, coverage ratios, lead response, handoff quality, stage progression, win-rate lift, and velocity

 - Strong program-building instincts: you can design scalable plays, instrument them with data, and run an inspection cadence that drives behavior change

 - Experience building operating systems for global teams, including cadences, dashboards, governance, playbooks, definitions, and change-management mechanisms

 - Executive presence and cross-functional leadership: able to align and influence Regional GMs, Marketing, RevOps, Enablement, EPD, Partnerships, and regional teams without relying on direct reporting lines for every dependency

 - Ability to balance regional autonomy with global craft excellence: you set the bar, create standards, and drive consistency while enabling local execution

 - Strong enablement and role-design instincts, with the ability to define expectations, onboarding paths, certification standards, and time-to-productivity mechanisms for BDR and SC motions

 - Builder orientation and comfort in ambiguity: you create the playbook while the org is executing, and you iterate quickly based on market, customer, and performance signals

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and help customers achieve better outcomes.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience with solution-led selling motions and technical or product-adjacent go-to-market

 - Track record building global programs that still allow regional adaptation

 - Experience partnering deeply with Marketing, Partnerships, RevOps, and Enablement to create measurable net new business impact

 - Experience designing partner-sourced pipeline programs, ABM or named-account motions, or field event program standards at scale

We hire talented and passionate people from a variety of backgrounds because we want our global employee base to represent the wide diversity of our customers. If you're excited about a role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every bullet point listed in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. If you're a builder at heart, share our company values, and enthusiastic about making software toolmaking ubiquitous, we want to hear from you.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. jobs.title: Souschef søges til 7-Eleven
jobs.description:
Souschef søges til 7-Eleven

Vi søger en engageret og ansvarsbevidst souschef til vores 7-Eleven-butik på Istedgade.

Som souschef bliver du en vigtig del af den daglige drift og kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med butikschefen og resten af teamet. Du skal være med til at sikre en veldrevet butik, høj kundeservice og en god oplevelse for både kunder og medarbejdere.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet bestå af daglig drift af butikken, kundeservice og salg, koordinering og oplæring af medarbejdere, varebestilling og vareopfyldning, modtagelse af leverancer, kontrol af lager og svind, kassehåndtering og kasseafstemning samt sikring af, at butikkens standarder for rengøring, fødevaresikkerhed og egenkontrol bliver overholdt.

Du vil desuden hjælpe butikschefen med vagtplanlægning og den daglige ledelse af medarbejderne og have ansvar for butikken, når butikschefen ikke er til stede.

Vi forventer

Vi søger en person, der er serviceminded, stabil og ansvarsbevidst og som trives i en travl butik med mange kunder.

Erfaring fra detailhandel, convenience, restaurant eller lignende er en fordel. Ledererfaring er ligeledes en fordel, men det vigtigste er, at du har lyst og evne til at tage ansvar og lede andre medarbejdere.

Du skal kunne arbejde selvstændigt, bevare overblikket i travle perioder og være fleksibel i forhold til arbejdstider.

Da butikken har åbent alle ugens dage, vil arbejdstiden kunne ligge på dag-, aften-, nat- og weekendvagter.

Du skal kunne kommunikere på dansk og/eller engelsk på et niveau, der gør dig i stand til at varetage jobbet.

Vi tilbyder

Vi tilbyder en fast fuldtidsstilling i en travl og spændende 7-Eleven-butik med ansvar og mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling.

Arbejdstiden er fuldtid og planlægges efter vagtplan.

Løn, pension, ferie og øvrige ansættelsesvilkår aftales i forbindelse med ansættelsen og følger de gældende regler og vilkår for stillingen.

Stillingsbetegnelse: Souschef
Ansættelse: Fastansættelse
Arbejdstid: Fuldtid
Antal stillinger: 1
Tiltrædelse: Efter aftale

Er du interesseret i stillingen, ser vi frem til at modtage din ansøgning og dit CV.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Project Manager for our client in the media sector.

Role Description:
The client is currently looking for an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead the planning and scoping of the automation of our GDPR Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) process. The current process is largely manual and involves multiple teams, systems and data owners. The objective of the assignment is to deliver an approved and actionable plan for future automation, including a documented current-state and gap analysis, aligned Privacy requirements, a governance model and a phased roadmap for technical implementation. The aim is to implement technical automation of the GDPR process starting from next year.

The DSAR process has an established process owner who owns the process and related business decisions. The Senior Project Manager will work closely with the process owner and coordinate the initiative across Privacy, Legal, Data, Technology and relevant business stakeholders. Team size of 15-20 people.

· Prioritised, phased automation roadmap

🚀 We’re Hiring: Software Responsible | Gothenburg

We’re looking for a Software Responsible to join Aurobay Technologies and contribute to the development of next-generation powertrain solutions—from hybrid engine control systems to fully electric powertrains.

📍 Location: Gothenburg, Sweden

🏢 Work setup: On-site (0% remote)

📅 Assignment: 12 October 2026 – 1 September 2028

💼 Visa: Sweden Work Authorization visa is mandatory and no visa sponsorship is available for this role.

⏳ Availability: Immediately/On a short notice

Employer: Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB

⚙️ About the Role

As a Software Responsible, you’ll be the component owner for software within your project, taking responsibility for coordinating and delivering software solutions to both suppliers and customers.

You’ll work as part of a high-performing team of Software and Hardware Engineers, led by a Group Project Leader, and collaborate closely with Base Technology Architects.

Depending on the project, you’ll be responsible for the software of an ECU or inverter and will coordinate the development of Base Software throughout different project phases.

🎯 Your Responsibilities

You will:

    Own and lead software deliverables towards suppliers and customers
    Coordinate the development of Base Software for ECUs or inverters
    Act as the primary technical contact towards the supplier
    Secure technology, cost, and timing according to project targets
    Understand and translate requirements into technical solutions
    Coordinate with function owners and plan implementation according to specifications
    Collaborate closely with Software, Hardware, and Architecture teams
    Contribute to the development of advanced powertrain control systems

🔧 What We’re Looking For

Education:

    M.Sc. or B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or equivalent relevant experience

Experience:

    Experience in Base Software development
    Experience with products such as ECM, inverters, TCM, or similar
    Knowledge of AUTOSAR is valuable
    Experience with application software and software integration is a plus

Languages:

    Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken
    Good knowledge of Swedish is desirable

🌍 What We Value

We’re looking for someone who is:

    🤝 Collaborative and caring
    🌎 Comfortable working in a global environment
    💡 Passionate about innovation
    🎯 Driven to deliver excellence
    🔧 Interested in developing both technical and professional skill.

📌 Important Information

This is an on-site assignment in Gothenburg. Consultants are expected to work in a remote desktop environment and provide their own equipment, including a computer and phone when required.

⚠️ The position may be filled before the application deadline. Applications are therefore encouraged as soon as possible.

jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE


We’re seeking our first M&A / Corporate Development hire to build and own the function, driving acquisition strategy and end-to-end execution to accelerate Replit’s core capabilities. You’ll build and run Replit’s acquisition pipeline, identifying the teams and technologies that can accelerate our mission. You’ll develop a deep understanding of the AI, developer tools, and software infrastructure ecosystem. You’ll build relationships with founders, investors, and industry participants to source and evaluate mergers & acquisitions.

This is a hands-on ownership role for someone who combines strong transaction execution skills with product judgment, relationship-building ability, and the ability to drive complex decisions across teams. You’ll work closely with senior leadership and teams across Product, AI, Engineering, People and Legal. The role reports to the Head of Finance, but partners very closely with our Co-Founder & CEO and President & Head of AI.



What You’ll Do

 - Shape M&A strategy: Partner with senior leadership to define where M&A can accelerate Replit’s product and company strategy, translating strategic priorities into actionable acquisition themes and target areas.

 - Source opportunities: Proactively identify acqui-hire, tuck-in and large-scale acquisition opportunities aligned with Replit’s strategic priorities.

 - Develop relationships: Establish trusted relationships with founders, investors, bankers, operators, and other participants across the ecosystem. Identify and attend industry events to source M&A opportunities.

 - Map the ecosystem: Build and maintain a detailed view of relevant markets, including AI infrastructure, developer tools, emerging technologies, competitors, and potential M&A targets.

 - Evaluate strategic fit: Assess companies and opportunities based on product alignment, market position, technical differentiation, financial profile, and potential value to Replit. Partner with Product, AI, and Engineering leaders to assess build, buy, and partner alternatives and deliver clear go/no-go recommendations.

 - Lead transaction execution: Own the transaction process from initial evaluation through signing and closing. Lead valuation and financial modeling, structure transactions, drive cross-functional due diligence, and lead negotiations in partnership with executive sponsors and Legal. Be accountable for the deal workplan, timelines, risk escalation, and decision materials. Coordinate integration planning with functional leaders, establishing clear owners and success measures before close.



Required Skills and Experience

 - 8+ years of experience in corporate development, venture capital, investment banking, or a related strategic role.

 - Strong product & technological intuition.

 - Demonstrated experience leading technology transactions through signing and closing, with direct responsibility for valuation, due diligence, transaction structuring, and negotiation.

 - Experience researching markets, identifying companies, and developing actionable opportunity pipelines.

 - Strong financial modeling, valuation, and analytical skills.

 - Ability to synthesize complex product, technical, market, and financial information into clear recommendations.

 - Strong relationship-building and written and verbal communication skills.

 - High degree of ownership, curiosity, and comfort operating in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment.

 - Proven ability to own complex transaction workstreams, hold cross-functional teams accountable to deadlines, and resolve issues across technical, business, and external advisory teams.



Bonus Points

 - Existing relationships across the AI, developer tools, or software infrastructure ecosystem.

 - Experience at a scaling technology company.

 - Current Replit user.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

jobs.title: Practice Assistant @ White & Case
jobs.description:
Are you a skilled assistant eager to grow your expertise in an international law firm? Do you thrive on helping others in a fast-paced environment? Are you known for your proactive and detail-oriented approach to work?

If you answered **YES**, please keep reading, because this could be the position for you!

**We are looking for** a practice assistant to join White & Case's team in a full-time, permanent position. Key tasks in this role include assisting lawyers with client-related work, along with other tasks to ensure that the daily operations run smoothly at the office. As a practice assistant, you will join a dynamic team of 45 professionals in the Helsinki office.

**In this role,** you will provide assistance across all practice groups. Your responsibilities include a wide range of administrative tasks, such as assisting lawyers with editing and formatting legal documentation, conducting research, providing translation support, as well as preparing and maintaining transaction data rooms. In addition, your duties include liaising with clients, various governmental authorities as well as White & Case's global offices. As a practice assistant, you are also ready to provide support with meeting arrangements, calendar management and other back-office duties.

**You will join** an efficient team of four practice assistants as the fifth member of the team and share your daily work with three evening assistants, a reception assistant and a senior practice assistant. White & Case's team works mainly on-site at their office in the heart of Helsinki, with the flexibility to work remotely once a week during most weeks.

**You may be the person we are looking for if you:**

- have at least one year of experience in a legal assistant or an administrative assistant role within a professional services organization, ideally in a law firm, consulting firm or financial institution;

- have a suitable educational background, such as a Bachelor of Business Administration degree;

- are highly organized and demonstrate great attention to detail;

- enjoy taking initiative and working independently while valuing teamwork and supporting your colleagues;

- are skilled in managing multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a high quality in your work;

- have excellent interpersonal skills and strong written and oral communication skills in Finnish and English; and

- are proficient in MS Office programs (especially Word) and able to quickly learn new software and systems.


**White & Case offers you:**

- an opportunity to work in a dynamic environment within a highly regarded international law firm;

- a diverse, key support role where you will also have the opportunity to assist lawyers with client assignments;

- a close-knit work community that invests in the development of each team member; and

- comprehensive benefits, including extensive occupational healthcare, optional health and accident insurance, and internal training opportunities to support your development. In addition, White & Case offers a selection of alternative benefits, which can be used, for example, for dental care, eyeglasses, a public transport pass, cultural activities or sports.


**Interested?** Send us your CV and cover letter **in English** by **Monday 12 October 2026**. We encourage you to apply early, as we will start reviewing applications already during the application period. If you would like to discuss the position in more detail, feel free to reach out to Minjons recruitment consultant Milla Numminen (from Monday to Wednesday and on Friday, +358 50 336 4396 / milla.numminen@minjon.fi).

_White & Case is a leading global law firm with lawyers and staff in 43 offices across 29 countries, working in virtually every country of the world with a long-established presence in Finland and the Nordic region. White & Case's lawyers and business services professionals are globally minded, enterprising, collaborative and committed to excellence. White & Case operates on a one firm basis, which is present in the day-to-day work of its professionals. They advise multinational corporates, financial institutions and private equity firms on corporate and financing transactions across all major industry sectors. White & Case's core practice areas in Finland are Capital Markets, Debt Finance and M&A/Private Equity._

jobs.title: Vastaava toimintaterapeutti
jobs.description:
**Vastaava toimintaterapeutti – tule rakentamaan kanssamme hyvää arkea ja vaikuttavaa toimintaterapiaa**

Etsimme joukkoomme **vastaavaa toimintaterapeuttia**, joka haluaa yhdistää vahvan toimintaterapiaosaamisen, asiakastyön ja toiminnan kehittämisen. Tässä tehtävässä pääset vaikuttamaan sekä asiakkaidemme kuntoutukseen että koko toimintamme sujuvuuteen ja kehittymiseen. Sinulla tulee olla vähintään toimintaterapeutti (AMK) koulutus sekä Lupa- ja valvontaviraston (Entinen Valvira) laillistus terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilönä. Arvostamme esimerkiksi toimintaterapian YAMK- opintoja tai kiinnostusta joko niiden tai muiden johtamis- ja esihenkilötyötä tukevien opintojen suorittamiseen lähitulevaisuudessa.

Vastaavana toimintaterapeuttina työsi muodostuu monipuolisesti asiakastyöstä (noin 70-80 %), toiminnan koordinoinnista ja hallinnollisista tehtävistä. Tehtävässä pääset hyödyntämään omaa ammatillista osaamistasi, mutta samalla ottamaan vastuuta suuremmista kokonaisuuksista.

**Mitä tehtävä pitää sisällään?**

Tehtävässä vastaat yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa toimintamme laadukkaasta ja sujuvasta toteutumisesta. Työhön kuuluu muun muassa:

- asiakastyötä ja toimintaterapeuttista arviointia sekä kuntoutuksen suunnittelua

- asiakaspaikkojen ja asiakasohjauksen koordinointia

- työntekijöiden työn, tavoitteiden ja toiminnan toteutumisen seurantaa

- työntekijöiden tukemista, ohjaamista ja perehdyttämistä

- toiminnan suunnittelua ja kehittämistä

- hallinnollisia tehtäviä ja talousasioiden seurantaa

- yhteistyötä asiakkaiden, läheisten, työntekijöiden ja yhteistyötahojen kanssa.


Toivomme sinulta kykyä hahmottaa kokonaisuuksia ja viedä asioita käytännössä eteenpäin. Tehtävässä tarvitaan hyviä organisointi- ja yhteistyötaitoja, oma-aloitteisuutta, päätöksentekokykyä sekä kiinnostusta toiminnan kehittämiseen. Arvostamme erityisesti rakentavaa ja kannustavaa työotetta sekä kykyä kohdata erilaisia ihmisiä rauhallisesti ja ammatillisesti.

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää myös valmiutta ottaa vastuuta taloudellisista ja hallinnollisista kokonaisuuksista. Aiempi kokemus esimerkiksi esihenkilötyöstä, hallinnollisista tehtävistä, talouden seurannasta, asiakasohjauksesta tai työntekijöiden tavoitteellisesta ohjaamisesta katsotaan eduksi. Tulet työskentelemään pienessä lämminhenkisessä ja kodinomaisessa perheyrityksessä, jossa välillä pääset pukemaan saappaat jalkaan ja hyppäämään mukaan mitä moninaisempiin toimintoihin.

Olemme sitoutuneet Terveyttä luonnosta – työnantajasitoumuksen kautta tuomaan luonnon osaksi työelämää. Lue lisää Työterveyslaitoksen Terveyttä luonnosta sitoumuksesta täältä.

**Sinulla on mahdollisuus tehdä työstä omannäköistäsi**

Meille toimintaterapia on ennen kaikkea asiakkaan arjen, osallisuuden ja toimintakyvyn tukemista. Haluamme tarjota työntekijöillemme mahdollisuuden toteuttaa terapiaa luovasti ja asiakkaan yksilölliset tarpeet huomioiden.

Meillä on mahdollista hyödyntää **eläinavusteista ja luontolähtöistä työotetta**, ja Green Care -ajattelu on tärkeä osa toimintaamme. Toivomme, että sinulla on suoritettuna **Green Care -perusteet 5 op** -verkkokurssi. Mikäli koulutus ei ole vielä suoritettuna, sitoudut suorittamaan sen ensimmäisen työskentelyvuoden aikana. Tuemme mielellämme myös muun ammatillisen osaamisen ja täydennyskoulutuksen kehittämistä.

Tehtävä edellyttää **rikostaustaotteen esittämistä alle 18-vuotiaiden kanssa työskentelyä varten** sekä voimassa olevia ensiaputaitoja. Toivomme, että sinulla on vähintään **EA1-koulutus** suoritettuna.

Lue lisää https://voimatassu.fi/voimatassu-2/toihin-voimatassulle/

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Jos koet, että tässä voisi olla sinulle sopiva seuraava askel, kuulisimme mielellämme sinusta!

Voit jättää kirjallisen hakemuksen sähköpostitse osoitteeseen **voimatassu@voimatassu.fi** tai alla olevan hakemuslomakkeen kautta mieluiten **30.10.2026 mennessä**.

Laita sähköpostin otsikoksi **Työhakemus vastaava toimintaterapeutti**.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä voit kysyä alla olevan lomakkeen kautta tai soittamalla tai WhatsApp-viestillä numeroon **040 358 9827**. Lisätietoja antaa **Eeva Kahilaniemi** asiakastyön lomassa.

**Tule mukaan rakentamaan kanssamme toimintaterapiaa, jossa ihmiset, luonto ja eläimet voivat olla osa hyvää ja merkityksellist**ä arkea!

jobs.title: Security Engineer - GRC
jobs.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Alan operates at the intersection of health insurance, prevention, and regulated data. The person in this role owns the security governance and risk posture of a company that handles sensitive health data for 1M+ members, operates under DORA and HDS certification requirements, and is regulated by the ACPR. They work in close partnership with Legal, Internal Audit, and the broader Risk function. It's a highly collaborative role.

🛡️ Your mission: Governance, risk & compliance

Own and operate the ISO 27001 ISMS. You are the accountable owner of the Information Security Management System: scope definition, Statement of Applicability, internal audit programme, and management review. You've led at least one full certification or recertification cycle and know what breaks down in the months between audits.

Be the security expert on regulatory and privacy matters. Legal leads on DORA, HDS, RGPD, PGSSI-S, and regulatory relationships. Your role is to bring the technical and operational security substance: translating regulatory requirements into controls, flagging implementation gaps, and making sure the security programme is solid when the regulatory team negotiates with the ACPR or ANS.

Run risk as an ongoing programme, in partnership with the broader risk function. You lead security risk cartography using EBIOS RM and ensure it feeds into, and is informed by, the company-wide risk framework. You facilitate risk workshops, produce treatment plans, and bring the security lens to forums where non-security risks are also on the table. You know when a security risk is really a business risk.

Own the controls framework, but distribute ownership of controls themselves. You define the framework, set the standards, and track coverage, but the controls live with the teams who build and run the things they protect. You work closely with Infrastructure, Platform, and Engineering to ensure foundational building blocks (identity, network, secrets management, logging) are designed with security requirements built in from the start. You work alongside those teams as a partner.

Run audit cycles with rigour, in close partnership with Internal Audit. You manage the security audit programme and coordinate with certification bodies. You work with Internal Audit to align scopes, avoid duplication, and present a coherent picture of control effectiveness to the board. You've sat in joint audit planning sessions and know how to make that relationship work well.

Manage third-party risk. You run vendor security assessments and define contractual security requirements (security annexes, DPAs). You partner with our Risk team, which oversees third-party risk, and own the security dimension.

Bring the health sector context. You understand the ANS framework, CERT Santé requirements, and what it means to handle sensitive health data in day-to-day operations. You're a useful partner to Legal when the question is "what does this regulation actually require us to do technically?"

Own incident governance and support DORA reporting. You classify and escalate ICT incidents internally, own BCP and DRP governance, and provide the security substance for DORA incident reports.

🚀 What you'll build and who you'll work with

Compliance Framework: ISO 27001, DORA, HDS, NIS2. Multiple regulators, multiple countries, one coherent governance backbone. Build the system that lets Alan scale from 1M to many millions of members without rebuilding compliance every time.

Automated Audit & Evidence Engine: Replace manual evidence collection with scripted pipelines plugged directly into engineering systems. Turn audit cycles into a continuous capability instead of a quarterly rush.

Risk Cartography: Risk treated as an operational signal that feeds directly into business and engineering decisions, with EBIOS RM at the core.

You'll work closely with Legal, DPO, Internal Audit, and the broader Risk function, and partner day-to-day with Infrastructure, Platform, Engineering, Product, and Operations. You're the bridge between regulatory complexity and operational simplicity.

⚡ Why this role is special

Direct Impact: You own the trust foundation that lets Alan handle health data for 1M+ members and operate in highly regulated markets. Your work is the precondition for everything else Alan does.

Complex Problems: 4 regulators across 4 countries, sensitive health data, and a regulatory landscape that keeps shifting (DORA, NIS2, AI Act), all to be modeled into a single, coherent control system.

Ownership & Growth: Board and executive exposure, real influence on company-wide risk decisions, and the autonomy to shape Alan's security culture across 800+ people.

🤝 What you will also do: Technical enablement

Automate compliance work wherever possible. You script evidence collection, automate control testing, and connect GRC tooling to engineering pipelines. You've used Python or similar to reduce the manual work of an audit cycle, and you actively look for the next process to streamline.

Configure and own GRC tooling. You can administer platforms like CISO Assistant, ServiceNow GRC, or Archer, designing workflows, building dashboards, and making them genuinely useful for the teams that feed them data.

Speak cloud governance fluently. You understand shared responsibility in HDS-qualified environments, know what CSPM tools surface and what they miss, and can reason about policy-as-code (OPA, SCP) without needing an engineer to translate.

Read architecture well enough to challenge it. You can review a proposed architecture, identify control gaps in identity, network segmentation, encryption, or logging, and push back credibly with engineers even though you're not one.

Interpret vulnerability data and drive prioritisation. You read scan outputs, work with engineering teams to prioritise remediation by business impact over CVSS score alone, and track resolution KPIs over time.

⭐️ Qualifications, mindset and soft skills

You translate risk into business language. You can brief a board or an audit committee and leave them genuinely informed. You know the difference between a finding that requires an emergency board call and one that belongs in a quarterly report.

You influence without authority. You align Legal, DPO, Risk, Engineering, Product, and Operations on security requirements without creating blockers or adversarial dynamics. People come to you early because you make their work easier.

You manage programmes with audit-grade rigor. You run structured, traceable roadmaps. You know where every commitment is, who owns it, and when it's due. You escalate proactively and don't let dependencies surprise you.

You build a genuine security culture. Your awareness programmes land because they're relevant to the people who take them. You foster proportionate risk ownership across the company, so teams make better day-to-day decisions.

You think in principles when frameworks shift. DORA is live. NIS2 transposition pace varies. The AI Act is arriving. When the regulatory landscape moves, you reason from first principles and adapt without waiting to be told what to do.

🌍 How we work

Location: You must be legally eligible to work from France, Belgium or Spain.

Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility, but we value in-person collaboration

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

You want to know more about Alan?

🙌 Perks & Benefits: Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

🤘A strong culture: People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work

jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Research Engineer (Kernel & Inference Optimization) based in France.

You will work at the intersection of AI research, systems engineering, and high-performance model inference.
Your focus will be on developing and optimizing model-serving architectures for advanced AI systems across a range of hardware environments.
You will tackle challenges involving latency, throughput, memory efficiency, and scalability, including deployment on resource-constrained mobile and edge devices.
The role combines hands-on research with low-level engineering, giving you the opportunity to develop novel inference strategies and GPU kernels.
You will work with complex architectures spanning text, image, audio, diffusion models, and vision transformers.
Your work will involve rigorous benchmarking, production testing, and iterative optimization to translate research into measurable performance improvements.
You will collaborate with cross-functional teams in a highly technical, remote environment focused on pushing the boundaries of efficient AI systems.


Accountabilities
  • Design and deploy advanced model-serving architectures optimized for high throughput, low latency, and efficient memory utilization.
  • Develop inference pipelines capable of operating effectively across diverse environments, including resource-constrained mobile devices and edge platforms.
  • Establish clear performance targets covering response latency, token generation speed, throughput, memory footprint, and reliability.
  • Build and execute controlled inference benchmarks in simulated and production environments, tracking latency, throughput, memory consumption, and error rates.
  • Create and maintain representative datasets and simulation scenarios for evaluating model performance under real-world and resource-constrained conditions.
  • Identify computational and memory bottlenecks across inference pipelines and implement solutions involving batching, networking, memory management, and other system-level optimizations.
  • Develop custom GPU kernels and compute shaders for mobile hardware, including solutions written in Metal Shading Language (MSL).
  • Apply advanced inference optimization techniques such as pruning, quantization, Flash Attention, KV caching, and speculative decoding.
  • Design and optimize distributed inference systems using approaches such as tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism, and expert parallelism for large-scale GPU workloads.
  • Work with cross-functional engineering and research teams to integrate optimized inference frameworks into production and edge-device applications.
  • Define evaluation methodologies, document experimental results, compare performance against established benchmarks, and continuously refine optimization strategies.
  • Monitor production performance and use empirical research to identify opportunities for further improvements in scalability, efficiency, and reliability.

    • Requirements:

    • Degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; a PhD in NLP, Machine Learning, or a related discipline is highly relevant, particularly with a strong AI research track record and publications at leading conferences.
    • Proven expertise in Metal Shading Language (MSL), including the ability to write custom compute shaders from scratch.
    • Demonstrated experience with low-level kernel optimization and inference optimization on mobile or other resource-constrained devices.
    • Track record of delivering measurable improvements in inference latency, throughput, and memory footprint for domain-specific applications.
    • Deep understanding of modern model-serving architectures, inference engines, and optimization techniques for high-performance AI deployment.
    • Strong experience writing GPU kernels for mobile devices such as smartphones.
    • Practical experience developing and deploying end-to-end inference pipelines, from model optimization through production integration on constrained hardware.
    • Strong ability to apply empirical research and systematic experimentation to solve latency, computational, and memory challenges.
    • Experience designing robust evaluation and benchmarking frameworks for inference systems.
    • Knowledge of distributed inference techniques, including tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism, and expert parallelism for large-scale GPU clusters.
    • Deep understanding of the mathematical foundations and architecture of diffusion models and Vision Transformers.
    • Familiarity with modern inference optimization techniques including pruning, quantization, Flash Attention, KV Cache optimization, and speculative decoding such as EAGLE.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with an ability to investigate complex system bottlenecks and turn research findings into practical engineering solutions.
    • Excellent English communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with distributed, cross-functional technical teams.

      • Benefits:

      • Opportunity to work on advanced AI systems spanning model serving, inference optimization, mobile computing, edge deployment, and large-scale distributed inference.
      • Remote-first working environment with an international team.
      • Exposure to cutting-edge AI research and practical systems engineering challenges.
      • Opportunity to contribute to performance-critical infrastructure where improvements can have a measurable impact on real-world AI applications.
      • Collaborative environment combining research-driven experimentation with hands-on engineering.
      • Opportunity to work with advanced model architectures including diffusion models, Vision Transformers, and multimodal systems.
      • Access to challenging technical problems involving GPU kernels, inference engines, memory optimization, and distributed computing.

jobs.title: Murersvend søges til Gladsaxe Bygningsentreprise ApS i Bagsværd – frihed, firmabil og ordnede forhold
jobs.description:
Murersvend søges til Gladsaxe Bygningsentreprise ApS i Bagsværd.

Vil du have frihed under ansvar, firmabil og fleksible arbejdstider? Så har vi måske jobbet til dig!

Om stillingen

Hos Gladsaxe Bygningsentreprise ApS søger vi en dygtig og kvalitetsbevidst murersvend til alsidigt og varieret murerarbejde.

Du får stor frihed i hverdagen, arbejder selvstændigt og får mulighed for selv at planlægge og tilrettelægge dine opgaver. Afhængigt af opgaven arbejder du enten alene, sammen med en kollega eller som en del af et større hold.

Du bliver en del af en stabil virksomhed med ca. 20 engagerede kollegaer, hvor vi lægger vægt på ordnede forhold, godt samarbejde og frihed under ansvar.

Vi tilbyder

  • Firmabil, som kan tages med hjem (jf. gældende regler)

  • Frihed under ansvar og mulighed for selv at planlægge din arbejdsdag

  • Fleksible arbejdstider

  • God lønpakke efter kvalifikationer

  • Fast fuldtidsansættelse

  • Ordnede arbejdsforhold

  • Stabilt arbejde og en god ordrebeholdning

  • Alsidige opgaver – både mindre serviceopgaver og større byggesager

  • Gode kollegaer og korte beslutningsveje

  • En fast og tryg arbejdsplads i en solid virksomhed

Dine opgaver kan bl.a. være

  • Renovering og reparation af eksisterende bygninger

  • Opmuring i mursten, Leca og porebeton

  • Reparation og pudsning af vægge, lofter og facader

  • Facaderenovering, netpuds og forskellige pudssystemer

  • Efterisolering og facadeisolering

  • Reparation af murværk og fuger

  • Tagarbejde, herunder tegl, rygninger og grater

  • Flisearbejde, badeværelser, gulve og vægge

  • Mindre ombygninger og renoveringsopgaver

  • Spjæld- og servicearbejde hos private, erhverv og offentlige kunder

  • Større byggesager, hvor du arbejder sammen med vores øvrige håndværkere

Det er ikke et krav, at du kan eller ønsker at udføre alle typer murerarbejde. Hvis du eksempelvis ikke arbejder med fliser, tagarbejde eller spjæld/service, er det ikke nødvendigvis et problem. Vi har forskellige typer opgaver og forsøger at bruge vores medarbejdere dér, hvor deres erfaring og kompetencer passer bedst.

Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er uddannet murer og har erfaring fra faget

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og struktureret

  • Kan planlægge og gennemføre dine egne opgaver

  • Sætter en ære i godt håndværk og kvalitet

  • Har en god omgangstone over for kunder og kollegaer

  • Er stabil og ansvarsbevidst

  • Har kørekort B

  • Har lyst til en arbejdsplads med stor frihed og ansvar

Om os

Gladsaxe Bygningsentreprise ApS er en solid entreprenørvirksomhed med base i Bagsværd og ca. 20 medarbejdere.

Vi udfører bygge- og renoveringsopgaver for private, erhverv, boligforeninger og offentlige bygherrer. Vi arbejder med både murer- og tømrerarbejde samt fag- og hovedentrepriser.

Hos os lægger vi vægt på kvalitet, ordentlighed, godt samarbejde og frihed under ansvar. Vi ønsker, at vores medarbejdere har plads til selv at tilrettelægge deres arbejde og tage ansvar for deres egne opgaver.

Ansøgning

Stillingen er fast og på fuld tid, og vi ønsker tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt.

Send dit CV og en kort ansøgning til:

Gladsaxe Bygningsentreprise ApS
Att.: Johnni Regnarsson
E-mail: johnni@gladsaxebyg.dk

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du også velkommen til at ringe på 50 90 18 74.

jobs.title: Manager, Renewals
Head of Medium Gas Turbine Controls in Engineering
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

You start your day collaborating with engineering leaders, project teams and regional stakeholders to align priorities, resources and customer needs. Throughout the day, you guide strategic initiatives, support project execution, review organizational capabilities and drive continuous improvement activities. You work closely with product management, project execution and regional organizations to strengthen collaboration, develop talent and ensure high-quality controls solutions. By balancing people leadership, operational excellence and business objectives, you help position the Medium Gas Turbine Controls organization for sustainable growth and long-term success.

How You’ll Make an Impact

    Strategic leadership and development of the global Medium Gas Turbine Controls engineering organization, fostering collaboration, accountability, continuous learning and high performance
    Alignment of organizational capabilities, competencies and workforce planning with business growth objectives, future market demands and long-term strategy
    Implementation of the Medium Gas Turbine Controls Service growth plan in close collaboration with regional organizations
    Delivery of high-quality, efficient and reliable engineering execution with a strong focus on customer value, project performance and business results
    Harmonization and continuous improvement of engineering processes, methodologies, standards and digital solutions to increase efficiency, quality and scalability
    Strengthening of cross-functional collaboration, talent development, succession planning and operational excellence across engineering, project execution, product management and regional teams

What You Bring

    Engineering degree or comparable technical background with experience in controls, automation, electrical engineering or related disciplines
    Solid professional experience in Medium Gas Turbines and/or turbine control systems
    Proven leadership experience with a strong commitment to developing people, building high-performing teams and creating an inclusive work environment
    Strong customer orientation and ability to translate business requirements into sustainable and effective engineering solutions
    Strategic mindset, curiosity and passion for innovation, continuous improvement, digitalization and positive organizational change
    Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills in an international environment, fluent English language skills, Swedish language proficiency as an advantage and willingness to travel as required

About the Team

The Medium Gas Turbine (MGT) Controls organization, part of Controls, Digitalization & Nuclear Controls (CD&NUC), is responsible for developing, selling, and delivering innovative and reliable control solutions for the global MGT fleet. Our solutions enable efficient, sustainable, and reliable power generation worldwide.
As a key contributor to a growing business, we combine deep technical expertise with a strong customer focus and a commitment to operational excellence. Our team of approximately 50 professionals, organized across six specialized sub-teams, drives the full spectrum of MGT controls activities, including sales enablement and bid managment, research and development, project execution, and service.

Covering all phases of the control system lifecycle, we play a critical role in shaping the future of MGT controls technology while supporting our customers throughout the entire lifecycle of their assets.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Application

Don’t hesitate – apply via https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/en_US/jobs , id nr 304364 not later than 2026-10-14.
Ongoing selection is applied, the role might be filled before last application date.

We refrain from all contact with staffing and recruitment companies, or advertising brokers.

jobs.title: Account Associate - Retail & Grocery (H/F)
jobs.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Rejoignez-nous dans notre mission de transformer la façon dont le monde mange et fait ses courses. Chez Deliveroo, impact, innovation et croissance sont au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Nous connectons les consommateurs, les restaurants, les magasins et les livreurs partenaires pour donner à chaque personne la possibilité d'acheter ce qu'elle veut, comme elle le veut, quand elle le veut et où elle le veut.

Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie, à l'avant-garde d'un secteur qui connaît une des expansions les plus rapides au monde. Nous avançons rapidement, valorisons l'autonomie, et sommes toujours en recherche de nouvelles idées et de personnes talentueuses pour nous rejoindre!

Ce que vous ferez au quotidien

En tant que Account Associate - Retail & Grocery (H/F), vous serez responsable du succès d'un portefeuille de partenaires, afin d'assurer la meilleure expérience à nos utilisateurs, tout en construisant un partenariat solide et durable avec nos eux pour notre application.

  • Analysez la performance de votre portefeuille et prenez les mesures adéquates, faites des recommandations, soyez agile et ouvert à la nouveauté.

  • Optimisation et gestion de Processus : Deliveroo est une société qui évolue à grande vitesse et à grande échelle. Vous aurez l'opportunité de créer et améliorer des processus, par exemple la gestion de partenariats pour contribuer à la croissance. Vous élaborerez des documents de meilleures pratiques pour des comptes spécifiques et pour l'ensemble du portefeuille

  • Relations avec les magasins Retail et/ou Grocery : Vous gérerez le développement des partenariats, le suivi des données, et vous assurerez une expérience optimale sur l'application afin de faire de Deliveroo le service de livraison à domicile de référence, en apportant votre expertise Food Tech en étant l'expert de votre zone / ville.

  • Vous veillerez au suivi du respect des engagements contractuels pris avec les partenaires de votre portefeuille.

Ce qu'il vous faut pour réussir

  • Expérience : stage ou alternance dans un rôle d'Account management ou commercial. Une expérience terrain au sein d'un grand groupe (idéalement supermarché, marketplace, ecommerce, retailer, FMCG) est un vrai atout.

  • Commercial : vous avez à cœur de négocier, d'anticiper des discussions commerciales, d'entreprendre des actions afin de maintenir un portefeuille de qualité (discussions contractuelles, négociations de mise en place d'outils commerciaux, etc)

  • Entrepreneur : vous avez le goût pour entreprendre, créer, aller chercher des opportunités, en sachant prendre de la hauteur mais sans jamais se couper du terrain et de votre téléphone pour comprendre vos partenaires.

  • Analytique : capable d'être synthétique, d'approfondir les données et de comprendre les données qui permettent d'améliorer les performances pour nos partenaires en magasins.

  • Proactif(-ive) dans vos relations avec les interlocuteurs. Vous adorez être sur le terrain et vous êtes impliqué(e) dans tout ce qui est opérationnel dans votre périmètre.

  • Centré sur le client : être obsédé par nos clients. Utiliser des données quantitatives et qualitatives pour construire un service qui soit opérationnellement excellent pour nos clients.

  • Jouer en équipe : un joueur d'équipe qui collabore et qui est capable de tirer le meilleur parti des personnes qui vous entourent. Capable de travailler efficacement à tous les niveaux de Deliveroo et de réussir avec et par les autres.

  • Optimiste, confiant et plein d'énergie : vous apportez de la fraîcheur, de l'énergie et de la passion dans l'équipe. Vous contribuez à créer un environnement de travail unique, propice aux nouvelles idées et agréable pour les autres personnes impliquées.

  • Langues : Français et Anglais courant indispensables.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Nous sommes des passionnés de food, des problem-solvers, des créateurs de communauté et bien plus encore. Ce qui nous rassemble : un esprit entrepreneurial fort et l'envie de construire quelque chose d'ambitieux ensemble.

🔧 Une grande autonomie pour avoir un impact concret sur votre portefeuille et nos partenaires.
🌱 Un environnement stimulant favorisant l'apprentissage, le développement et l'évolution de carrière.
💙 Des avantages pensés pour le bien-être et l'équilibre de nos équipes.
🌍 Une culture inclusive, internationale et collaborative où chacun peut trouver sa place.

À compétences égales, ce poste est ouvert aux travailleurs et travailleuses en situation de handicap ou assimilés au sens de l'article L5212-13 du Code du travail. Deliveroo s'engage en faveur de la diversité, l'égalité professionnelle, l'emploi des personnes en situation de handicap.

Prêt(e) à contribuer au futur de la foodtech ? Postulez dès aujourd'hui !

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.
