Software Engineer (C++)
jobs.description:
Job description:
Want to build C++ software that helps power the next generation of autonomous and unmanned systems?At Robotto, we build advanced autonomy and software solutions for drones and unmanned systems. Our technology brings together computer vision, C++ software, autonomy, embedded systems and real-world product development.

We are looking for a C++ Software Engineer to join our engineering team and contribute to the software that connects and powers different parts of Robotto's technology platform.This is a hands-on software engineering role for someone who enjoys building reliable systems, solving complex technical problems and seeing their software move beyond development into real-world operation.

The role:
You will develop and maintain C++ software across Robotto's software ecosystem, working on applications and services that support the operation, communication and coordination of our unmanned systems.Depending on the project, your work may span different parts of our platform-from software running alongside our autonomous systems to applications used to configure, control and interact with them.You will work closely with engineers across computer vision, autonomy, embedded software, electronics and testing to develop new capabilities, integrate components and continuously improve the reliability and performance of our systems.

What you will do:
- Design, develop and maintain high-quality software primarily in C++.
- Build software used across our drone and unmanned-systems platform.
- Develop reliable communication and data flows between different software and hardware components.
- Work on performance-sensitive and potentially real-time or near-real-time applications.
- Integrate software with APIs, networking components, sensors and wider system infrastructure.
- Debug complex issues across interconnected software systems and identify root causes.
- Contribute to software architecture and technical design decisions.
- Write maintainable, testable and well-structured production code.
- Participate in code reviews, testing, documentation and continuous improvement of our engineering practices.
- Collaborate closely with computer vision, embedded, autonomy and hardware engineers.
- Support integration and testing on real systems and drone platforms.

What success could look like in your first 3-6 months:
- You have developed a strong understanding of Robotto's software architecture and how the different parts of our platform work together.
- You are contributing production-quality C++ code to our products.
- You have taken ownership of features or components from development through integration and testing.
- You are successfully debugging and solving issues across interconnected systems.
- You are contributing to improved reliability, maintainability and performance of our software.
- You have become a trusted technical partner within the engineering team.

What we are looking forWe are looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems and building software that interacts with real systems.
- Strong professional experience developing production-quality software in C++, with a solid understanding of modern software engineering practices.
- Solid understanding of software architecture, data structures, algorithms and object-oriented design.
- Experience developing multi-component or distributed software systems.
- Experience with networking, inter-process communication, APIs or communication protocols is highly relevant.
- Good understanding of concurrency, multithreading and performance considerations in C++.
- Experience with debugging, testing, version control and modern software development practices.
- Experience with Linux-based development environments is an advantage.
- Experience with robotics, drones, autonomous systems, defence technology or other complex technical products is an advantage, but not a requirement.
- Experience working with software that interfaces with hardware or real-world systems is an advantage.
- Professional fluency in English.
- A degree in computer science, software engineering, robotics or a related field is preferred; equivalent practical experience is equally welcome.

Please apply even if you don't meet every single point. We are interested in what you can bring to the team, your ability to learn and your motivation to work on the challenges we are solving.

Who you are:
Beyond your technical or professional experience, we care about how you work and collaborate.You:
- Are curious and enjoy solving complex problems.
- Take ownership and follow things through.
- Communicate openly about progress, challenges and risks.
- Are comfortable in a growing company where priorities can evolve.
- Enjoy collaborating with people across different disciplines.
- Value testing, learning and continuous improvement.
- Want to contribute rather than simply execute a predefined set of tasks.

Why join Robotto?
Robotto is building advanced autonomy technology for drones and unmanned systems, working at the intersection of software, hardware, computer vision, autonomy and real-world operations.You will be joining Robotto at an exciting stage of our journey as we continue to grow our team, technology and products.

Our teams work across software, computer vision, control, electronics, hardware and real-world testing. This means you will work closely with people from different technical disciplines and see how your work contributes to the wider product.

We are an ambitious and collaborative team, and we value people who take ownership, challenge ideas constructively and want to help build both great technology and a great company.This is not a role where everything is already defined. You will have the opportunity to:
- Work on challenging technology with real-world applications.
- Have meaningful ownership and influence over your area.
- Work closely with talented colleagues across multiple disciplines.
- See your work move from an idea or prototype into real-world use.
- Help shape how we work as the company continues to grow.

More information and application:
https://careers.robotto.ai/jobs/8397119-software-engineer-c

jobs.title: Socialpædagog til kvalitets- og udviklingsarbejde – bliv vores nye faglige fyrtårn på Holstedgaard
jobs.description:
Er du en struktureret pædagog med passion for faglig udvikling, dokumentation og implementering? Vil du være med til at bygge bro mellem teori og praksis og gøre det pædagogiske arbejde målbart og synligt? Så er du måske hende eller ham, vi søger på Holstedgaard.

Om stillingen

Holstedgaard er en selvejende institution, som gennem mange år har oplevet en positiv vækst. Vi er beliggende i Næstved og rummer 69 beboere med forskellige diagnoser inden for det psykiatriske område. I tillæg til dette har mange af vores beboere også komplicerede somatiske lidelser. Alle vores beboere har det til fælles, at de som udgangspunkt ikke er udadreagerende.

I takt med vores udvikling møder vi øgede krav til dokumentation, opfølgning og metodisk anvendelse af pædagogiske principper. For at imødekomme disse krav og løfte vores faglighed endnu mere, opretter vi nu en helt ny stilling. Som vores nye kvalitets- og udviklingspædagog skal du, i tæt samarbejde med ledelsen, være med til at skabe en synlig og struktureret tilgang, der kvalificerer det socialpædagogiske arbejde. Det overordnede afsæt for dit arbejde bliver Socialtilsynets kvalitetsmodel samt den fulde implementering af KRAP.

Stillingen er overvejende administrativ og strategisk, men som fagligt fyrtårn forventer vi, at du kan gå forrest som det gode eksempel i praksis. Du skal kunne understøtte personalet i pressede situationer eller overtage opgaver, når der er behov for det.

Dine kerneopgaver

  • Praksisrefleksion: Du understøtter den faglige refleksion og sparring blandt dine kolleger, så teori og hverdagspraksis kobles naturligt sammen.

  • Systematisk og målbar evaluering: Du anvender evalueringsredskaber (f.eks. KRAP) til at vurdere, måle og synliggøre det pædagogiske arbejde, så kvaliteten bliver observerbar og drøftelig i personalegruppen.

  • Implementering i hverdagen: Du sikrer, at Socialtilsynets kvalitetsmodel og KRAP omsættes til levende, meningsfuld hverdagspraksis for både beboere og personale.

  • Kompetenceudvikling: Du driver faglige udviklingsforløb, igangsætter nye tiltag og fungerer som underviser og facilitator gennem både sidemandsoplæring, mindre grupper og større sammenhænge.

  • Tværfagligt samarbejde: Du arbejder tæt sammen i krydsfeltet mellem det pædagogiske og sundhedsfaglige personale (herunder vores sundhedsfaglige kvalitets- og udviklingssygeplejerske), ledelsen samt eksterne samarbejdspartnere som fx bosteds team og kommuner.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du é uddannet pædagog med en stærk metodisk værktøjskasse og lysten til at gå forrest i faglige forandringsprocesser.

Vi ser gerne, at du:

  • Har kendskab til Socialtilsynets kvalitetsmodel og erfaring med at gøre pædagogisk arbejde målbart og synligt – både internt og over for tilsynsmyndigheder.

  • Har erfaring med implementering af pædagogiske tiltag og formår at arbejde systematisk, struktureret og målrettet, med afsæt i en anerkende tilgang.

  • Trives i rollen som formidler og underviser, uanset om det er på et personalemøde eller via sidemandsoplæring i hverdagen.

  • Har et recovery-orienteret menneskesyn, hvor beboerens trivsel, selvbestemmelse og livskvalitet altid er i centrum.

  • Har kendskab til KRAP-metoden (dette er en fordel, men ikke et absolut krav, så længe du har mod på at tilegne dig metoden og drive den fremad).

  • Kørekort: Det er ikke et must, men en fordel i hverdagen.

Det får du også hos os

  • En skøn samling af beboere, en uformel personalekultur med fokus på udvikling, humor og glæde, samt regelmæssig ekstern supervision.

  • Fordele og goder: Intern opkvalificering, sundhedsforsikring, adgang til motionsrum, pædagogiske måltider samt spændende personalearrangementer og rigtige julegaver (ingen honninghjerter!).

Arbejdstid og rammer

Som udgangspunkt er stillingen uden fast weekend, helligdage og nattevagter, og du vil være selvtilrettelæggende inden for en fast ramme. Vi har en forventning om, at du arbejder hos os mellem 25 og 37 timer, primært i dagstimerne.

Straffeattest

Stillingen er omfattet af loven om pligt til at indhente straffeattest. Ansættelsen kan først påbegyndes, når attesten er indhentet.

Ansøgning og kontakt

Er denne stilling noget for dig, vil vi glæde os til at modtage din ansøgning. Vi afholder ansættelsessamtaler løbende. Hører du ikke fra os, er stillingen gået til anden side. Vi håndterer og sletter alle dine data i overensstemmelse med GDPR.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Helle på telefon 21440953 eller Ann-Sofie på telefon 22757735 

Tiltrædelse: hurtigst muligt

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Senior Computer Vision & AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Do you want to build computer-vision technology that helps autonomous drones understand and navigate the real world?

At Robotto, we build advanced autonomy and software solutions for drones and unmanned systems. Our work brings together computer vision, edge computing, software, electronics and real-world product development.We are looking for a Senior Computer Vision & AI Engineer to take a leading technical role in developing and improving the perception capabilities behind our drone platform.You will work on challenging real-world problems where robust vision, accurate localisation and reliable performance matter. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys going beyond algorithms and prototypes to build computer-vision solutions that perform reliably in demanding real-world environments.

The role:
You will join a highly technical engineering team working on autonomy for drones and unmanned systems.You will take significant ownership of computer-vision capabilities supporting object detection, tracking, visual localisation, visual-inertial odometry and other perception-related challenges.You will work closely with software, control, flight-test and electronics colleagues to turn computer-vision concepts into robust, deployable solutions.As a senior engineer, you will also contribute to architecture and technical decisions, help strengthen engineering practices and share your experience with other engineers across the team.

What you will do:
- Design, develop, test and improve advanced computer-vision algorithms for Robotto's drone and autonomy platform.
- Take technical ownership of computer-vision problems from exploration and prototyping through implementation, evaluation and deployment.
- Work with object detection, tracking, visual localisation, visual-inertial odometry, visual SLAM and related perception challenges.
- Build robust solutions that can perform under changing environmental and operational conditions.
- Optimise computer-vision solutions for deployment on edge and resource-constrained computing platforms.
- Define appropriate datasets, test scenarios, evaluation methods and performance metrics.
- Contribute to architecture and technical-design decisions across the perception stack.
- Collaborate closely with software, control, flight-test and electronics engineers to integrate perception capabilities into the wider platform.
- Investigate complex technical issues, validate results and drive practical improvements.
- Contribute to code quality, testing, documentation and engineering practices.
- Share knowledge and provide technical guidance to other engineers where relevant.

What success could look like in your first 3-6 months:
- You have developed a strong understanding of Robotto's autonomy platform, architecture and computer-vision priorities.
- You have taken ownership of one or more important perception challenges and are driving them towards robust solutions.
- You have contributed meaningful improvements to areas such as object detection, tracking, localisation or visual-inertial odometry.
- Your solutions are being evaluated against real-world data and operational scenarios.
- You are contributing to architecture and technical decisions across the computer-vision stack.
- You are collaborating effectively across computer vision, software, control and flight testing.
- You have become a trusted senior technical contributor within the engineering team.

What we are looking for:
We are looking for an experienced engineer with a strong computer-vision foundation and a track record of turning complex technical ideas into practical, working systems.
- 5+ years of relevant professional experience preferred, with significant hands-on expertise in computer vision, robotics, machine learning, autonomy or a closely related field.

- A good understanding of how vision systems interact with cameras, sensors, software, compute platforms and real-world environments.
- Experience with drones, robotics, autonomous systems or embedded-adjacent software is a strong advantage.
- Experience mentoring, supporting or sharing technical knowledge with other engineers is an advantage.
- Professional fluency in English.
- A degree in computer vision, robotics, computer science, engineering or a related technical field is preferred; equivalent industry or research experience is equally welcome.

Who you are:
You are technically curious, analytical and comfortable taking ownership when the answer is not immediately obvious.You enjoy going deep into difficult technical problems, while keeping sight of the goal: building technology that works reliably in the real world.
- You take ownership of technical problems and drive them towards practical solutions.
- You are comfortable making technical decisions and explaining the trade-offs behind them.
- You challenge assumptions constructively and are willing to explore new approaches.
- You care about robustness, testing and measurable performance.
- You collaborate naturally across computer vision, software, control, electronics and flight testing.
- You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping others solve difficult technical problems.
- You are comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve as the company and technology develop.

jobs.title: Global ESO Quality Specialist
jobs.description:
Global ESO Quality Specialist (Fixed Term 1-Year)

Primary Location: Uppsala, Sweden

At Galderma, we advance dermatology for every skin story. We are now looking for a dynamic and experienced QA Specialist to join our External Supplier Organization (ESO) for Sterile Products.

This role offers an exciting opportunity to work in a global environment, supporting world-leading brands such as Nemluvio and Sculptra while collaborating closely with external suppliers across the globe. As part of ESO, you will play a critical role in ensuring product quality, regulatory compliance, and the continuous improvement of our quality systems and processes.



Position Overview

We are seeking a Quality Assurance Specialist with 2–5 years of experience within the medical device, pharmaceutical, or other regulated industries. The ideal candidate will have expertise across various QA functions, including complaint management, release activities, sterile production, documentation management, and regulatory compliance.

The position is within the External Supplier Organization (ESO) for Sterile Products, and you will work closely with external manufacturing partners and suppliers to ensure the highest standards of quality and compliance throughout the product lifecycle.



Key Responsibilities

    Quality Systems

Contribute to the development, implementation, and maintenance of robust quality systems, including complaint management, deviation management, change control, CAPA, and risk management processes. The main responsibility within the Quality Management System (QMS) area will be complaint management.

    Release Activities

Execute product release activities in compliance with regulatory requirements and company standards. Ensure the timely and accurate release of pharmaceutical products for distribution.

    Sterile Production

Provide QA oversight for sterile manufacturing operations, including aseptic processing, sterilization processes, and environmental monitoring. Ensure adherence to cGMP guidelines, regulatory standards, and applicable ISO requirements.



    Documentation Management

Manage and review quality documentation, including batch records, standard operating procedures (SOPs), risk assessments, validation protocols, and reports. Ensure documentation complies with regulatory requirements, ISO 13485, MDR, and internal quality standards.



    Regulatory Compliance

Stay up to date with regulatory requirements and industry best practices related to quality assurance. Ensure ongoing compliance with FDA regulations, applicable ISO standards, MDR requirements, and company policies.

    Continuous Improvement

Identify opportunities for process improvement and quality enhancement. Participate in quality improvement initiatives and projects aimed at optimizing quality systems and operational efficiency.



Required Qualifications

· Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Chemistry, Biology, or a related field.

· 2–5 years of experience in a Quality Assurance role within the medical device, pharmaceutical, or other regulated industry.

· Fluency in written and spoken English; additional languages are considered an advantage.

· Strong operational knowledge of medical device or pharmaceutical manufacturing processes, including the production of sterile biological drugs, terminally sterilized products, and/or aseptically filled products.

· Proficiency in documentation management.

· Familiarity with regulatory requirements, including cGMP, FDA regulations, ISO 13485, MDR, and international guidelines.

· Excellent communication skills.

· Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.



Preferred Qualifications

· Pharmacist degree or a Master’s degree in Biology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Chemistry, Engineering, Microbiology, Life Sciences, or another relevant scientific or engineering discipline.

· Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.



What We Offer in Return

You will be working for an organization that embraces diversity and inclusion and believes that better outcomes are achieved by reflecting the perspectives of our diverse customer base.

Within the ESO organization, nearly 60 employees work together in a highly collaborative global environment supporting world-leading brands such as Nemluvio and Sculptra.

We offer the opportunity to work in an exciting international setting where both professional and personal development are encouraged. Our teams are based in modern offices across Europe, including Uppsala (Sweden), Alby (France), and Barcelona (Spain).

As you will be working closely with suppliers located across the globe, travel is an integral part of the position.

Who You Are

You are a resilient and quality-focused professional with a strong sense of ownership and accountability. You thrive in an international and collaborative environment, enjoy building relationships with internal and external stakeholders, and have a passion for ensuring compliance, product quality, and continuous improvement.

Your expertise and engagement will contribute significantly to Galderma's continued growth and success.

Our People Make a Difference

At Galderma, you’ll work with people who are like you—and people who are different. We value what every member of our team brings. Professionalism, collaboration, and a friendly, supportive culture create the perfect environment for people to thrive, develop, and excel in what they do.

Join us on this exciting journey and help shape the future of quality within Galderma's global External Supplier Organization.

jobs.title: Quality Specialist
jobs.description:
RaySearch develops innovative software solutions to improve cancer care. About 1000 clinics in more than 40 countries use RaySearch software to improve treatments and quality of life for patients. RaySearch was founded in 2000 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. The headquarters is located in Stockholm, with subsidiaries in the US, Europe and Asia - Pacific. Today we are more than 400 employees with a common vision of improving cancer care with innovative software. Our great staff is crucial for our success and we offer a fantastic working environment in modern offices, flexibility and good opportunities for development. We believe in equal opportunities, value diversity and work actively to prevent discrimination.

Do you want to contribute to improving the care of cancer patients by helping ensure the quality and compliance of innovative software medical devices?

Join RaySearch and become part of our Quality & Regulatory Affairs team. In this role, you will work closely with colleagues across the organization to support and continuously improve our Quality Management System, enabling the development and delivery of safe and effective products to patients around the world.

About the role

As a Quality Specialist, you will be part of a dedicated Quality & Regulatory Affairs team supporting a growing and innovative medical device organization.

You will be involved in a variety of quality activities across the product lifecycle and have the opportunity to work closely with colleagues throughout the organization.

The role focuses on maintaining and improving our Quality Management System while supporting the organization in meeting regulatory and quality requirements in a practical and efficient way.

Your main responsibilities

    Support the maintenance and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS), related quality processes, and electronic QMS platforms.
    Manage and support CAPA, non-conformity, and change control activities.
    Plan, conduct, and follow up on internal audits.

    Review quality records and documentation to ensure compliance with company procedures and regulatory requirements.
    Support process improvements and help drive a culture of continuous improvement throughout the organization.
    Provide guidance and support to colleagues on quality processes and QMS requirements.

Your profile

We are looking for someone who enjoys working in a collaborative environment and combines strong quality knowledge with a pragmatic and positive mindset. You are proactive, structured, and detail-oriented, while also understanding how to apply quality requirements in a practical way that supports business objectives.

You are comfortable challenging the status quo, asking questions, taking ownership of issues through to completion, and making informed decisions when balancing quality, compliance, and business needs. You enjoy collaborating across functions, are eager to learn, and are motivated by continuous improvement.

Skills and experience

    3+ years of experience working with Quality Management Systems in the medical device industry.
    Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Medical Technology, Quality Management, or a related field.
    Good understanding of quality processes such as:

    CAPA

    Change control
    Internal audits

    Experience from software medical devices is highly desirable.
    Strong communication and collaboration skills.
    Ability to work independently and drive activities forward.
    Able to balance compliance requirements with business needs using a risk-based mindset.
    Very good command of English, both spoken and written.

Our Culture

At RaySearch, we share a passion for innovation and the fight against cancer. Our team consists of dedicated experts who strive to deliver exceptional results through collaboration, attention to detail, and cutting-edge technology. We take pride in our role as a leader in cancer treatment, developing solutions that truly make a difference for patients worldwide.

Our Offer

We offer a dynamic and inclusive work environment in Hagastaden, Stockholm’s Life Science Hub. Our modern office space includes an in-house gym, yoga classes, and social activities such as after-work events. We also provide a fantastic lunch buffet, daily fika, and a stunning rooftop terrace with a 360-degree view of Stockholm. This comes with a competitive compensation and benefits package.

jobs.title: Embedded Software & Control Engineer
jobs.description:
Job description:
Do you enjoy writing C++ software that interacts directly with hardware and makes complex systems perform reliably in the real world?

At Robotto, we build advanced autonomy and software solutions for drones and unmanned systems. Our work brings together computer vision, embedded software, control, electronics and real-world product development.We are looking for an Embedded Software Engineer with strong C++ experience to develop software close to the hardware layer of our drone platform. Experience with motor control and Field-Oriented Control (FOC) is highly preferred.This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of software, electronics and control systems, where performance, reliability and real-world behaviour matter.

The role:
You will work on embedded software that supports the control and operation of Robotto's drone and unmanned systems.Your work will involve developing reliable C++ software that interfaces with hardware, sensors, motors and other system components. You will work closely with colleagues across control, electronics, computer vision and flight testing to take software from development through integration and into real-world operation.For candidates with motor-control experience, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the development and improvement of our motor-control capabilities, including Field-Oriented Control (FOC).

What you will do:
- Develop and maintain embedded software in C++ for drones and unmanned systems.
- Build software that interfaces with motors, sensors, actuators and other hardware components.
- Work with real-time and performance-sensitive software.
- Contribute to motor-control software, including Field-Oriented Control (FOC), where relevant to your experience.
- Develop and integrate communication between embedded components and wider product systems.
- Debug complex software and hardware interactions and identify root causes of issues.
- Collaborate closely with control, electronics, flight-test and software engineers.
- Contribute to software architecture, testing, documentation, code quality and technical decisions.
- Support integration and testing on real hardware and drone platforms.

What success could look like in your first 3-6 months:
- You have developed a strong understanding of Robotto's embedded architecture, hardware and control systems.
- You are contributing production-quality C++ code to our embedded platform.
- You are successfully integrating and debugging software on real hardware.
- You are contributing to improved reliability and performance across our embedded systems.
- If you have motor-control experience, you are actively contributing to our FOC and motor-control development.
- You have become a trusted technical partner for colleagues across software, control, electronics and flight testing.

What we are looking for:
We are looking for an engineer who is comfortable working close to hardware and enjoys solving complex technical problems where software and physical systems meet.
- At least 3 years of professional software engineering experience, ideally within embedded or real-time systems.
- Experience with motor control, particularly Field-Oriented Control (FOC), is highly preferred. Experience with BLDC/PMSM motors, control loops, PWM, encoders or related motor-control technologies would also be highly relevant.
- Strong C++ programming skills.
- Hands-on experience developing software that interfaces with hardware.
- Experience with embedded systems, real-time systems, microcontrollers or similar low-level environments.
- Good understanding of debugging, testing, software architecture and version control.
- Experience with communication protocols such as CAN, UART, SPI, I²C or similar is an advantage.
- Experience with robotics, drones, autonomous systems or other complex electromechanical products is an advantage.
- Professional fluency in English.
- A degree in computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, robotics, mechatronics or a related field is preferred; equivalent practical experience is equally welcome.

Who you are:
You are practical, curious and comfortable getting close to both the software and the hardware when solving a problem.
- You take ownership of your work and care about software quality and reliability.
- You enjoy understanding how systems behave beyond the code itself.
- You approach debugging methodically and are comfortable solving difficult software/hardware problems.
- You collaborate well across software, electronics and control disciplines.
- You are comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities.
- You communicate technical trade-offs, progress and risks clearly and pragmatically.

Minds and makers forging ahead together.
At Robotto, we value people who do. People who take ownership, are willing to try new things just to see if they work, and are comfortable asking for forgiveness rather than permission. We want people who are curious, proactive and excited about turning ideas into something real.

Why join Robotto?
Robotto is building advanced autonomy technology for drones and unmanned systems, working at the intersection of software, hardware, computer vision, control and real-world operations.You will join a highly technical and ambitious team at an exciting point in the company's journey. As we continue to scale our engineering team and work on challenging new projects, you will have the opportunity to influence how our embedded and control software develops.This is a role where your software will not remain behind a screen. You will see it integrated with real hardware, tested on real systems and used in demanding real-world environments.You will work closely with talented engineers, take meaningful technical ownership and help shape the next generation of Robotto's technology.

Equal Employment Opportunity:
Robotto is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering an inclusive workplace. We recruit based on skills, experience and potential. Please note that certain positions may require specific nationality or eligibility for security clearance in accordance with applicable laws and the nature of our work.

More information and application:
https://careers.robotto.ai/jobs/8273412-embedded-software-control-engineer

jobs.title: Lähiesihenkilötyön harjoittelijaksi Satakunnan Osuuskaupan market -toimialalle
jobs.description:
Primary location:
PORI

Satakunnan Osuuskaupan market -toimialalle haetaan lähiesihenkilötyön harjoittelijoita

Omaatko mahtavan asiakaspalveluasenteen? Olisitko sinä tulevaisuuden vastuumyyjä tai esihenkilö? Tule kanssamme tekemään ihan tavallisia töitä, poikkeuksellisen upeassa porukassamme! 💚

Haemme Satakunnan Osuuskaupan Sale- ja S-market-ketjuihin henkilöitä, jotka ovat kiinnostuneita oppimaan vastuumyyjän työnkuvaa ja tarvittaessa sijaistamaan vastuumyyjiemme lomia tai poissaoloja. Harjoittelupaikkoja on meillä useissa yksiköissä, sekä Porissa että muualla Satakunnassa.

Lähiesihenkilötyön harjoittelijana pääset ohjaamaan työryhmän toimintaa ja vastaat kokonaisvaltaisesti myymälän arjen pyörittämisestä, henkilöstöstä sekä tuloksellisesta toiminnasta yhdessä muun vastaavatiimin ja esihenkilön kanssa. Odotamme halua oppia valmentavia johtamistaitoja koko työryhmän kehittämiseksi ja yksikön tavoitteiden saavuttamiseksi.

Tehtävä on osa-aikainen (34 h/vko), ja harjoittelujakso ajoittuu touko-syyskuulle 2027. Edellytämme mahdollisuutta työskennellä vaihtelevissa vuorotyössä laajojen aukioloaikojemme mukaisesti. Harjoittelun aloitusajankohdasta voidaan sopia joustavasti opintojesi mukaan ja harjoittelusuunnitelma laaditaan sinun osaamisesi pohjalta. Me perehdytämme sinut kattavasti kaikkiin tehtäviisi ja tuemme sinua onnistumisiin pitkin matkaa!

Tässä tehtävässä työpäiväsi ovat monipuolisia, ja pääset oppimaan uutta sekä kehittämään osaamistasi käytännön tekemisen kautta. Opetamme sinut asettamaan tavoitteita sekä antamaan valmentavaa palautetta päivittäisessä työssäsi. Varmistat yhdessä muun vastuutiimin kanssa onnistuneet asiakaskokemukset ja sujuvan arjen hyvällä fiiliksellä. Etsimämme lähiesihenkilötyön harjoittelija on ennakkoluulottomasti ja positiivisesti työhön suhtautuva henkilö, joka osaa innostaa henkilökuntaa mukaan kehitykseen.

Odotamme sinulta joustavuutta, paineensietokykyä sekä halua johtaa ja kehittää tiimin toimintaa omalla esimerkillä. Jos olet aktiivisen työotteen omaava tiimipelaaja, saat työryhmän loistamaan asiakaspalvelussa ja olet vastuullinen kaikessa tekemisessä, olet etsimämme henkilö.

Työntekijämme viihtyvät ja kasvavat meillä: S-ryhmän sisällä on paljon työntekijätarinoita siitä, että isosta talosta on löytynyt mieluisia urapolkuja motivoituneille tekijöillemme. Tarjoamme sinulle ammatillisen kasvun mahdollisuudet sekä erilaisia koulutusmahdollisuuksia. Työntekijänämme saat käyttöösi myös S-ryhmän ja Satakunnan Osuuskaupan erinomaiset henkilöstöedut, joista voit lukea lisää täältä!

Tehtävän palkka perustuu kaupan alan työehtosopimukseen. Tuntipalkka on koulutuksesta ja kokemusvuosista riippuen 11,16-14,93 €/h. Vuorotyössä ilta- ja viikonloppulisät tuovat mukavaa lisää peruspalkan päälle. Lisäksi sinulla on mahdollisuus suoritepalkkioon.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa ryhmäpäällikkö Merja Perttula-Vuori, merja.perttula-vuori@sok.fi, p. 044 725 1405.

Haku päättyy perjantaina 30.10.2026. Esikarsintavaiheessa kutsumme soveltuvimmat hakijat videohaastatteluun. Videohaastattelukutsun lähetämme antamaasi sähköpostiosoitteeseen.



Satakunnan Osuuskauppa on paikallinen yritys, jonka omistavat satakuntalaiset asiakasomistajat. Tehtävämme on tuottaa asiakasomistajillemme palveluita ja etuja. Toimimme marketkaupassa, matkailu- ja ravitsemiskaupassa ja liikennekaupassa. Satakunnan Osuuskauppa on alueensa suurin yksityinen työnantaja, ja savuton työpaikka. Olemme osa valtakunnallista S-ryhmää.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing & Growth Specialist
jobs.description:
Vire Advisors kasvaa, ja etsimme uutta osaajaa tiimiin. Keskeinen ajatuksemme **Vaikuttava HR ei ole käsityötä** ohjaa tekemistämme. Sinun tehtäväsi on auttaa tekemään siitä ajatus, jonka markkina tuntee, muistaa ja mielellään myös jakaa eteenpäin.

Autamme yrityksiä modernisoimaan johtamista ja HR-tekemistä teknologian, automaatioiden ja tekoälyn avulla. Samalla rakennamme omia teknologiaratkaisujamme, ja SaaS-alustamme **Arviro©** on nyt siinä vaiheessa, että se tarvitsee työbestiksen, jolla on markkinoinnin seniori-osaamista, vauhtia ja joka osaa vahvistaa SaaS tuotteistamisen kaupallista ajattelua.

Etsimme siis kokenutta **Senior Marketing & Growth Specialistia** vahvistamaan brändiämme, kasvattamaan näkyvyyttämme ja rakentamaan markkinointia, joka näkyy myös liiketoiminnan tuloksissa.

Roolissa yhdistyvät sisältömarkkinointi, sosiaalinen media, tapahtumat, digitaalinen näkyvyys ja kasvun rakentaminen. Etsimme ihmistä, joka osaa rakentaa suunnan mutta ei kavahda käytännön tekemistä.

**Mitä työssäsi teet?**

Vastaat Vire Advisors sisältömarkkinoinnin, sosiaalisen median ja kasvua tukevan markkinoinnin suunnittelusta ja toteutuksesta yhdessä asiantuntijoidemme kanssa.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:

- sisältökalenterin ja uusien sisältökonseptien rakentaminen

- LinkedIn- ja Instagram-sisältöjen suunnittelu ja toteutus

- blogien, uutiskirjeiden, asiakastarinoiden ja verkkosisältöjen kirjoittaminen

- asiantuntijoiden ajatusten jalostaminen sisällöiksi, joita muutkin kuin asiantuntijat haluavat lukea

- kampanjoiden, webinaarien, messujen ja asiakastilaisuuksien suunnittelu ja toteutus

- verkkosivujen, SEO:n ja AI-haun kehittäminen

- markkinointimateriaalien ja landing pagejen rakentaminen

- analytiikan, liidien ja eri kanavien tulosten seuranta

- markkinoinnin työkalujen ja tekoälyn aktiivinen hyödyntäminen.


Hyvä sisältö ei ole meille itseisarvo. Sen pitää rakentaa tunnettavuuutta, herättää kiinnostusta, vahvistaa asiantuntijabrändiä, synnyttää liidejä ja tukea myyntiä.

**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Etsimme kokenutta B2B-markkinoijaa, jolla on jo näyttöjä siitä, mitä on omalla osaamisellaan saavuttanut.

Toivomme sinulta:

- vahvaa kokemusta B2B-markkinoinnista

- vahvaa sisältömarkkinoinnin ja kirjoittamisen osaamista

- erittäin hyvää LinkedIn- ja Instagram-osaamista

- kokemusta tapahtumista, webinaareista ja kampanjoista

- ymmärrystä SEO:sta, verkkosivuista, analytiikasta ja liidien muodostumisesta

- hyvää visuaalista silmää

- vahvaa markkinoinnin työkalujen tuntemusta

- kykyä hyödyntää tekoälyä tehokkaasti omassa työssäsi

- erinomaista suomen ja englannin kielen osaamista. Aiemmin kokemus kansainvälisiltä markkinoilta on vahva etu.


**Aikaisempi kokemus kasvuyrityksestä sekä SaaS-, teknologia-, asiantuntija- tai ratkaisumyynnin markkinoinnista on meille erittäin tärkeää.** Ja jos tiedät ja osaat selkeästi perustella, että markkinoinnin onnistuminen näkyy muuallakin kuin seuraajamäärässä, saat meiltä monta tykkäystä.

**Millainen henkilö menestyy meillä?**

Menestyt tässä roolissa, jos olet samaan aikaan luova, kaupallinen ja systemaattinen. Tartut asioihin itsenäisesti, viet ideat käytäntöön ja osaat muuttaa suuntaa nopeasti, jos data kertoo, ettei jokin toimi.

Pidät ihmisistä, tapahtumista ja keskusteluista ja saat mielellään asiantuntijasta irti ajatuksen, jota hän ei itse edes tajunnut olevan julkaisemisen arvoinen (big ask, we know ). Uskallat myös haastaa tiiminjäseniä! Huonot ideat nostetaan rohkeasti pöytään ja tehdään niistä yhdessä parempia.

Kasvuyrityksessä kaikki ei ole valmiiksi pureskeltua. Jos tarvitset täydellisen tehtävänannon, kolmen viikon hyväksyntäkierroksen ja kuusi allekirjoitusta ennen julkaisua, emme ehkä ole täydellinen match.

Jos taas nautit siitä, että pääset rakentamaan, kokeilemaan ja näkemään oman kädenjälkesi nopeasti, hae meille!

**Mitä tarjoamme?**

Saat laajan roolin kasvuyrityksessä, jossa markkinointi on yksi kasvun tärkeimmistä moottoreista.

Pääset työskentelemään suoraan omistajien, asiantuntijoiden, myynnin ja teknologiatiimin kanssa sekä vaikuttamaan siihen, miltä Vire Advisors ja Arviro näyttävät ja kuulostavat seuraavassa kasvuvaiheessaan.

Saat vastuuta, vapautta ja tilaa tehdä asioita paremmin kuin me olemme niitä tähän asti tehneet. Itse asiassa sitä me sinulta odotammekin.

**Työpaikka:** Vire Advisors

**Tehtävänimike:** Senior Marketing & Growth Specialist

**Työsuhde:** Vakituinen ja kokoaikainen, se voi myös olla osa-aikainen ja/tai toiminimiyrittäjä. Olemme avoimia monenlaisille työsuhdemuodoille, kunhan osaaminen ja omistautuneisuus ovat kohdallaan.

**Sijainti / hybridityö:** Vire Advisors on tällä hetkellä 100% remote. Ainakin toistaiseksi. Ehdotuksia otetaan vastaan.

**Aloitus:** Mahdollisimman pian, mutta sovittavissa. Meidän monilahjakas markkinoinnin assistentti Sanna päättää määräaikaisuutensa 16.10.2026.

**Hakuaika:** Än, yy, tee, nyt! Hakuaika alkaa nyt, ja päättyy viimeistään 23.10.2026

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Lähetä meille CV ja kerro erityisesti siitä, mistä olet oman osaamisesi suhteen ylpeä, mitä onnistumisia haluat tuoda esiin. Voit mielellään näyttää meille sisältöjä, kampanjoita, tapahtumia tai muita kokonaisuuksia, joista olet ylpeä ja jotka mielestäsi tukevat hakemustasi.

**Meitä kiinnostaa vähemmän se, mistä olet ollut vastuussa. Meitä kiinnostaa enemmän se, mitä sinun ansiostasi tapahtui.**

jobs.title: Specification Engineer
jobs.description:
Wärtsilä Marine Power, Global Planning, is looking fora Specification Engineer to join the Specification Management team. This opportunity is offered permanently and is located in Vaasa, Finland.
Specification Management is an internal function of Global Planning. Our common target is to ensure that produced engines include sold options, and all deliveries will be completed according to the delivery schedules. We can provide a great supportive working atmosphere with highly motivated professionals in a solid cooperative team where you can also always feel free to discuss and share your ideas. You will work as one of the key persons in the middle of order to delivery process where you can see your personal performance results in practice. We are developing as a company and improving our processes and way of working all the time, so we can ensure that you will also have a role in continuous improvement actions and other development streams.

As a Specification Engineer, your work will focus on:
Creating and maintaining engine technical specifications and bill of materials according to the inputs from separate stakeholders and organizations for customer deliveries
Close cooperation with Project Management, Production, Material Management, Technology and other supportive functions
Engine specifications and bill of materials to be created and maintained according to the production program
Provide As-Manufactured bill of materials of completed deliveries for Service use
Design release implementation process


To meet the below requirements will enable you to shine in this role:

B.Sc. in Engineering, or equivalent
Demonstrable knowledge of MS-office, ERP systems (SAP) and PDM systems (Teamcenter)
Design for manufacturing and manufacturing bill of material experience
Ability to read and understand technical drawings
Knowledge of Project management
Previous experience with 4-stroke engine products
Fluency in English and Finnish, both written and verbal
Team player who engages and collaborates with others to deliver results

Why you and us?
We at Wärtsilä believe in empowerment, ownership and taking responsibility of our work. We support each others growth, and co-creation is the true basis of our innovation. We have courage to see opportunities and take initiative.
We are authentic and honest, and we strongly believe in that by being your own true self you can accomplish so much more. We dont always get it right the first time, and if mistakes are made, we make sure to learn and grow from them. We want everyone to voice their opinions freely. That is why we have built an environment that empowers you and everyone around you, and where you can feel safe and cared for. Are you eager to be part of this ambition?
We have an amazing team, and we are excited about our work and the impact it has on building sustainable societies. We are looking to find a colleague with this shared passion for smart technologies and a sustainable future.

Contact & next steps

We hope to hear from you soon by submitting your application through our careers portal. We aim to keep you updated on the process throughout.
Welcome to join us in shaping the decarbonisation of marine and energy!

Facilities Manager Location: Dublin 7, Ireland Salary: €50,000 plus Sodexo benefits Contract: Full-time, Permanent About the Role Sodexo is looking for an experienced Facilities Manager to join our team in Grangegorman. This is a hands-on, client-facing role responsible for the day-to-day management of the on-site hard and soft services team, ensuring excellent service delivery, strong operational performance and compliance with contractual requirements. You’ll play a key role in managing the site team, contractors, maintenance programmes, lifecycle works and reactive client requirements, while driving continuous improvement across the contract. Manage the SSOW permitting system and promote safe working practices. Lead Toolbox Talks, Safety Walks and Near Miss reporting. Manage contractor engagement and site inductions. Act as the key operational point of contact for on-site issues. Manage materials ordering and maintain accurate contract and project records. Deliver allocated projects on time, within budget and to specification. Monitor remedial works, budgets and expenditure. Support continuous improvement, innovation and cost-reduction initiatives. Build strong relationships with clients, visitors, contractors and internal stakeholders. Prepare reports and monitor operational deadlines and performance. What We’re Looking For We’re looking for an experienced Facilities professional who combines strong people leadership with commercial awareness and excellent customer service. You’ll ideally have: Previous FM management or coordination experience. Experience managing both hard and soft FM services. Strong people management and leadership skills. Experience in a client-facing role. Good understanding of FM technical services. Experience working with contracts and commercial requirements. Strong financial and budget management skills. Excellent communication and relationship-management skills. The ability to analyse information, make decisions and provide practical solutions. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail. Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Word and Excel. A customer-focused and solutions-oriented approach. The ability to work at pace while maintaining accuracy.

jobs.title: Capacitaire / Référent du projet animalier (H/F)
jobs.description:
Le Parc Animalier de Sainte-Croix entre dans une nouvelle étape de son histoire.
Après 45 ans d'engagement pour le vivant, le parc a souhaité restructurer en profondeur son pôle animalier afin d'en faire un modèle de transmission, de conservation et de bien-être animal, fruit d'une nouvelle d'organisation. Depuis 2 ans nous restructurons le service avec un nouveau cadre managérial de proximité engagé et compétent, des équipes stables et un projet en construction.  

Notre ambition est claire :
Reconnecter toutes les générations au vivant, dans le respect des animaux et des écosystèmes, pour transformer le regard de nos visiteurs sur la nature.
Dans ce cadre, nous recherchons un capacitaire capable d'accompagner cette transformation, non pas uniquement comme garant réglementaire, mais comme référent structurant d'un projet animalier ambitieux.

Le projet :
Le pôle animalier de Sainte-Croix a engagé un travail de restructuration autour de plusieurs priorités :
- Clarifier les rôles et responsabilités de chacun
- Renforcer l'autonomie des responsables de secteur et des équipes
- Structurer les procédures, les circuits de décision et les validations
- Faire monter les équipes en compétence
- Développer une culture forte du bien-être animal
- Mieux intégrer les projets d'élevage, de conservation et de réintroduction ;
- Accompagner l'évolution des infrastructures et des enclos ;
- Donner davantage de sens, de cadre et de fluidité au quotidien animalier.

Ce travail s'inscrit dans la continuité de l'accompagnement mené avec Brice Lefaux, qui a permis de poser un diagnostic, d'identifier les axes de progrès et d'engager une nouvelle dynamique collective.

La mission :
- être le garant du cadre réglementaire, sécuritaire et animalier du parc.
- veiller à ce que les décisions prises soient conformes aux obligations liées à la détention et à la présentation au public d'animaux sauvages, tout en permettant à l'organisation de gagner en maturité et en autonomie.  

Sous la responsabilité directe de la Direction du parc, vous rejoindrez le pôle animalier, une équipe pluridisciplinaire d'une trentaine de collaborateurs composée de vétérinaires, d'un chef de service, de managers de proximité et de soigneurs animaliers. Le poste ne comporte pas de missions de gestion administrative ni d'encadrement d'équipe.
Votre rôle est de poser le cadre, sécuriser les décisions importantes, transmettre votre expertise dans des réflexions collectives et accompagner la montée en compétence et responsabilité des équipes. Et notamment :
- Faire partie du comité de direction avec votre expertise et un bon niveau d'autonomie.
- Participer à la conception du Master Plan.

Nous recherchons une personne capable de conjuguer exigence réglementaire, expertise zoologique et intelligence collective.
Vous devrez accompagner Sainte-Croix dans la nouvelle étape du pôle animalier : être une équipe exemplaire, structurée, responsable et pleinement alignée avec la raison d'être du parc.
Vous devrez également :
- être titulaire du Certificat de capacité adapté aux espèces concernées.
- justifier d'une solide expérience en parc zoologique.
- posséder un bon niveau d'autonomie.
- Très bonne connaissance du bien-être animal, de la sécurité et des obligations réglementaires.
- Capacité à travailler de manière transverse avec une direction, une responsable zoologique, des responsables de secteur et des équipes terrain.
- Goût pour la transmission, la structuration et l'accompagnement du changement.
- Capacité à déléguer et à faire grandir les équipes.
- Sensibilité forte aux enjeux de conservation, d'éducation et de reconnexion au vivant.

Vous ne serez pas seulement le garant d'un cadre, vous serez l'un des artisans d'une nouvelle organisation au service des animaux, des équipes et de la mission du parc.

jobs.title: Bilmekaniker / teknisk leder – Bil, ATV og UTV
jobs.description:
Senteret AS i Egersund søker teknisk leder / bilmekaniker for lette kjøretøy. Hos oss får du en variert arbeidshverdag med bil, ATV/UTV, dekk, og noe anleggsmaskiner – kombinert med stor frihet, ansvar og mulighet til å forme din egen arbeidsdag.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi ser etter en dyktig og engasjert bilmekaniker som ønsker å ta ansvar og være med på å bygge opp vårt nye bilverksted.

Du liker å finne løsninger, jobber selvstendig og trives med en variert arbeidshverdag. Hos oss er ikke alle dager like, så vi ser etter en person som synes det er spennende å jobbe med alt fra moderne biler og diagnose til ATV/UTV, tilhengere og andre mekaniske utfordringer.

Vi ser gjerne at du:

  • Har fagbrev som bilmekaniker for lette kjøretøy

  • Har relevant praksis og kan oppfylle kravene til teknisk leder, eller allerede er godkjent som teknisk leder

  • Er selvstendig, løsningsorientert og tar initiativ

  • Har god teknisk forståelse og interesse for feilsøking

  • Er strukturert og opptatt av kvalitet i arbeidet

  • Tar ansvar for jobben fra den kommer inn til den er ferdig

  • Trives med både selvstendig arbeid og samarbeid med andre

  • Har lyst til å bidra med egne ideer til hvordan verkstedet kan utvikles

Erfaring med ATV/UTV eller anleggsmaskiner er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Det viktigste for oss er å finne riktig person. Du trenger derfor ikke kunne <<alt>> fra første dag. Har du riktig faglig grunnlag, praktisk sans og lyst til å utvikle både deg selv og verkstedet sammen med oss, ønsker vi gjerne å høre fra deg.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som teknisk leder og bilmekaniker får du en sentral rolle i oppbyggingen og den daglige driften av vårt nye bilverksted. Du får stor påvirkning på hvordan verkstedet organiseres og utvikles.

Arbeidsoppgavene vil blant annet være:

  • Service, vedlikehold, feilsøking og reparasjon av person- og varebiler

  • Teknisk ledelse og oppfølging av verksteddriften

  • Sikre at arbeid utføres i henhold til gjeldende krav og rutiner

  • Kontroll og kvalitetssikring av utført arbeid

  • Bidra til å utvikle gode rutiner og effektiv arbeidsflyt i verkstedet

  • Montering, Service og reparasjoner på ATV/UTV

  • Dekk- og hjularbeid

  • Mulighet for arbeid på mindre anleggs- og arbeidsmaskiner

Dette er en stilling for deg som liker variasjon og ønsker større frihet til å kunne styre din egen arbeidsdag. Siden bilverkstedet etableres nå, får du en unik mulighet til å være med og forme både verkstedet, utstyrsparken og arbeidshverdagen fra starten.

Vi tilbyr

Vi tilbyr en variert og selvstendig arbeidshverdag med stor frihet og korte beslutningsveier. Som teknisk leder blir du en viktig del av satsingen vår på bilverksted, og får være med på å forme verkstedet fra starten.

Hos oss får du blant annet:

  • Konkurransedyktig lønn etter avtale

  • Fast 100 % stilling eller deltidsstilling, alt etter hva som passer deg best.

  • Stor grad av frihet og ansvar i arbeidshverdagen

  • Reell påvirkning på hvordan verkstedet bygges opp og drives

  • Mulighet til å påvirke valg av verktøy, utstyr og arbeidsmetoder

  • En svært variert arbeidshverdag med bil, ATV/UTV, dekk, og maskiner

  • Muligheter for kurs, faglig utvikling og videre kompetanse

  • Et uformelt arbeidsmiljø med korte beslutningsveier

  • En arbeidsplass i utvikling, hvor gode ideer raskt kan bli satt ut i praksis

Vi ønsker at den som kommer inn i denne rollen skal få være med på å utvikle det videre sammen med oss. Her får du muligheten til å sette ditt eget preg på arbeidsplassen -- ikke bare overta en ferdig oppskrift.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Senteret AS er en lokal og solid bedrift i Egersund med en variert virksomhet innen kjøretøy, maskiner og utstyr. Vi driver blant annet med salg og service av ATV/UTV, dekk og hjul gjennom Dekkpartner, samt utleie i samarbeid med Naboen Utleie.

Vi liker å ha flere bein å stå på og har bygget virksomheten rundt praktiske løsninger, god service og korte beslutningsveier.

Hos oss er det høyt under taket, lite unødvendig byråkrati og kort vei fra en god idé til handling. Vi ønsker å bygge et moderne og allsidig verksted hvor både ansatte og kunder skal trives, og hvor den rette personen får stor påvirkning på hvordan verkstedet utvikles videre.

·         Er uddannet kok eller har solid erfaring fra køkken

·         Brænder for god, hjemmelavet mad og kvalitet

·         Har lyst til at bidrage med idéer og faglighed

·         Trives som en del af et team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og løfter i flok

·         Fast fuldtidsstilling

·         Gode og attraktive arbejdstider

jobs.title: Den selvejende institution Stefanshjemmet søger pr. 1.11 2026 eller snarest derefter en medarbejder på 30-37 timer i gennemsnit pr. uge.
jobs.description:
Den selvejende institution Stefanshjemmet søger pr. 1.11.2026 eller snarest derefter en medarbejder på 30-37 timer i gennemsnit pr. uge.

Stefanshjemmet er et bo- og beskæftigelsestilbud til mennesker med erhvervet hjerneskade og/eller svære fysiske handicap.

Der er 10 beboere på en afdeling, og de har en erhvervet hjerneskade. På afdelingen er der ca.15 faste medarbejdere med forskellig baggrund og faglighed til at varetage pleje, omsorg, bostøtte og aktivitet for beboerne efter serviceloven.

På Stefanshjemmet værner vi om det tværfaglige miljø og har omkring 130 ansatte. Hovedgrupperne af ansatte består af SOSU-assistenter, pædagoger og ergo- og fysioterapeuter samt omsorgshjælpere.

Det kan også være du er uddannet SOSU-hjælper eller sygehjælper eller har en masse relevant erfaring fra pleje- og omsorgsområdet, der giver dig gode kompetencer til denne stilling.

Vi søger en medarbejder, der

·        brænder for området og beboere

·        har lyst til at bruge tid sammen med beboerne i løbet af dagen til aktivitet og samvær og være med til at skabe en god hverdag for beboerne

·        evner at tage sig tid til nærvær med beboerne og påskønner livshistorierne

·        er engageret og god til at se muligheder

·        er udadvendt, opsøgende og initiativrig

·        ser værdien i dokumentation og deling af viden. Vi bruger dokumentationssystemet Modulus.

·        Har et smittende humør og en sund og god indstilling til arbejdet og samarbejdet.

 

Som ansat på Stefanshjemmet er det vigtigt for os, at du er fagligt stolt, engageret og har hjertet på rette sted og et menneskesyn der stemmer overens med Stefanshjemmets værdier. Beboernes selvbestemmelse og værdighed ligger os meget på sinde.

Dagligdagen byder på mange spændende faglige udfordringer og etiske dilemmaer, gode kollegaer, godt arbejdsmiljø og højt humør.

Arbejdet på afdelingerne tager udgangspunkt i beboernes behov og muligheder og vi arbejder mere og mere med KRAP-modellens anerkendende og ressourceorienterede tilgang, såvel som vores neuropædagogiske tilgang, samt værdier og etik.

Alle medarbejdere indgår i arbejdet med plejeopgaver, bostøtte og aktiviteter for beboerne og byder ind i de fælles opgaver med hver deres faglighed. Vi søger en dedikeret medarbejder, der har lyst til at indgå i plejen, omsorgen og aktiviteterne for beboerne. Vi arbejder med udvikling af afdelingen såvel monofagligt som tværfagligt, så kompetencer og viden kommer bedst muligt i spil.

Du skal være indstillet på, at der er tale om et arbejde, hvor man skal have en god fysik samt kunne arbejde et sted, hvor man af og til udfordres følelsesmæssigt i sit arbejde.

jobs.description:
Den selvejende institution Stefanshjemmet søger pr. 1.12.2026 eller snarest derefter en SOSU-assistent på 37 timer i gennemsnit pr. uge. Ønske om andet timetal kan også imødekommes.

Vi søger en SOSU-assistent, der:

·        brænder for sit fag

·        gerne vil være tovholder på beboernes sundhed sammen med dine sundhedsfaglige kolleger

·        kan skabe en struktur på samt organisere de sundhedsfaglige opgaver i afdelingen og for beboerne

·        vil indgå i oplæring af kolleger indenfor sundhedsfaglige opgaver, herunder instruktion i vitale parametermålinger

·        gerne vil stå for medicin-dosering sammen med dine kolleger

·        Kan eller har lyst til at lære at kunne varetage kateterpleje, skift og skyl af kateter, skift af sonde samt andre SOSU-opgaver.

·        Kan tage føringen, når der opstår komplekse sundhedsfaglige udfordringer, hvilket der af og til gør.

·        Ser værdien i et tæt samarbejde med bostedslægen, der kommer i vores hus.

·        ser værdien i dokumentation og deling af viden. Vi bruger dokumentationssystemet Modulus.

·        har lyst til at bruge tid sammen med beboerne i løbet af dagen til aktivitet og samvær og være med til at skabe en god hverdag for beboerne

·        evner at tage sig tid til nærvær med beboerne og påskønner livshistorierne

·        er engageret og god til at se muligheder

·        er udadvendt, opsøgende og initiativrig

·        Du kan være nyuddannet og er måske lige den, vi søger

Som ansat på Stefanshjemmet er det vigtigt for os, at du er fagligt stolt, engageret og har hjertet på rette sted og et menneskesyn der stemmer overens med Stefanshjemmets værdier. Beboernes selvbestemmelse og værdighed ligger os meget på sinde.

Dagligdagen byder på mange spændende faglige udfordringer og etiske dilemmaer, gode kollegaer, godt arbejdsmiljø og højt humør.

Stefanshjemmet er et bo- og beskæftigelsestilbud til mennesker med erhvervet hjerneskade og/eller svære fysiske handicap.

Der er 10 beboere på afdelingen, og de har en erhvervet hjerneskade. På afdelingen er der ca.15 faste medarbejdere med forskellig baggrund og faglighed til at varetage pleje, omsorg, bostøtte og aktivitet for beboerne efter serviceloven.

På Stefanshjemmet værner vi om det tværfaglige miljø og har omkring 130 ansatte. Hovedgrupperne af ansatte består af SOSU-assistenter, pædagoger og ergo- og fysioterapeuter.

Arbejdet på afdelingerne tager udgangspunkt i beboernes behov og muligheder og vi arbejder mere og mere med KRAP-modellens anerkendende og ressourceorienterede tilgang, såvel som vores neuropædagogiske tilgang, samt værdier og etik.

Alle medarbejdere indgår i arbejdet med plejeopgaver, bostøtte og aktiviteter for beboerne og byder ind i de fælles opgaver med hver deres faglighed. Vi søger en dedikeret SOSU-assistent, der har lyst til at indgå i plejen, omsorgen og aktiviteterne for beboerne. Vi arbejder med udvikling af afdelingen såvel monofagligt som tværfagligt, så kompetencer og viden kommer bedst muligt i spil.

Vi har på Stefanshjemmet etableret et sundhedsfagligt netværk, hvor vi arbejder med monofagligt indhold og hjælper hinanden med at styrke vores kompetencer. På HG1 er der yderligere to SOSU-assistenter.

Hvis du bliver ansat hos os, vil der blive udarbejdet et introduktionsprogram for dig, som en del af din oplæring i huset.

Vi vil glæde os til at modtage din ansøgning og håber, du kan se dig ind i de arbejdsopgaver, der er skitseret ovenfor.

Du kan også få mere at vide om Stefanshjemmet på vores hjemmeside: www.stefanshjemmet.dk.

Arbejdstiden er skiftende dag- og aftenvagter med arbejde hver 3. weekend.

jobs.title: Programming and game design club instructor
jobs.description:
**Brief:**

We are looking for game educators whose hearts beat for creativity, game design, and 21st-century skills! In this role, you will act as the mentor and guide for two of our awesome club themes: _My Own Game Studio_ and _Coding and Future Skills_. You will lead children and young people behind the scenes of the digital world, helping them develop logical thinking and breathe life into their own game ideas in a safe and engaging online environment.

**About us:**

School of Gaming (SOG) is a game-based education and digital youth work company that combines education and gaming in a fun and safe way. We provide children and young people with opportunities to develop 21st-century skills such as teamwork, problem-solving, and creativity. Our trained game educators guide kids in inspiring online clubs and courses with a strong social and educational impact.

**Description:**

Have you ever wondered what it feels like to be the one pulling the strings behind the scenes of a game studio? Now is your chance to become the boss of your own game studio and lead the talents of tomorrow from initial idea to final publication. And don't worry, we don't require you to move to Silicon Valley! You can stay right in your gaming chair in Finland or work at your local school. Or both!

Your mission is to guide and mentor groups of 10–15 young, creative gamers. In the _My Own Game Studio_ club, you aren't just coding. You are setting up a whole production team, including scriptwriters, graphic designers, sound designers, and producers. You will help kids identify their strengths and collaborate. In the _Coding and Future Skills_ club, you will step behind the digital curtain using the globally acclaimed Code.org platform.

Rather than spoon-feeding answers or mechanically grinding code syntax, you encourage them to try, fail, and figure things out on their own. Your role is to tickle their gray brain cells, spark their curiosity, and create challenges for them to solve.

**What We Are Looking For:**

- You know which way to hold a mouse and you understand the mechanics and culture of gaming worlds.

- You have a visual eye or a basic understanding of the different aspects of game design (coding, graphics, audio, or storytelling).

- We greatly appreciate it if you have former experience guiding small humanoids on Tellus (e.g., camp counselor, club instructor, or youth work).

- If gaming is your passion and you love stepping into stories and play, you are the Game Educator we want!


We provide plenty of materials, ready-made templates, and infinite support 24/7.

jobs.title: Fine dining floor manager til Tamashii
jobs.description:
I November åbner Norrlyst Koncernen dørene til Tamashii - et nyt ambitiøst restaurantprojekt på en af Københavns mest unikke lokationer

Tamashii betyder “sjæl” på japansk, og køkkenet bliver moderne asiatisk med Henrik Jyrks personlige aftryk. Ambitionen er høj, med teknik og råvarekvalitet i den skarpe ende, men uden den formalitet, der ofte forbindes med fine dining.

Fra køkken og service til vinkort og indretning er Tamashii skabt med en ambition om at nå Michelin-niveau.

Nu søger vi en floor manager der vil være med til at sætte retningen for hele gæsteoplevelsen og stå i spidsen for et hold, hvor service, struktur og nærvær er afgørende.

Om Norrlyst Koncernen

Norrlyst Koncernen står bag nogle af Københavns mest markante restauranter og vinbarer. Fælles for vores steder er en kompromisløs tilgang til kvalitet, stærkt værtskab og et ønske om konstant at udvikle os.

Vi tror på, at de bedste restauranter skabes af mennesker, der tager ansvar, skaber relationer og løfter hinanden. Derfor arbejder vi målrettet med ledelse, kultur og udvikling – og vi giver plads til dem, der vil sætte deres præg.

Som floor manager bliver du en nøgleperson i åbningen og får du sammen med restaurantchefen ansvaret for at skabe rammerne for en serviceoplevelse, der er lige så gennemtænkt som gastronomien.

Rollen

Du bliver den daglige leder af restauranten sammen med restaurantchefen.

Du skal sikre, at gæsteoplevelsen hænger sammen fra første kontakt til sidste farvel – og at teamet arbejder som én enhed, hvor struktur, overblik og energi går hånd i hånd.

Du er tæt på driften, men også på kulturen. Du er synlig på gulvet, sætter retning for dit team og skaber et arbejdsmiljø, hvor faglighed og arbejdsglæde går hånd i hånd.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Har erfaring med fine dining.

  • Er en stærk leder, der kan skabe ro, struktur og energi i service.

  • Har et naturligt værtskab og brænder for at skabe gode gæsteoplevelser.

  • Arbejder struktureret

  • Trives med ansvar og motiveres af at bygge en kultur op fra bunden.

  • Er tydelig, nærværende og god til at få mennesker til at lykkes sammen.

Vi tilbyder

  • En central rolle i åbningen af et nyt og ambitiøst restaurantprojekt.

  • Indflydelse på opbygningen af service, struktur og team.

  • Muligheden for at præge kulturen fra første dag.

  • Attraktive løn- og ansættelsesvilkår.

  • Personalefordele på tværs af Norrlyst Koncernens restauranter og vinbarer.

Hvis du motiveres af værtskab, ledelse og ambitionen om at skabe en restaurantoplevelse på højt niveau, glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Product Manager AnoxKaldnes MBBR
jobs.description:
Veolia – Driving Ecological Transformation

Veolia is a global leader in environmental services, operating on all five continents with nearly 218,000 employees. The company specialises in water, energy and waste management, and develops and implements innovative solutions for decarbonisation, pollution remediation and resource recovery – supporting communities and industries in their ecological transformation.

Within Water Tech, a dedicated team of experienced professionals works to address the world's most complex challenges related to water scarcity, water quality, productivity and energy. Together, we strive towards a shared goal: to create a more sustainable future.

At Veolia, diverse perspectives are encouraged and valued. Joining us means you will be part of a network that makes a real difference – for society and for the environment.

About the role

Are you passionate about driving growth and innovation in wastewater treatment technology? We're seeking an experienced Product Manager to drive accretive profitable growth of the AnoxKaldnes MBBR technology portfolio, including MBBR, Hybas, AnitaMox, eXeno, and Cella.

In this dynamic role, you'll sit at the intersection of technology, market intelligence, supply chain, and commercial strategy, working closely with the Aerobic Wastewater Technologies Leader to define and execute the technology strategy.

Strategy & Innovation

    Curate and maintain the technology roadmap for the AnoxKaldnes MBBR portfolio
    Define and drive the innovation roadmap by identifying gaps and opportunities through market intelligence, customer feedback, and competitive analysis
    Monitor and analyze market trends, regulatory developments, and competitive dynamics to anticipate future technology needs
    Work closely with the Aerobic Wastewater Technologies Leader to define technology and business strategy

Commercialization & Go-to-Market

    Lead the commercialization of new technologies and offers, from core offering definition through launch and adoption tracking
    Develop and execute go-to-market strategies and launch plans
    Develop compelling marketing messaging and positioning for the technology portfolio; collaborate with marketing and communications functions to produce impactful marketing content and campaigns
    Champion new technology introductions and represent the portfolio at industry conferences, customer events, and technical forums

Cross-Functional Collaboration

    Work transversally across the organization—engaging with sales, engineering, R&D, marketing, communications, regional teams, and other business lines (EPP, MWIS)
    Collaborate with regions to understand local market needs and ensure global relevance with local applicability
    Establish and maintain relationships with key external stakeholders including customers, industry partners, research institutions, and technology collaborators
    Enable the commercial organization through training, technical content, and thought leadership

Business Operations

    Support the development of technology training and educational programs for internal teams and external clients
    Contribute to business planning processes, including annual strategic planning and investment prioritization
    Provide timely reporting and strategic recommendations to senior management
    Maintain accurate documentation of technology roadmaps, innovation pipelines, and commercialization plans

Education

    Minimum Master's degree in Chemical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Chemistry, or equivalent professional experience
    MBA or business-related qualification is an asset

Professional Experience

    Minimum 5 years of relevant industry experience in water/wastewater treatment, including familiarity with biological treatment technologies (MBR, MBBR, MABR, BAF, or equivalent)
    Demonstrated experience in technology management, product management, or innovation management roles
    Experience developing and executing technology or product roadmaps
    Experience with commercialization of new technologies or products, including go-to-market strategy development
    Experience working in a matrix or transversal organizational structure
    Experience engaging with regional or global teams across multiple markets
    Experience with marketing strategy and technical communication

Language Skills

    Written and oral English proficiency required
    Other languages encouraged

Key Competencies

    Strong strategic thinking and analytical skills with the ability to translate market insights into actionable plans

    Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization

    Ability to communicate clearly and concisely on complex technical matters to both technical and non-technical audiences

    Strong customer orientation and market awareness

    Self-driven, organized, and capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously

Other Requirements

    Valid driving license (Category B)

Why join us?

Be part of a forward-thinking team focused on ecological transformation. Work with global experts in water treatment and contribute to environmental sustainability. If you join us you join a company that values knowledge sharing and personal development but most importantly you join a company where we pride ourselves on our friendly, open and collaborative atmosphere.

We can offer you freedom in return for responsibility. We are convinced that the right person for this job will have an exciting future!

Location: Based in Lund, Sweden .

Position: Full-time, Permanent

jobs.title: Electrical Operations Manager
jobs.description:
What you’ll do

Right now, we are looking for a Electrical Operations Manager for our Energy & Power Distribution team. In this role you will report to our Head of Energy & Power Distribution and sit within our Mill Services function.

Specific to this role, the day-to-day tasks will include the following but as we are a growing company with very little silos between teams, other tasks might be included as well.

    Lead and support a team of electricians, providing daily guidance, coaching, and ensuring proper training and qualifications.
    Act as the authorized supervisor of electrical installations, ensuring compliance with electrical safety legislation and internal standards.
    Oversee operations, maintenance, and inspections to guarantee safe, reliable, and continuous power supply for production.
    Drive improvements in efficiency, reliability, and maintenance processes through failure analysis, corrective actions, and cost optimization.
    Manage external service providers and stakeholders, ensuring accurate documentation, regulatory compliance, and up-to-date technical records.

What you’ll bring

Specific to this role, we would like to see that you can tick off a fair amount of the boxes below:

    Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Power Engineering or a related field.
    Valid Auktorisation A (Swedish High Voltage Authorization), or eligibility to obtain it.
    3+ years of relevant experience in a comparable role.
    Deep expertise in electrical distribution systems across low, medium, and high voltage networks.
    Strong background in electrical operations management with thorough knowledge of Swedish Electrical Safety Legislation (Elsäkerhetsverket) and EU directives.
    Proven ability to manage contractors and oversee on-site electrical safety responsibilities.
    Experience with SCADA systems, including protection, control, and measurement within electrical networks.
    Very good knowledge of English. Knowledge of Swedish is an advantage.
